  • Reviews and balances daily files downloaded from the Correspondent Banks and the ACH files from Federal Reserve Bank through the third-party ACH application within required service and compliance standards. Generates and processes exception reports.
  • Reviews and balances daily files downloaded from Third-Party Servicers for all emerging payment channels to include Zelle, RTP, Bill Pay service within compliance standards. Generates and processes exception reports.
  • Reviews and analyzes the daily returns file for ACH transactions posted against member accounts. Determines pay, pay and charge or no-pay status of exception items. Balance the returns file and transmit the returns file electronically within the regulatory deadlines.
  • Processes SCCU payroll, benefit and other inter-organizational transfers via digital payment rails.
  • Receives, verifies, and processes incoming and outgoing Domestic and International wires, outgoing wires up to $1 Million for members and departments through Wire system.

Payments Specialist II-Digital Requirements:

Since 1951, Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU) has proudly served our community, growing to over 685,000 members and managing $9 billion in assets. jobs.title: ServiceNow Developer II
jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

This position is a 6 month contract-to-hire. 

The ServiceNow Developer will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining ServiceNow solutions that support Space Coast Credit Union’s IT and business processes. This individual will be responsible for configuring and customizing ServiceNow applications, implementing workflows, and integrating the platform with other enterprise systems. The developer will work closely with stakeholders to understand requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver high-quality solutions that enhance operational efficiency and user experience. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical skills, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to continuous improvement within the ServiceNow environment.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

 ServiceNow Developer II Responsibilities

  •  Own the development of the enterprise platform ecosystem, using ServiceNow to standardize intake, workflow orchestration, CMDB alignment, and cross-platform integrations that enable end-to-end visibility and consistent service delivery.
  • Develop, configure, and customize ServiceNow applications and modules to meet business requirements.
  • Implement and maintain workflows, business rules, UI policies, and client scripts within the ServiceNow platform.
  • Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Integrate ServiceNow with other enterprise systems using REST, SOAP, and other APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to ServiceNow functionality, performance, and integrations.
  • Participate in testing, deployment, and documentation of ServiceNow solutions.
  • Maintain data integrity and ensure compliance with organizational standards and best practices.
  • Assist in upgrading ServiceNow instances and applying patches as needed.
  • Provide technical support and training to end users and junior developers.
  • Stay current with ServiceNow releases and new features, recommending improvements to enhance platform capabilities.

jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

This position is a 6 month contract-to-hire.

As a Systems Engineer II, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and securing enterprise Linux platforms with a primary focus on Red Hat Enterprise Linux, while also supporting distributions such as Ubuntu and related Linux variants. This role supports highly available, secure, and well-controlled infrastructure that underpins critical business services in a regulated financial services environment across on-premises, virtual, and cloud-hosted platforms.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Systems Engineer II Key Responsibilities

  • Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Linux servers with primary responsibility for Red Hat Enterprise Linux and supporting knowledge of Ubuntu and other Linux distributions.
  • Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and harden Linux operating systems, core services, and supporting packages across development, test, and production environments.
  • Manage system performance, availability, capacity, and operational health through monitoring, tuning, log analysis, and proactive maintenance.
  • Implement and maintain security controls including user and group administration, file permissions, SSH, sudo, PAM, SELinux, firewall configuration, certificate updates, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Execute compliance and hardening activities using SCAP, STIG, CIS benchmarks, and NIST-aligned controls; document findings, remediation plans, exceptions, and operational evidence for audits and reviews.
  • Support Linux workloads hosted on virtualized, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure, including integration with VMware, storage, backup, monitoring, networking, and identity platforms.
  • Develop and maintain automation for provisioning, patching, configuration management, health checks, and routine administration using Bash, Python, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis for infrastructure incidents impacting operating system, middleware, application, storage, network, or security services.
  • Support backup, recovery, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning and testing for Linux-based systems and services.
  • Participate in platform upgrades, migrations, lifecycle management, and enterprise change activities while following established operational, risk, and change control processes.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, standards, procedures, and change records that support operational consistency and knowledge transfer.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, network, database, cloud, and application teams to support secure, resilient, and high-performing production services.

Systems Engineer II Requirements

 5 to 8 years of progressively responsible Linux systems administration experience in enterprise environments, including strong hands-on administration of Red Hat Enterprise Linux, server patching, troubleshooting, security hardening, scripting, and support of virtualized infrastructure.

A 4-year degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent combinations of education, certifications, and directly related enterprise Linux administration experience will also be considered. Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or government is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Manager, IT Quality Assurance
jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Manger of IT Quality Assurance, you will lead our Quality Assurance (QA) and Business Analysis (BA) teams within our organization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality of our software products and services through effective QA processes while also driving business analysis activities to align IT solutions with business objectives. This role requires strong leadership skills, technical expertise in QA methodologies, and a strategic mindset to optimize IT processes and deliverables. The Manager will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization to gather requirements, define project scope, and ensure high-quality software solutions are tested and delivered on time.

Why Join SCCU?

• Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
• Hybrid and Flexible Schedule Options: Available for select positions. This position is Hybrid with 2 days per week required in office.
• Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Manger of IT Quality Assurance Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to the IT quality assurance and business analysis teams. Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting professional growth and development opportunities.
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop team members to ensure high performance and career growth. Set clear goals and objectives for the teams and monitor performance against these targets.
  • Collaborate closely with Systems Development, and other departments to translate business requirements into technical specifications and solutions.
  • Facilitate communication between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Work closely with project managers and teams to ensure QA and BA activities are integrated into project plans and timelines. Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of IT business analysis and quality assurance processes.
  • Tool selection for QA and BA teams to mature their processes within the organization.

Quality Assurance

  • Oversee the quality assurance process, including test planning, execution, and reporting. Develop and implement quality assurance standards and best practices.
  • Ensure that all software products meet established quality criteria, including functionality, performance, and reliability.
  • Organize, manage, and assist manual and automated testing to ensure minimal production defect.
  • Facilitate the decomposition of business requirements, into Use Cases and Acceptance Criteria
  • Organize and manage manual and automated test case libraries.
  • Participate in deployment testing exercises, and SCRUM events as needed.
  • Lead Instructor Training on QA-related topics.
  • Keep abreast of changes in technology, standards, and relevant developments in IT & testing by maintaining professional competency through training, reading, etc.
  • Lead QA process improvement initiatives and identify opportunities for automation and optimization to streamline workflows.

Business Analysis

  • Lead the IT business analysis team in gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into functional specifications.
  • Ensure that proposed solutions meet business objectives and address key challenges or opportunities.
  • Coordinate the requirements gathering process for applications, overseeing documentation and validation of changes.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies, trends, and best practices in IT business analysis and quality assurance.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or other relevant degree or equivalent experience is required.
  • 8-10 years of experience in IT business analysis or quality assurance required, with a minimum of 5 years in IT Management.

    Manger of IT Quality Assurance Compensation:

    • Starting Compensation: $131,940.00 - $139,734.00 annually
    • Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for ONE SCCU Annual Bonus.


    SCCU Benefits

    • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
    • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
    • Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
    • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
    • Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!

    • Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.

    Detailed description for internal job boards

    Manger of IT Development Duties and Responsibilities:

    • Manage the resources and activities of the IT Application Development team comprised of on and off-shore technical professionals responsible for providing software solutions for SCCU’s custom built and vendor provided applications.
    • Develop, maintain and execute on an IT Roadmap that will effectively forecast and meet the business’ needs.
    • Understand key stakeholder’s needs, features, and functionality and provide technical solutions that will address their software application needs.
    • Manage and execute project plans to deliver commitments with quality within the agreed upon timelines and budgets.
    • Work with project management to ensure accurate project status is provided regularly, risks are anticipated and mitigated, and issues are raised and addressed quickly.
    • Staff projects with the appropriate technical talent, track progress, and provide guidance and direction to help remove impediments and meet project milestones and timelines.
    • Drive continuous improvement by utilizing metrics and team feedback to identify and improve software engineering practices, processes, development and delivery.
    • Provide coaching, technical direction, supervision and development of the IT Application Development team.
    • Conduct regular meetings with direct reports to set objectives, review their workload and performance. Provide mentorship and support to help them achieve their career development goals.

    Minimum Qualifications:

    To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the minimum level of knowledge, skills and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions:

    • Demonstrated project management leading or supervising systems/applications development team members utilizing proven SDLC methodologies such as Waterfall and Agile (Kanban, Scrum) overseeing the technology life cycle from requirements analysis, feasibility estimates, design, code, documentation, testing, implementation, and support.
    • Experience designing software for scalability, reliability, and performance using Microsoft Stack (.NET framework, MVC, ASP.NET, VB.Net, C#, React or Angular/Blazor, ASPX, WPF, WinForms), JSON, XML, SOAP, and relational database development (SQL Server, Oracle).
    • Ability to build strong relationships with diverse teams within an organization
    • Ability to handle multiple, competing priorities, and navigate ambiguity
    • Strong leadership, communication and organizational skills
    • A deep understanding of the software development life-cycle, and a track record of shipping software on time
    • A passion for people management and mentorship

    Education & Training:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or other related field is required, ITIL certification strongly preferred.

    Prior Experience:

    • 8-10 years of related experience required; 5 years of experience working directly within engineering teams, 3+ years of managing teams within a development organization, 5+ years developing and building scalable enterprise software engineers people management in a technology function to include 3 years of demonstrated leadership capabilities, demonstrated in a management role of IT Professionals in a Software Development/Engineering environment. Preferred experience managing both on-shore and off-shore development teams.

At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Manger of IT Quality Assurance, you will lead our Quality Assurance (QA) and Business Analysis (BA) teams within our organization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality of our software products and services through effective QA processes while also driving business analysis activities to align IT solutions with business objectives. This role requires strong leadership skills, technical expertise in QA methodologies, and a strategic mindset to optimize IT processes and deliverables. The Manager will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization to gather requirements, define project scope, and ensure high-quality software solutions are tested and delivered on time.

Why Join SCCU?

• Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
• Hybrid and Flexible Schedule Options: Available for select positions. This position is Hybrid with 2 days per week required in office.
• Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Manger of IT Quality Assurance Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to the IT quality assurance and business analysis teams. Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting professional growth and development opportunities.
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop team members to ensure high performance and career growth. Set clear goals and objectives for the teams and monitor performance against these targets.
  • Collaborate closely with Systems Development, and other departments to translate business requirements into technical specifications and solutions.
  • Facilitate communication between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Work closely with project managers and teams to ensure QA and BA activities are integrated into project plans and timelines. Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of IT business analysis and quality assurance processes.
  • Tool selection for QA and BA teams to mature their processes within the organization.

Quality Assurance

  • Oversee the quality assurance process, including test planning, execution, and reporting. Develop and implement quality assurance standards and best practices.
  • Ensure that all software products meet established quality criteria, including functionality, performance, and reliability.
  • Organize, manage, and assist manual and automated testing to ensure minimal production defect.
  • Facilitate the decomposition of business requirements, into Use Cases and Acceptance Criteria
  • Organize and manage manual and automated test case libraries.
  • Participate in deployment testing exercises, and SCRUM events as needed.
  • Lead Instructor Training on QA-related topics.
  • Keep abreast of changes in technology, standards, and relevant developments in IT & testing by maintaining professional competency through training, reading, etc.
  • Lead QA process improvement initiatives and identify opportunities for automation and optimization to streamline workflows.

Business Analysis

  • Lead the IT business analysis team in gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into functional specifications.
  • Ensure that proposed solutions meet business objectives and address key challenges or opportunities.
  • Coordinate the requirements gathering process for applications, overseeing documentation and validation of changes.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies, trends, and best practices in IT business analysis and quality assurance.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or other relevant degree or equivalent experience is required.
  • 8-10 years of experience in IT business analysis or quality assurance required, with a minimum of 5 years in IT Management.

    • Starting Compensation: $131,940.00 - $139,734.00 annually
    • Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for ONE SCCU Annual Bonus.

    • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.

    • Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.

jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Mortgage Loan Processor in our Melbourne Headquarters, you’ll help guide approved first mortgage loans from application through closing. You’ll review loan files for completeness and accuracy, coordinate required documentation, support borrowers and business partners, and help ensure timely, compliant closings that exceed member expectations.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Hybrid and Flexible Schedule Options: Able to work from home up to 3 days a week. 2 days in office required.   
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

 Mortgage Loan Processor Key Responsibilities

  • Review and process conventional, FHA, VA, and other first mortgage loan applications for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with lending guidelines.
  • Verify borrower income, assets, employment, credit history, and funds to close; ensure approval conditions are satisfied before closing.
  • Order and review appraisals, title commitments, flood certifications, and other third-party documentation within established timelines.
  • Submit complete loan files to underwriting, follow up promptly on conditions, and manage a pipeline of approximately 20–40 loans in line with department goals.
  • Communicate clearly with borrowers, Realtors, closing agents, and internal partners regarding documentation, file status, and closing arrangements while maintaining confidentiality.
  • Resolve member questions and file issues efficiently while meeting established productivity, loan quality, regulatory, attendance, and service standards.

Mortgage Loan Processor Requirements

  • Two-year degree or equivalent experience required.
  • 3–5 years of mortgage processing, mortgage closing, or banking experience related to review and process of mortgage applications required.
    • Mortgage closing or mortgage processing experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with TRID and investor guidelines, including Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, and VA, preferred.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain active NMLS registration before performing mortgage loan originator activities, when applicable.

 Mortgage Loan Processor Compensation

jobs.title: Business Services Advisor
jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As the Business Service Advisor at our Miramar Operations Center, you will be responsible for driving business growth by identifying, developing, and expanding relationships with prospective and existing business members. This role serves as a consultative partner to members by assessing needs, recommending appropriate products and services, and delivering solutions that support member goals and business objectives. The position requires a strong sales mindset, effective business development skills, the ability to manage a pipeline of opportunities, and a high level of personal accountability for sales activity and follow-through. The role also requires strategic thinking, sound judgment, strong organizational and time-management skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in support of overall member satisfaction and revenue growth.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Hybrid & Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Business Service Advisor Responsibilities

  • Identify, develop, and maintain relationships with prospective and existing business members to support growth in business deposits, loans, and related services.
  • Understand members’ needs and recommend appropriate business products and services that align with their financial goals and operational needs.
  • Generate new business opportunities through proactive outreach, networking, relationship development, referrals, and community engagement.
  • Build, manage, and maintain a consistent sales pipeline by prospecting, conducting follow-up, tracking opportunities, and advancing relationships through the sales process.
  • Meet or exceed established sales goals, performance expectations, and key performance indicators, including production, relationship growth, activity levels, and member experience standards.
  • Prepare and deliver business development presentations, product recommendations, and proposals in a professional and member-focused manner.

Business Service Advisor Requirements

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in sales, business development, outside sales, relationship management, financial services sales, or a comparable member-facing business development role required.
  • Experience building, managing, and maintaining a sales pipeline, including prospecting, outbound outreach, follow-up, and opportunity tracking, required.
  • Experience in banking, credit union, treasury services, business lending support, merchant services, or other financial services environments preferred.
  • Experience using CRM tools to document activity, manage follow-up, maintain pipeline visibility, and support reporting preferred.
  • Must complete the Association of Accredited Small Business Consultants Simplified Examination within 60 days of employment.
  • Two-year College or University diploma (Associate’s) in Business Administration, Finance/Accounting or equivalent experience required. 
  • Valid Florida Driver’s license and good driving record required with a working vehicle.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish fluency preferred.
  • The selected candidate will be responsible for supporting the Broward and Palm Beach service territory.

Business Service Advisor Compensation

  • Starting Salary: $28.13 - $29.79/hour or $58,510 - $61,962/year plus monthly commission 
  • Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for ONE SCCU Annual Bonus.

Work Schedule

  • Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 6:00 p.m.

Detailed description

At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As the Express Service Associate at our Miramar Operations Center, you will promote SCCU’s financial products by converting incoming and outbound calls from new and existing members into closed sales by providing outstanding service, product and service information, addressing concerns and guiding members to the right fit product.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Hybrid & Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Express Service Associate Key Responsibilities

  • Handle outgoing and incoming member phone calls, conduct loan interviews, assesses member needs, and cross sells other SCCU products and services. Provide fast, friendly, effective service to the members.
  • Opens new memberships and looks for opportunities to add-on deposit products for existing members to ensure the retention and profitability of members.      
  • Analyzes loan applications, credit bureau reports and member account data to match the member to the appropriate product or service and maximize loan and add-on.
  • Enters the loan or new account application in the loan origination system in accordance with required data entry procedures to meet established quality standards. Monitors pipeline to follow up on pending applications, collects required documentation, and keeps members informed throughout the loan/account process.
  • Meets established productivity standards to ensure efficiency.
  • Participates in regular product, system, and compliance training to maintain knowledge of changes in policies, procedures, and product offerings.

Express Service Associate Requirements

  • Minimum 1 to 3 years prior experience in sales and customer service or consumer loan processing/interviewing. Telephone sales preferred. 

  • High School plus additional course work gained through attendance at vocational, technical or business school or equivalent experience.
  • This position requires federal registration with the Nationwide Multistate Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) if the Team Member performs mortgage loan originator activities, including taking residential mortgage loan applications or offering/negotiating residential mortgage loan terms. The Team Member must obtain and maintain active NMLS registration and a unique identifier before performing MLO activities. Continued eligibility to perform MLO duties is subject to satisfactory completion of applicable NMLS registration requirements, including required background check review, fingerprinting, renewal, and ongoing compliance obligations. Failure to obtain or maintain required NMLS registration may result in removal from MLO duties and may lead to further employment action, consistent with SCCU policy and applicable law.
  • You must have the ability to obtain CUNA Mutual licensing within the first eight weeks of initial employment. The CUNA Mutual License is required for this position.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish fluency required.

Express Service Associate Compensation

  • Starting Salary: $24.74 - $26.20/hour or $51,450 - $54,505/year plus monthly commission 
  • Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for ONE SCCU Annual Bonus.

Work Schedule

  • Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 7:00 p.m.
  • Rotating Saturdays: 9:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m.

SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
  • Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
  • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!

About SCCU

Since 1951, Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU) has proudly served our community, growing to over 685,000 members and managing $9 billion in assets. With 67 branches spanning Florida’s east coast, we are the third-largest credit union in the state. In 2025, we expanded into Orange County to better serve the growing East Orlando market.

As a not-for-profit financial institution, SCCU is dedicated to putting our members first. Unlike traditional banks, we return profits to our members through better rates, lower fees, and enhanced services. While we offer the same financial products—like checking, savings, and loans—our focus remains on empowering our members and supporting their financial well-being. With local decision-making and a commitment to exceptional service, we strive to make a meaningful difference in the lives of those we serve.

At SCCU, we also prioritize our team members by fostering a supportive and collaborative environment that encourages career growth and development. As we continue to grow, we are seeking talented, member-focused professionals to join our team and help deliver innovative financial solutions and outstanding service.

Upon acceptance of an offer with SCCU, I understand that I will be required to complete background screening, employment and education verifications, and drug screening. If I am a member of Space Coast Credit Union, my SCCU membership accounts will be reviewed as part of the employment screening process to determine whether they are in good standing, as defined by SCCU policy. Failure to meet these standards may affect employment eligibility, including the possible withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. I further understand that any misstatements or omissions in this application or during the pre-employment process may be considered falsification and could result in a decision not to hire me, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

I UNDERSTAND that the information requested regarding date of birth, race, and sex is for the sole purpose of gathering the above information accurately and will not be used to discriminate against me in violation of any law. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and complete the required employment eligibility verification documentation upon hire.

SCCU is a drug-free workplace. I understand that as a condition of employment, I will be required to submit to drug testing and any procedures necessary to assess my qualifications for employment. If hired, I further understand that my employment is for no definite period and may be terminated at any time without prior notice.

jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Community Engagement Associate, you will play an important role in supporting brand visibility, fostering community relationships, and executing engaging events. This position requires a creative, organized, and proactive individual who is passionate about connecting with our audience and driving brand awareness. The person in this role operates under the direction of the Community Engagement Manager and focuses on event related touchpoints with members and prospects.

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Community Engagement Associate Key Responsibilities:

  • Support to engage with our community and reach new communities both online and offline.
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute a variety of events including community events and outreach, sponsorship activations, SCCU team member volunteer opportunities, workshops and more.
  • Manage all aspects of event logistics, including venue selection, vendor negotiations, budget management, participant recruitment & communications, and onsite coordination.
  • Create comprehensive event timelines, run-of-show documents, and ensure seamless execution.
  • Work closely with marketing and design, social media, and internal communications teams to develop event collateral such as announcements, forms, invitations, signage, and promotional materials.
  • Capture event content through photos, videos, and interviews to be used in social media and a variety of promotional avenues.
  • Proactively identify, research and develop local community partnership opportunities that increase community awareness and engagement, expand event reach, meet local community needs, and support shared SCCU and organizational goals.
  • Collaborate to develop and execute components of sports sponsorship program to enhance fan experience, engagement, and awareness. 
  • Prepare post-event reports with key metrics, feedback, and actionable insights for continuous improvement.

Community Engagement Associate Requirements:

  • Associate’s Degree or equivalent experience required.

  • 1-4 years relevant experience in marketing is required.

  • A passion for building meaningful community partnerships and delivering impactful events, along with strong organizational communication, creative thinking, networking, and relationship-building skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining close attention to detail.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish skills are preferred.

Community Engagement Associate Compensation: 

  • Starting Salary: $51,450 - $54,505 annually.

jobs.title: Teller/Customer Service - West Pines Branch (Part-Time)
jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Member Service Specialist (Teller/Customer Service) in our West Pines Branch, you will deliver exceptional service by assisting members with deposits, loans, and new account processing. You will assess member needs, provide tailored recommendations for SCCU products, and resolve any issues efficiently.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.
  • Member Service Specialist positions are eligible for a promotion at 12 months.

Member Service Specialist Key Responsibilities

  • Consistently demonstrates effective sales and service skills by meeting established goals.
  • Consults with members regarding SCCU products and services and recommends additional offerings to meet member needs.
  • Periodically serves as floor manager to assess walk-in member’s needs. Directs them to the appropriate information source while ensuring maximum lobby efficiency, and minimizing member waiting time.
  • Performs all aspects of transactions, including deposits, withdrawals, payments, and the sale of monetary instruments to provide complete member service.
  • Balances cash, monetary instruments, and daily work accurately to ensure member account integrity.
  • Services existing deposit and loan accounts, assists members with transactions and account maintenance to meet and exceed their expectations.
  • Masters and effectively utilizes the computer terminal and online system, and all required commands, including general ledger fee and transaction codes, to produce error-free work.

Member Service Specialist Requirements

jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you will be responsible for protecting the credit union’s digital assets, sensitive customer information, and internal systems from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and managing security measures to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data and systems. Responsibilities and expectations will scale according to the candidate's experience level 

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Cybersecurity Engineer I Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor security systems (SIEM/Endpoint Protection (AV, EDR, Zero Day, APT), DLP, IPS/IDS, NAC and rogue device detection) for suspicious activities and anomalies.
  • Respond to security incidents, conducting root cause analysis and coordinating remediation efforts.
  • Identify, analyze, and respond to security threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Perform threat hunting and advanced detection activities to protect systems and data.
  • Lead the planning, testing, and scheduling of system patches across all endpoints, mobile devices, servers, and network infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain a patch management schedule and ensure timely application of security patches and updates.
  • Coordinate with various teams to minimize disruption and ensure compatibility of patches with organizational systems.
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing. Identify and prioritize risks, working with IT teams to remediate vulnerabilities and implement patches.
  • Design, implement, and manage security solutions, including firewalls, encryption protocols, access control systems, and data protection technologies.
  • Ensure compliance with regulations such as NCUA, PCI-DSS, and other applicable industry standards. Assist in audits, both internal and external, and provide reports and documentation as required.
  • Develop, document, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the organization’s cybersecurity posture.
  • Work closely with network, systems, and application teams to ensure security is integrated into the infrastructure. Support secure system and application development practices.
  • Assist in delivering cybersecurity training programs to staff, promoting awareness of security policies, phishing attacks, and safe computing practices.
  • Lead complex incident response efforts, coordinating with internal teams and external partners. Serve as the primary point of contact during high-impact security incidents.

Cybersecurity Engineer I Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field. Relevant certifications and experience may substitute for a degree.
  • 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity.

jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Building Engineer in our [Miramar Operations Center you will be responsible for maintaining, operating, and troubleshooting building systems.  Your role will focus on performing routine maintenance tasks, responding to service requests, and ensuring systems operate safely.  This role will focus on Servicing Branch Locations in North Broward, Palm Beach, and Indian River Counties.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

 

Building Engineer Key Responsibilities

  • Perform scheduled maintenance, repairs, and inspections of building systems; address service requests, including hot/cold calls, plumbing issues, and lighting repairs.
  • Troubleshoot minor equipment malfunctions and escalate issues as needed.
  • Replace light fixtures/bulbs, filters, and other components as required.
  • Maintain accurate records of inspections and equipment performance.
  • Interact with occupants, contractors, and facilities managers and work closely with facilities management leadership to support smooth building operations and resolve location issues.
  • Assist with preventive maintenance tasks and contractor oversight.
  • Conduct property inspections to identify deficiencies.
  • Record equipment readings and ensure assigned building systems are operating according to standards.
  • Follow company safety protocols and wear appropriate PPE; ensure compliance with OSHA, NEC, NFC, NFPA regulations; report safety hazards; participate in safety inspections.
  • Provide guidance to junior Technicians when needed.
  • Communicate verbally and in writing with teammates, leadership team, and vendors in a professional manner, keeping the appropriate customer(s) informed/updated as needed.
  • Work closely with senior management to develop technical skills and participate in professional development programs.

 

Building Engineer Requirements

  • HS Diploma or GED required
  • A valid Universal level EPA Section 608 certification is required.
  • A valid Florida driver’s license with and an acceptable driving record is required
  • Minimum of four (4) years of technical experience in all aspects of building engineering with a strong background in technical aspects of HVAC equipment and systems, plumbing, electrical, equipment repair and maintenance, and overall system design and application.
  • 3-5 years of job-related experience or commensurate certification/trade experience.

 

Job Title Compensation 

  • Starting Salary: $32.04 - $33.93 per/hour depending on experience.
  • Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for a 4% ONE SCCU Annual Bonus.

 

SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).

The Advanced Service Technician at Nextran Truck Centers is a skilled position that is responsible for repairing and maintaining our customer’s Medium & Heavy-Duty Trucks. This includes diagnosing issues, preventative maintenance, repairs, disassembly and re-assembly, and writing detailed work notes.

Essential Duties

Technical

  • Maintain proficiency in the diagnosis and repair of all assigned equipment.
  • Maintain proficiency in the rebuilding of major components on assigned equipment.
  • Ensure accurate diagnosis and the effective repair and/or replacement of components necessary for the proper functioning of assigned equipment.
  • Perform Service calls for emergency breakdowns.

Administrative

  • Interact effectively, courteously, professionally with customers, vendors, and other employees regarding vehicle repairs and other shop business.
  • Reports machinery defects or malfunctions to supervisor.
  • Communicates with parts department to obtain needed parts.
  • Saves and tags parts of the job if under warranty or if requested by the customer.
  • Examines assigned vehicle to determine if further safety or service work is required or recommended.
  • Communicates with service advisor/dispatcher immediately on repair updates and or delays.
  • Documents all work performed and recommended on the repair order.
  • Supervises work of any apprentice technicians as assigned.

Health, and Safety

  • Reports machinery defects or malfunctions to supervisor.
  • Ensures that vehicle is kept clean. Notifies service advisor/dispatcher immediately of anything that has happened to change the appearance or condition of the vehicle.
  • Maintains and is accountable for all dealership-owned tools and manuals. Returns them to the proper place and in the same condition as when they were received.
  • Understands, keeps abreast of, and complies with federal, state, and local regulations, such as hazardous waste disposal, OSHA Right-to-Know, etc. Keeps abreast of manufacturer technical bulletins.
  • Operates all tools/equipment in a safe manner and reports any safety issues immediately to management.
  • Make building and facility repairs as requested.
  • Perform other maintenance duties or assignments as requested.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Two to four years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • ASE Certification a plus
  • Cummins Engine Repair Certification a plus
  • Basic computer skills
  • High School Diploma- College or Technical training preferred, but not required
  • Valid CDL License a plus, recommended within 1 year of hiring.

Nextran Core Hiring Competencies

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

We will never ask candidates to provide payment, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information (such as bank account details or Social Security numbers) during the initial application or interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent our company, please do not respond or provide any information. Instead, report the communication to us through our official website or apply directly through our verified job postings.

Your safety and privacy are important to us, and we encourage all applicants to remain vigilant when searching for employment opportunities.

  • Diagnose the cause of the malfunctions and perform repairs.
  • Communicates with the parts department to obtain needed parts.

  • Operates all tools/equipment in a safe manner and reports any safety issues immediately to management.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Three plus years of diesel mechanic experience.
  • ASE or Cummins Engine Repair Certificate is a plus.
  • English proficiency is essential for understanding safety protocols, customer interactions, and internal communications.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Valid CDL License a plus, recommended within 1 year of hiring.

Mathematical Skills:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, percentage, draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability:

Ability to solve problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations with only limited resources.Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:

  • Regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.
  • Use of torque wrenches, air powered tools or hand tools.
  • Use of arms in a raised position above shoulder level for prolong periods of time. Use of creeper or rolling device to enable tech to work underneath vehicle.
  • The employee frequently is required to walk; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear.
  • The employee is required to stand and sit for extended periods of time (hours) while making repairs.
  • Entry or exit from the cab of the vehicle.
  • Climb to a safe position to access the engine compartment area, firewall or roof of a vehicle to perform repairs.
  • The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move more than 100 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Ability to push/pull large tool chest from vehicle to vehicle.

Nextran Core Hiring Competencies:

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

Summary

The Service Technician at Nextran Truck Centers is a skilled position that is responsible for repairing and maintaining our customer’s Medium & Heavy-Duty Trucks. This includes preventative maintenance, repairs, disassembly and reassembly, and writing detailed work notes.

Essential Duties

  • Performs work as outlined on repair order with efficiency and accuracy, in accordance with dealership and factory standards.

  • Communicates with the parts department to obtain needed parts.

  • Saves and tags parts of the job if under warranty or if requested by the customer.

  • Documents all work performed and recommended on the repair order.

  • Reports machinery defects or malfunctions to the supervisor.

  • Ensures that the vehicle is kept clean. Notifies service advisor/dispatcher immediately of anything that has happened to change the appearance or condition of the vehicle.

  • Maintains and is accountable for all dealership-owned tools and manuals. Return them to the proper place and in the same condition as when they were received.

  • Understands, keeps abreast of, and complies with federal, state, and local regulations, such as hazardous waste disposal, OSHA Right-to-Know, etc. Keeps abreast of manufacturer technical bulletins.

  • Operates all tools/equipment in a safe manner and reports any safety issues immediately to management.

Skills and Qualifications

  • High School Diploma

  • Basic computer skills

  • Up to Two years related experience and/or training as a Technician.

  • Valid CDL License a plus, recommended within 1 year of hiring.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability

Ability to solve problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations with only limited resources. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.

  • Use of torque wrenches, air powered tools or hand tools.

  • Use of arms in a raised position above shoulder level for prolong periods of time. Use of creeper or rolling device to enable tech to work underneath vehicle.

  • The employee frequently is required to walk; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear.

  • The employee is required to stand and sit for extended periods of time (hours) while making repairs.

  • Entry or exit from the cab of the vehicle.

  • Climb to a safe position to access the engine compartment area, firewall or roof of a vehicle to perform repairs.

  • The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move more than 100 pounds.

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

  • Ability to push/pull large tool chest from vehicle to vehicle.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

Essential duties and related qualifications may be changed as needed to meet the changing demands of the organization. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Nextran Truck Centers is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and a Drug Free Workplace.

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

We are aware that fraudulent job postings and recruitment scams are becoming more common. Please be advised that legitimate communications from our company will only come from official company email addresses and through our verified hiring platforms.

We will never ask candidates to provide payment, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information (such as bank account details or Social Security numbers) during the initial application or interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent our company, please do not respond or provide any information. Instead, report the communication to us through our official website or apply directly through our verified job postings.

Nextran Truck Centers Mobile Diesel Mechanic - Orlando, Florida

Join a team that brings the shop to the customer. Are you an experienced diesel technician looking for something different? Do you enjoy building relationships, solving problems, and working directly with customers rather than spending every day in the same service bay?

Nextran Truck Centers is hiring! Our Employees Benefit from:

Career Paths || Network of 30 Dealerships || Disability Insurance || Paid Time Off (2wks 1st year) || Nextran Paid Life Insurance

Family Centered Values || Medical and Dependent Care FSA || 401(k) Retirement Plan with Match || Company-Paid Holidays || EAP

Great Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits || Social Responsibility Opportunities || 28+ Years of Industry Experience || Professional Growth

Summary

As a Mobile Diesel Technician, you will serve as a concierge-style field technician supporting customer fleets on-site. You become an extension of both our dealership and our customers’ operation. Every day brings new challenges and opportunities as you work closely with fleet managers, drivers, and maintenance personnel to keep equipment operating safely and efficiently.

This is not a traditional roadside emergency repair position. Instead, you will serve as a trusted technical resource for our fleet customers, delivering planned maintenance, inspections, upgrades, and repair solutions directly at their locations.

We believe our technicians are among our most valuable assets. In this role, you will not simply repair equipment, you will build lasting relationships with customers and help develop solutions that support their business. You will work directly on customer property, in their maintenance facilities, and in the field, serving as a trusted advisor and representative of our organization.

Essential Duties:

  • Scheduled preventive maintenance services
  • Factory warranty campaigns and recalls
  • Fleet-wide upgrades and retrofits
  • DOT inspections and certifications
  • Windshield replacements
  • Valve adjustments and engine services
  • Diagnostic troubleshooting and repairs
  • Customer consultations and maintenance planning
  • Coordinating transportation of equipment to our dealership service center when major repairs are required.

What We’re Looking For

  • Heavy-duty diesel repair experience
  • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent communication and customer service abilities
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Professional appearance and positive attitude
  • Commitment to safety and quality workmanship
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and customer needs

Schedule & Pay

This position offers a dynamic work environment with variety and flexibility. Schedules may vary based on customer needs and business demands. We are committed to supporting our team members by providing flexibility whenever possible while ensuring exceptional service for our customers.

Compensation:
Hourly Flat Rate, based on experience and qualifications.

What We Offer

  • Competitive starting pay
  • Performance-based wage growth opportunities
  • Additional compensation opportunities tied to industry certifications
  • Company-provided service truck stocked with tools and inventory
  • Potential authorization to take company vehicle home based on performance and business needs
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Supportive team environment
  • Opportunity to build meaningful customer relationships and make a direct impact

Why Join Us?

If you’re looking for a career where your skills, work ethic, professionalism, and positive attitude are genuinely appreciated, you’ve come to the right place. Join a team that values expertise, invests in its people, and empowers technicians to make a difference every day.

Nextran Core Hiring Competencies:

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

Notice Regarding Job Posting Scams

We are aware that fraudulent job postings and recruitment scams are becoming more common. Please be advised that legitimate communications from our company will only come from official company email addresses and through our verified hiring platforms.

We will never ask candidates to provide payment, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information (such as bank account details or Social Security numbers) during the initial application or interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent our company, please do not respond or provide any information. Instead, report the communication to us through our official website or apply directly through our verified job postings.

Your safety and privacy are important to us, and we encourage all applicants to remain vigilant when searching for employment opportunities.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description_html:
Nextran Truck Centers Talent Acquisition Partner - Central Florida Region

Nextran Truck Centers is seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner to help build the workforce that will support our continued growth. Based at our Orlando Florida dealership, this position will initially support talent acquisition efforts across the Central Florida Region, and will report to the corporate Vice President of Human Resources.

This Talent Acquisition Partner goes beyond filling open positions. This individual will work closely with dealership and HR leadership to understand current and future talent needs, build sustainable candidate pipelines, strengthen bench strength, and improve hiring and retention outcomes.

As a new role within Nextran, this position offers the opportunity to help shape and expand our talent acquisition strategy across the organization.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with dealership leaders to identify current and future hiring needs and gaps in bench strength.
  • Develop short- and long-term recruiting strategies that support both external hiring and internal talent development.
  • Source, recruit, screen, and help select qualified candidates for skilled trade, operational, sales, leadership, and other dealership positions.
  • Build proactive candidate pipelines for critical and difficult-to-fill roles.
  • Manage the recruiting and hiring process in partnership with Hiring Managers and local HR.
  • Help leaders improve interviewing, candidate assessment, and selection practices.
  • Support the identification and development of high-potential employees for future opportunities.
  • Partner with management on effective onboarding and training plans for new hires and monitor early retention.
  • Develop relationships with technical schools, industry organizations, professional associations, and other talent sources.
  • Leverage recruiting technology, social media, career fairs, marketing, and other creative sourcing strategies.
  • Monitor the competitive talent market and recommend ways for Nextran to remain competitive in attracting and retaining employees.
  • Use recruiting data and analytics to track results, including time-to-fill, source of hire, hiring volume, 90-day retention, and bench strength progress.
  • Partner with dealership leadership, HR Business Partners, and Corporate HR on employee engagement and retention opportunities.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 4 years of Human Resources and/or talent acquisition experience, preferably within a decentralized or multi-location organization.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting and hiring high-quality talent.
  • Experience recruiting skilled trades, technicians, transportation, logistics, supply chain, or other difficult-to-fill operational roles strongly preferred.
  • Strong sourcing, networking, and candidate pipeline development skills.
  • Ability to build credibility and influence leaders across multiple functions.
  • Proactive, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of urgency.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Experience with an ATS and HRIS; ClearCompany and UKG experience is a plus.
  • Staffing agency experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree and SHRM-CP, PHR, or similar certification preferred.
  • Fluency in Spanish is a plus

Why Nextran?

Nextran Truck Centers is a network of 30+ medium and heavy-duty truck dealerships committed to providing the best products and services through highly skilled employees who are focused on delivering the lowest life-cycle cost. Above all, we are dedicated to keeping our customers moving.

This role provides the opportunity to move beyond transactional recruiting and have a direct impact on Nextran's long-term talent strategy. You will help build stronger talent pipelines, develop internal bench strength, expand industry partnerships, and influence how we attract and retain great people.

If you enjoy learning the business, building relationships, finding great talent, and creating sustainable recruiting strategies, we'd like to hear from you.

Nextran Core Hiring Competencies:

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

Join Nextran and help us build the talent that will drive our future.

Notice Regarding Job Posting Scams

We are aware that fraudulent job postings and recruitment scams are becoming more common. Please be advised that legitimate communications from our company will only come from official company email addresses and through our verified hiring platforms.

We will never ask candidates to provide payment, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information (such as bank account details or Social Security numbers) during the initial application or interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent our company, please do not respond or provide any information. Instead, report the communication to us through our official website or apply directly through our verified job postings.

Your safety and privacy are important to us, and we encourage all applicants to remain vigilant when searching for employment opportunities.

EEO Employer

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Job Title: Accounts Payable Specialist

Classification: Hourly/Non-Exempt

Reports to: Controller

Department: Accounting

Introduction:

  • The role of the Accounts Payable Specialist is to collect, report, and process all Vendor invoices and pay applications from subcontractors. He/she is to assure accountability, accuracy, and confidentiality of any and all payables related information and to track pay applications, invoices, purchase order receivers and unvouchered liabilities.

Functional Role:

  • The basic function of this position is to manage the smooth flow of Accounts Payable information of the company. To track all invoices and pay applications received and match all purchase order receivers to the appropriate invoices. They are also responsible for coordinating the approval of all subcontractors pay applications with the appropriate Project Manager and to ensure pay applications are posted to accounts payable in the accounting period that they apply to.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for maintaining Insurance certificates for subcontractors ensuring all insurance requirements are at the minimum amounts required by the subcontract and are current with respect to policy expiration dates.
  • Responsible for accurate accounting records of the Company’s Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Maintain the close security of company Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Maintain the confidentiality of company Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Keep management apprised of the collection status of past due accounts and lien position within the time requirements that protect all lien rights.
  • Ensure the Accounts Payable documents are processed in a timely and error-free manner.

Requirements:

  • Education: High School diploma with courses in accounting.
  • Experience: Two to five year’s experience in Accounts Payable and AIA Schedule of Values.
  • MUST have lien law knowledge and experience.
  • Skills, knowledge, and abilities - Ability to work independently and to work well with others in a multi-functional fast paced environment. Good comprehension of Accounts Payables, Subcontractor and spreadsheet software, excellent reading, writing and verbal skills. Must understand AIA Schedule Of Values.
  • Reasoning Ability – Ability to apply principles of logical thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems, ability to deal with a variety of abstract and concrete variables, ability to manage a variety of activities simultaneously.
  • Language Skills – Ability to communicate and give answers in a clear and precise style, ability to compose standard letters with proper format, grammar, punctuation, and spelling, using all parts of speech, ability to speak with poise, voice control, and confidence, using correct English with a well modulated voice.
  • Physical – While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to talk on the phone and use a computer.
  • Work Environment - The work is normally performed in a standard office environment with usually quiet to moderate noise levels.

DFWP/EOE

jobs.title: Commercial Service Technician
jobs.description_html:
Responsibilities:

  • Present a positive image to customers, co-workers, and others at all times
  • Follow all service department and company policies and procedures
  • Adhere to all company safety policies
  • Attend training to improve HVAC industry knowledge
  • Perform preventative maintenance; identify potential issues (e.g., contactors, relay coils, over-amping devices, loads, transformers, motors)
  • Perform electrical troubleshooting; able to read various wiring diagrams (ladder, schematic, parallel, series circuits)
  • Understand all phases of line voltage (single phase, three phase, part start windings, two-speed motors, variable frequency drives)
  • Understand general fan laws: RPM, speed, how pulley or sheave changes and belt sizing affect amperage draw
  • Calculate CFM using heat rise or static pressure method
  • Understand piping systems: refrigerant, water, gas, condensate, pumps, valves (single/two-pipe systems, bypass circuits, modulating valves, circuit setters)
  • Understand water source equipment: water-cooled condensers, chillers, cooling towers, fluid coolers, basic water treatment knowledge
  • Calculate wire sizes, fuses, and circuit breakers for both low and line voltage loads
  • Install and program common DDC controls (e.g., Carrier, Trane)
  • Understand operation differences between VAV and VVT boxes
  • Identify and work with all types of thermostats: low/line voltage, standard, programmable, digital, and time clocks
  • Perform leak detection for water and refrigerant systems
  • Possess knowledge of semi-hermetic compressors (change unloaders, valves, valve plates, internal bypass plugs; diagnose mechanical and electrical failures)
  • Understand relationships between temperature, pressure, humidity, and their effects on indoor air comfort and quality
  • Understand the purpose and process of test and balance for building performance, pressure control, and comfort
  • Diagnose and repair all types of heating and cooling issues as required
  • Possess all necessary tools to complete tasks listed in the job description

Qualification:

  • Physical activities include standing, balancing, climbing stairs and ladders
  • Must be able to walk and lift 20 pounds or more as part of daily job duties
  • Requires use of upper extremities for forward and overhead reaching, pushing, pulling, and material handling
  • Requires use of torso and lower extremities for kneeling, crawling, stooping, twisting, and squatting

jobs.title: Groundsman
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to assist with electric line maintenance or installation.  The class is responsible for loading and delivering materials, traffic control, setting up equipment, technical or manual support tasks, and logs or routine reports.  The class works according to some procedures; decides how and when to do things under general supervision.  This is a progressive classification leading to an Electric Line Technician Apprentice classification which is required to move forward when a position opens.  

Essential Job Functions

  • Prepares vehicles by inspecting and performing minor service; reports malfunctions to supervisor.
  • Gathers and loads job materials, tools, or other supplies and delivers to job site.
  • Maintains traffic control and insures vehicle and pedestrian safety procedures are observed.
  • Sets up equipment such as trucks, outriggers, trailers or other equipment.
  • Operates line maintenance or installation equipment as directed.
  • Performs support tasks such as stripping wire, digging, moving equipment, and other.
  • Completes work logs or routine reports and performs minor office work.
  • Complete a pole climbing school or program.

Minimum Requirements

Requires a high school diploma or GED. 

Knowledge of basic algebra. 

Experience associated with a Lineman Boot Camp is preferred. 

This position is an entry level position and the employee will receive on the job training. Being an entry level position, the person accepting this position or holding this position understands that he/she will be eligible for promotion and understands that promoting into an Electric Line Technician Apprentice position is a condition of employment as positions become available.

Requires a valid State of Florida Class A temporary permit for CDL upon hire and a satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. At the end of the six (6) months’ probation period, employee must take and pass the exam required for possession of a Florida Class A CDL. 

Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

Must be comfortable with working from heights; poles, structures and aerial lifts. 

Must be available for on call status/assignments. Must live within 20-mile radius of the City Limits of Leesburg.

jobs.title: Heavy Equipment Operator WW
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to operate mobile equipment and perform skilled work in support of City maintenance operations. The class is responsible for operating light to heavy mobile equipment, minor equipment maintenance, assisting and supporting City facility and area maintenance, and minor administrative tasks. The class works according to some procedures, but decides how and when to do things under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Operates mobile equipment to transport materials, tools, equipment, and personnel to job sites and to remove debris or other materials from job sites in support of plant operations, maintenance and/or repair of infrastructure.
  • Operates specialized mobile equipment to support City operations such as utilities construction and repair, concrete laying, and other specialized operations.
  • Monitors truck, tractors, tools and equipment and ensures for the proper operation of equipment used. Reports major malfunction to supervisor and services equipment to ensure proper operation.
  • Operates hand and power tools and equipment to support maintenance operations such as weed cutting, debris removal, grass cutting, digging or filling, portable pumps and other maintenance tasks.
  • Inspects equipment and performs minor maintenance; reports malfunctions to supervisor.
  • Troubleshoots and repairs the sprayfield infrastructure and associated facilities.
  •  Reads and interprets plans and drawings and uses this information to perform job tasks.
  • Performs minor administrative tasks such as completing job-related logs and forms, answering phones, or providing information.
  • Performs simple clerical tasks. Maintain hauling manifests.
  • Performs assigned duties as needed and requested.

Minimum Requirements

High School Diploma or GED.

Must be able to run various equipment with minimal instruction

Requires a valid State of Florida Driver’s License and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment.

Must obtain a Class A CDL permit within 3 months of hire. Must obtain a Class A CDL license with tanker endorsement within 6 months of hire.

Special skills or additional equipment certification may be required.
