jobs.title: Commercial Lines Pricing Actuary - Hybrid
jobs.description_html:
New Jersey Manufacturers Insurance Company (NJM) was founded in 1913 by a group of manufacturers seeking to provide cost-effective, safety conscious and financially secure workers' compensation insurance for their workers. From inception the Company has operated as a mutual, with a focus on the needs of its policyholders.


Today, NJM Insurance Group, is a leading mid-sized U.S. property and casualty insurance company with 90 consecutive years of A+ financial strength ratings by AM BEST. Due to exceptional employee experience, NJM has been included on the latest Forbes List of Best Employers in New Jersey for the fourth year in a row. The NJM reputation for being a top provider of outstanding customer service was reaffirmed by the most recent J.D. Power Auto Insurance Claims Survey.


Over the last five years, the Company has focused on a strategic plan that calls for it to become a regional property & casualty insurer and has transitioned away from its affinity-based membership model. To that end, the Company has added an independent agency model for new lines of middle and large commercial and has more than doubled its product offerings. NJM now offers its various products to businesses across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Delaware, and Connecticut.

NJM’s Commercial Lines department conducts business for policyholders and preferred agencies within the Mid-Atlantic region, specifically NJ, PA, NY, MD, DE, CT. Products include Commercial Auto, G/L, Workers Comp, BOP, Excess/Umbrella, and Package. The Commercial Lines function encompasses Underwriting, Sales, Operations, Premium Audit, Product Management, Product Development, Loss Prevention and Business Process Unit.

The Actuary (this role can be filled at the level, I, II , Senior or Associate level) will support NJM’s efforts to attract new policyholders, retain existing policyholders, and honor our commitment to pay claims by developing fair and competitive pricing, providing comprehensive product analysis, and ensuring that NJM maintains a strong financial position.

This role is hybrid working 3 days in the West Trenton, NJ office and 2 days from home.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Perform pricing studies to evaluate the profitability of our Auto, Workers’ Compensation, and Commercial Package insurance products. 

  • Analyze rating variables based on company data and competitor information and recommend changes.

  • Perform analysis of frequency, severity, and premium trends.

  • Perform analysis of loss and LAE reserves.

  • Assist with the annual loss and LAE ratio planning process.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop business insights and recommendations. 

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of actuarial tools and processes to enhance the department’s capabilities over time.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, or related field.

  • Property and casualty actuarial experience. 

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with SQL, SAS, or other programming languages a plus.  

  • ACAS or FCAS credential.

This role can be filled at the Analyst, Associate or Senior level and the salary is commensurate based on experience.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

NJM reserves the right at any time to amend, add or delete any aspect of the job description for this position based on business needs.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $116,749-$147,145

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Workforce Supervisor, Stock Services
jobs.description_html:
The Stock Services Workforce Supervisor oversees the daily operations of the Stock Services department, including receiving, inventory control, stock distribution, courier functions, fleet-vehicle support, and mail transport activities.  This position provides direct supervision and guidance to the Stock Services Courier/Driver-Stock Clerk staff, insuring accurate inventory management, timely deliveries across the NJM campus, safe driving practices and high-level customer service.  The Stock Services Workforce Supervisor ensures compliance with company policies, safety requirements, and departmental standards while driving operational efficiency and continuous improvement.

SCHEDULE: Monday – Friday, 8:00 am to 4:15 pm

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

Supervisor Responsibilities

  • Provide daily supervision, scheduling, and task assignments for Stock Services staff.
  • Oversee performance, provide coaching, conduct evaluations and support professional development.
  • Ensure team compliance with inventory procedures, safety protocols, and customer service standards.
  • Lead and participate in hiring, onboarding, and training of new employees.
  • Monitor workload, prioritize department activities, and resolve operational issues promptly.
  • Maintain a positive, collaborative team environment and address performance or conduct issues as needed.

​Operational Oversight & Inventory Management

  • Supervise all receiving operations to ensure accurate inspection, counting, and documentation of deliveries.
  • Ensure that inventory items are properly transferred, stored, and tracked within the physical and system-based inventory locations.
  • Ensure stockroom inventory controls are in place and adhered to.
  • Communicate the delivery of stocked items with appropriate vendors to ensure adequate inventory levels.
  • Investigate vendor discrepancies, delivery issues, and product variances; communicate finding to appropriate departments.
  • Oversee timely fulfillment and delivery of stock orders to internal requestors while upholding customer service expectations.
  • Monitor and audit inventory management software (Workday) activity, including requisition approvals, receiving entries, serialized item logging, cycle counts, adjustments and required reporting.
  • Ensure safe and compliant operation of manual and electric pallet jacks and other equipment.
  • Support the development and maintenance of organized, efficient, and compliant stockroom areas.

Courier, Driver & Fleet Oversight

  • Oversee the daily courier/driver operations performed by staff, ensuring punctual and safe transport of cargo and/or passengers.
  • Ensure all vehicle loading, unloading, and delivery activities meet safety and company standards.

Departmental Support & Additional Duties

  • Develop and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and service delivery.
  • Generate and review departmental activity reports, inventory reports, and metrics as required.
  • Serve as the operational point of contact for internal departments requiring Stock Services support.
  • Function as a backup to Stock Services staff completing their assigned tasks as needed.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • 1-2 years of experience in a supervisory or leadership role.
  • 2-4 years of experience in inventory, warehouse, stock, or related operations.
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to prioritize, adjust to changing demands, and manage multiple tasks.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, perform repetitive movements, and stand or sit for long periods of time.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to maintain requirements for company fleet driving.
  • Ability to access all federal/government buildings.
  • Proficient with MS Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supervising stockroom, warehouse, inventory, or courier operations.
  • Prior inventory management system experience.
  • Knowledge of Workday Financials a plus.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $58,737-$74,031

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Hybrid
jobs.description_html:
New Jersey Manufacturers Insurance Company (NJM) was founded in 1913 by a group of manufacturers seeking to provide cost-effective, safety conscious and financially secure workers' compensation insurance for their workers. From inception the Company has operated as a mutual, with a focus on the needs of its policyholders.


Today, NJM Insurance Group, is a leading mid-sized U.S. property and casualty insurance company with 90 consecutive years of A+ financial strength ratings by AM BEST. Due to exceptional employee experience, NJM has been included on the latest Forbes List of Best Employers in New Jersey for the fourth year in a row. The NJM reputation for being a top provider of outstanding customer service was reaffirmed by the most recent J.D. Power Auto Insurance Claims Survey.


Over the last five years, the Company has focused on a strategic plan that calls for it to become a regional property & casualty insurer and has transitioned away from its affinity-based membership model. To that end, the Company has added an independent agency model for new lines of middle and large commercial and has more than doubled its product offerings. NJM now offers its various products to businesses across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Delaware, and Connecticut.

The purpose of the Project Management Team is to serve as a strong advocate and partner within NJM dedicated to driving the facilitation, planning and successful execution of approved business initiatives so that NJM can achieve its annual objectives, strategic goals and long-term vision. 

The Project Manager is responsible for managing one or more projects from startup through closeout and ensuring customer satisfaction. Project Managers need to be very comfortable around technology, be inquisitive, have a problem-solving mindset, and be willing to adapt approach to successfully execute projects.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Manage one or more independent projects from startup to closeout with some input from senior PMO members.
  • Demonstrate accountability with guidance from senior project managers or portfolio managers towards project implementations and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Demonstrate understanding and proficiency of Agile project management techniques and processes.  
  • Hold self and project team members accountable to deliverables and commitments.
  • Demonstrate awareness of project metrics and using metrics towards project discussions.
  • Work with Portfolio leadership to deal with dynamic situations and ambiguity.
  • Demonstrate the ability to adapt and perform in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.
  • Collaborate with Technical Leads for Release and Sprint Planning, brainstorming, etc.
  • Demonstrate an analytical mindset and be comfortable working with data.
  • Take charge of situations, challenges, and leading the team towards resolution with guidance from senior project managers or portfolio managers.
  • Provide direction and day-to-day management of project teams.
  • Communicate transparently through status reporting and managing expectations of senior PMO leaders.
  • Understand project objectives and ensuring team member commitment towards achieving those objectives.
  • Engage in discussions with team members  to propose alternative solutions/approaches to address challenges.
  • Identifying challenges and risks (not just reporting status) and proactively seek resolution through support from PMO leadership.
  • Demonstrate awareness of various risk management strategies.
  • Prepare presentations regarding projects and their statuses to small audiences.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Minimum 4-year degree or equivalent experience; technical or business background preferred.
  • Minimum 5-year work experience in a team setting; willingness to continue working in a team setting.
  • Basic understanding of tooling such as Jira, Planview, etc. Very proficient in MS Office (Excel, MS Word) and essential to be able to learn and utilize tooling.
  • Excellent and effective verbal and written communication skills (verbal, written, presentation) and facilitation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Scaled Agile or Scrum Master experience / certifications preferred Experience with Project budget management preferred.
  • Experience and understanding of P&C insurance a big plus.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

NJM reserves the right at any time to amend, add or delete any aspect of the job description for this position based on business needs.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $104,686-$131,986

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Senior IVR & Contact Center Engineer (NICE CXone / Genesys)
jobs.description_html:
The Sr. Telecom Apps Software Engineer (official NJM job title) will have extensive knowledge of the NICE CX1 platform and is responsible for the design and development of voice/email/chat solutions on the NICE suite of applications used by contact center staff.  The person in this role will be the technical lead for IT and will be expected to translate software requirements into working solutions within the existing IVR application framework. The person serving this role will also be responsible for monitoring and troubleshooting systems for optimal performance.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Customer support and troubleshooting
    • Perform analysis and resolve telecom related issues and service requests in a timely manner.
    • Assist immediate team members, extended IT team members and vendors to resolve complex and cross product issues.
    • Interact with vendor support and provide adequate communication about problem resolution.
    • Proactively monitor systems and take corrective action when required.
    • Document process and procedures according to established IT standards.
    • On a periodic frequency, insure that all supporting telecom systems are adequately patched with the appropriate application and security related updates.
    • Have a thorough understanding of NICE CX1 and related technologies.
       
  • Subject matter expert on IVR development
    • Design and develop IVR voice, chat and email solutions leveraging API’s to communicate to backend systems on the CX1 platform.
    • Act as the liaison for the business unit and IT.
    • Support the various IT system integrations to the telecom architecture.
    • Identify and correlate business requirements to software configurations solutions within the telecom applications.
    • Influence technical staff in the design and operation of telecom systems.
    • Serve as the point of contact for issue resolution and problem analysis.
    • Coordinate and run testing efforts to validate application functionality upon deployment of a fix and or platform upgrades.
       
  • Quality and documentation
    • Insure that team and individual deliverables are of high quality.
    • Service requests are resolved to end user satisfaction with minimal rework.
    • Effectively use available tools to diagnose and remedy user reported issues.
    • Create and document procedures adhering to established IT processes.
    • Maintain library of documentation to be used as a reference by immediate team members.
       
  • Continuous improvement
    • Maintain and improve technical proficiency through continuous learning of telecom products, supporting hardware and software environments.
    • Actively seeks to learn from senior team members as appropriate.
    • Serve as a mentor to junior team members.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of related information technology experience.
  • 5+ years of supporting telecom applications.
  • 5+ years of programming experience.
  • 3+ years of supporting Linux based application.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (computer science, engineering) or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of telecom system architecture to support a contact center environment on NICE CX1 platform.
  • Working knowledge of database design and operation, web technologies.
  • Proficiency and experience with certain operating systems (Windows, Linux)

Certifications or Licenses:

  • NICE Certified System Administrator (preferred but not required)

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $91,021-$114,806

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: JAVA Developer (Hybrid)
jobs.description_html:
This role will be responsible for developing, configuring and customizing business applications under the guidance of the team lead or a senior JAVA developer. The JAVA Developer will work in a highly collaborative environment as part on an agile delivery team.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Code, configure, develop, and debug functionality in core systems in accordance with architectural guidelines and defined best practices under the guidance of a senior developer, this includes: screens, data model, batches.
  • Plan, initiate, and conduct unit and integration testing of applications.
  • Provide accurate and reliable estimates.
  • Consistently deliver work on time and of high quality.
  • Understand and work from business requirements documentation (user stories, use cases, as well as traditional software requirements specifications).
  • As a part of an agile project team, share technical and product knowledge with other team members.
  • Support and troubleshoot production deployments
  • Seek mentoring from senior team members as necessary

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of software development experience with object-oriented technologies
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field required.
  • Some knowledge of object-oriented design patterns, software architecture concepts, and web application constructs.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming languages and object-oriented architectures.
  • Some understanding of relational database technologies and experience writing SQL queries.
  • Possesses good written, oral communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to learn how to support production systems
  • Experience working with integrations such as web services or messaging is a plus.
  • Experience working as part of a high pace agile development team is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Guidewire technologies; PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, or ClaimCenter; required.
  • Knowledge and experience of the Guidewire object model.
  • Experience with both configuration as well as integration within the Guidewire architecture.
  • GOSU development skills.
  • Knowledge and experience with Guidewire typelists, rule sets, plugins, activities and messaging framework.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL server
  • Certification or Licenses
  • Comparable object-oriented technology certification a plus.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. jobs.title: Sr. Loss Prevention Representative - Industrial Hygiene
jobs.description_html:
NJM Insurance Group, is a leading mid-sized U.S. property and casualty insurance company with 90 consecutive years of A+ financial strength ratings by AM BEST. Due to exceptional employee experience, NJM has been included on the latest Forbes List of Best Employers in New Jersey for the fourth year in a row. The NJM reputation for being a top provider of outstanding customer service was reaffirmed by the most recent J.D. Power Auto Insurance Claims Survey.


NJM has focused on a strategic plan that calls for it to become a regional property & casualty insurer and has transitioned away from its affinity-based membership model. To that end, the Company has added an independent agency model for new lines of middle and large commercial and has more than doubled its product offerings. NJM now offers its various products to businesses across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Delaware, and Connecticut.

NJM’s Commercial Lines department conducts business for policyholders and preferred agencies within the Mid-Atlantic region, specifically NJ, PA, NY, MD, DE, CT. Products include Commercial Auto, G/L, Workers Comp, BOP, Excess/Umbrella, and Package. The Commercial Lines function encompasses Underwriting, Sales, Operations, Premium Audit, Product Management, Product Development, Loss Prevention and Business Process Unit.

The Commercial Lines Loss Prevention team is searching for a Senior Loss Prevention Representative. The goal of the Sr. Loss Prevention Representative is to assist our policyholders in the process of identifying, quantifying, eliminating, or reducing the risk of loss.  This is a senior level position that will entail training and mentoring of staff.

** This position does not provide a company vehicle but NJM does reimburse for mileage and tolls.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Conduct on-site loss control surveys and underwriting evaluations to assess potential hazards for our policyholders and agency partners

  • Conduct accident investigations

  • Prepares loss control reports and sends recommendations to policyholders to help them improve potential risk factors

  • A knowledge of workplace safety

  • An understanding of nationally recognized standards and codes

  • Develop, enhance and present training programs in the area of loss prevention

  • Communicate loss prevention services available to policyholders and agency partners

  • Will be responsible for mentoring loss prevention representatives in the department

  • May act on behalf of the loss prevention supervisor in their absence

  • May train other loss prevention representatives on conducting site evaluations, training, or other loss control services

Required Qualifications and Experience: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • 6+ years of experience in loss control including Industrial Hygiene

  • Air sampling and noise monitoring experience

  • High School Diploma/GED Required

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills

  • Ability to work in a team environment or independently

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task and be detail-oriented

  • Excellent analytical and decision making skills

  • Experience with laptop computers as well as Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook

  • Safety experience is required 

  • Loss Control and Safety Experience in the Insurance Industry (Workers’ Comp, Commercial Auto, Property and/or General Liability)

  • This position is the field and requires regular travel throughout the Central NJ area.

Preferred Qualifications:                                                                          

  • Bachelor's Degree is preferred

  • Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH)

  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP) preferred

  • OHST (Occupational Health and Safety) Certification Preferred

  • ARM (Associate in Risk Management) preferred

  • ASC (Advanced Safety Certification)

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $121,807-$141,453

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Manager, PL Product Development
jobs.description_html:
The Product Development Manager is responsible for supporting the design, enhancement, and ongoing management of NJM’s personal auto, homeowners, and umbrella products across the company’s operating footprint. This newly created position is accountable for evaluating product performance, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to improve product competitiveness and profitability. The role is also responsible for conducting research, developing recommendations, and collaborating with actuarial, underwriting, claims, compliance, IT, and other business areas to implement product changes and strategic initiatives. In addition, the position ensures alignment with regulatory requirements and organizational objectives, contributing to product strategy and supporting NJM’s growth and performance goals.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

Lead the creation & recommendation of new & existing product enhancements for assigned lines of business. Develop short & long-term project roadmaps for each product assigned. Work with key stakeholders to ensure alignment of product goals & objectives. Present recommendation for approval to senior leadership, up to and potentially including the Executive Leadership Team.

Proactively identify, evaluate, and recommend new product opportunities for assigned lines of business. Conduct comprehensive competitor research and other market solutions. Apply the analytical rigor model to determine best solution to successfully solve consumer pain points.

Oversee the successful execution of assigned product enhancements. Work closely with the SOG and PMO teams ensuring a timely implementation. Collaborate and provide support & guidance across Personal Lines in communicating changes to policyholders and staff.

Hours:
Monday through Friday, day shift

Compensation:
The salary is commensurate with experience and credentials but is likely to fall in the $175,000 - $215,000 range. This full time position is based in our suburban West Trenton, New Jersey corporate office, which is easily commutable from central and southern New Jersey as well as Bucks and Philadelphia Counties in Pennsylvania.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Minimum 4‑year college degree or equivalent
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in insurance product development, product management, actuarial, or analytics, with increasing responsibilities
  • Strong analytical abilities and natural curiosity for solving complex business challenges
  • Advanced Excel and database skills; proficiency with MS Office suite
  • Commitment to continuous learning, including product best practices and emerging technologies
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization

Preferred Qualifications:

  • College degree in Business, Data Analytics, Economics, Insurance, or related field

jobs.title: Workers Compensation Claims Specialist, Sr
jobs.description_html:
NJM’s WC Claims Department is seeking an experienced Claims Specialist, Sr. who lives in Western or Central PA to provide on-site service to our policyholders and agents in that area.  This is a 100% remote position which includes virtual claims handling for customers in any area of PA and possibly MD, DE or CT as needed.  

At NJM, our WC Claims Department empowers our employees to focus on delivering guidance and empathy to our customers.  As a department driven by service and customer advocacy, we are committed to providing transparent, empathetic support and collaborative engagement during the life of a claim. The WC Claims Department takes pride in being a key component in the growth and success of our policyholders’ business operations.

To meet these expectations, WC Claims Specialists are supported by a dedicated call center who can field calls for them and other specialized units who are responsible for setting reserves, making permanency payments, and following through on subrogation so they can dedicate the time needed to manage claims. Many of our staff are long-tenured with a focus on building relationships, not only with our customers, but with each other providing a positive and nurturing work environment.

Hours:

Monday to Friday 8:00AM- 4:15PM (Hours can vary depending on start time).

Training is required at the NJM- West Trenton office.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure quality management of claims in accordance with claims best practices and company guidelines, and timely, accurate documentation of claim activity

  • Provide a high level of customer service that promotes injured worker advocacy-based principles to improve outcomes for all parties 

  • Determine compensability and coverage issues by gathering medical and factual evidence

  • Administer the delivery of timely, appropriate, and accurate benefits

  • Evaluate the claim for potential fraud indicators and escalate the claim to SIU, as appropriate

  • Recognize and investigate subrogation opportunity and refer to NJM subrogation staff for recovery of third-party funds

  • Initiate and provide excellent communication with all stakeholders (injured workers, medical providers, attorneys, policyholders, agents, etc.) professionally and proactively with a customer-centric approach

  • Apply critical thinking skills to evaluate and mitigate exposures, and establish and implement a proactive strategic plan of action

  • Assign and refer claim petitions to Counsel, and work to resolve the claim within given authority

  • Build rapport with policyholders and agents, conduct on-site investigations when necessary, and educate policyholders and agents on NJM procedures, policies, and claim practices

  • Prepare and attend Claim Reviews at policyholder or agent locations in Western and/or Central PA or virtually for further locations.

  • Serve as a liaison between policyholders/agents and various departments in NJM.

  • Represent WC Claim in on-site capabilities meetings to onboard new policyholders in Western and/or Central PA. 

  • Participate in training programs to keep current on relevant issues/topics

  • Recommend process improvement where applicable to best improve the department efficiency, work product, and service commitment to interested parties

  • Demonstrate a commitment to NJM’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and apply knowledge of compliance policies and procedures, standards, and laws applicable to job responsibilities in the performance of work

Required Qualifications and Experience:

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Workers' Comp Claim Representative, or comparable knowledge and experience with various aspects of claims handling and/or process including advanced knowledge of medical terminology and WC regulations for PA, MD and/or DE claims.

  • Knowledge of and/or experience working with liens and Medicare Set-Asides to secure full and final settlements

  • Customer service oriented with strong written and oral communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work both in a team and independently

  • Demonstrated organizational skills, and use of sound decision-making capabilities

  • Working knowledge utilizing an automated claim processing system and Microsoft Office tools including Word and Outlook

  • Licensed in DE and/or CT to adjust WC claims or have the ability to obtain these licenses within 90 days.

  • Ability to travel for business purposes, approximately 2 – 3 days a week meeting with policyholders and/or agents

Preferred:

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree

  • AIC/CPCU or other applicable insurance designations

  • Experience using Guidewire Claim Center, OnBase and additional Microsoft Office tools including Teams, Excel and PowerPoint

  • Knowledge and experience in claims handling for other commercial line products in various states including PA, MD and/or DE.

Salary:

  • Sr Level starting rate is $79,129.05+ annually based on experience and credentials

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $79,129-$91,834

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Data Analytics & Automation
jobs.description_html:
Director, Technology, Data, Analytics & Automation


Who we are

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a leading global insurance organization. Building on 100 years of experience, today AIG member companies provide a wide range of property casualty insurance and other financial services to customers in more than 80 countries and jurisdictions. These diverse offerings include products and services that help businesses and individuals protect their assets, manage risks and provide for retirement security.


Purpose of the Role

The Director, Technology, Data, Analytics and Automation will design and deliver technology and automation-driven solutions to enable the optimal delivery of legal, compliance, and regulatory services within AIG across all regions in which the company operates. 

Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities

In this role you will be leading a Global high performing team across Ireland, the US, and Japan driving technology and process innovation, including the adoption of AI capabilities, across legal, compliance and regulatory functions. As a subject matter expert in the systems, workflows and data, you will ensure alignment with their standards. You will put the Global Legal, Compliance and Regulatory Technology Roadmap into practice to support organizational transformation, improve efficiency and deliver operational excellence across the application environment.

You are a process-driven, strategic thinker with a proven track record of managing high-performing teams with an operational excellence mindset and evidence of having delivered significant organizational results. 

Complementing your core responsibilities, you will elicit, analyze, and document business, functional, and system requirements and translate those into clear system specifications, user stories, and process flows for technology teams will round out your profile.


Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant technology, operations, and analytics experience.  Insurance industry and/or legal, compliance, and regulatory knowledge is preferred.
  • Experience leading high-performing teams with strong track records of flawless project execution and driving a culture of operational excellence.
  • Experience in leading the development and execution of automation strategies.
  • Experience developing applications utilizing desktop and web-enabled reporting, database, and analytics tools.
  • Experience collaborating with the IT organization and business partners on a project.
  • Strong project management skills, including effective attention to detail.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to establish effective working relationships with and provide constructive feedback to stakeholders, colleagues, and reviewers.
  • Effective time management skills; coordinate and prioritize competing initiatives while meeting deadlines.
  • Ability to educate team members in using automation.
  • Ability to identify process improvements and suggest efficiencies.
  • Ability to document processes, and transfer knowledge to team members.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to create and deliver effective presentations.
  • BA or equivalent experience; Masters degree is a plus.  Preferred areas of study include Data Management, Computer Science, Finance, Business Administration, Technology, and other related disciplines.

For positions based in New York , the base salary range is $195,000-$215,000 and the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. Your actual compensation will be dependent on your skills, experience, and qualifications. In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: US Benefits


At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories.

AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities.  If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an email to candidatecare@aig.com.  

Functional Area:

FA - FinanceAIG Employee Services, Inc.

  • Lead the Midmarket platform for Property business, working closely with Head of Wholesale Property to enhance and integrate all complimentary product offerings 
  • Establish and implement a long-term business strategy for Midmarket Property focusing on risk appetite that effectively manages risk 
  • Drive consistent distribution and underwriting best practices and guidelines to ensure rating and pricing adequacy of the business 
  • Develop sustainable relationships with key wholesale brokers throughout the zonal framework. 
  • Develop and ensure effective utilization of detailed monitoring standards including quality reviews to assess underwriting results and loss ratios down to the account level 
  • Understanding of regulatory and compliance processes 
  • Establish strong relationships with Lexington leadership; create mutual understanding of overall parameters and goals to drive effective execution of business model. 
  • Develop tools and strategies, in collaboration with HR, to attract and retain top industry talent and develop high performing teams. 
  • Drive a culture that promotes collaboration, diversity and inclusion. 
  • Ensure a reputation of Claims excellence in the marketplace.

  • At least 15 years insurance leadership experience in Property Insurance.

  • Established strong relationships with brokers 
  • Skilled leader of change; versatile, client focused, results oriented 
  • Demonstrated business savvy, analytical and quantitative skills 
  • Expert technical underwriting background with advanced knowledge of first party insurance for all industries

jobs.title: Investment Accounting Senior Analyst
jobs.description_html:
Who we are

AIG, Inc. is a leading provider of insurance products and services for commercial and personal insurance customers.  It includes one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks.  AIG, Inc. (“AIG”) offers a broad range of products to customers through a diversified, multichannel distribution network.  Customers value AIG’s strong capital position, extensive risk management and claims experience and its ability to be a market leader in critical lines of the insurance business.


Corporate Finance - Investment Accounting

The Investment Accounting group at AIG is responsible for the accounting and reporting for AIG's Invested Assets of over $95 billion a comprised primarily of fixed maturity securities and includes private equity, hedge funds, commercial/residential loans and equity securities.  In addition, AIG’s derivative portfolio consists primarily of foreign exchange derivatives but also includes interest rate and other derivative instruments. 


The Investment Accounting group’s specific responsibilities include reconciliation of transactional data from various sub-ledgers to the general ledger and ultimately AIG's financial statements as well as all related external reporting for investments (10Q/K, Financial Supplement, STAT Audited Financials, Investment NAIC reporting and various government regulatory reports).  AIG has multiple legal entities around the globe.


The team is also responsible for establishing the accounting for new transactions or new investment products, implementation of new GAAP and STAT accounting standards as it relates to invested assets, the implementation of new accounting systems as it relates to invested assets, and management of the risks, controls and AIG audit as it relates to investments and supporting Investment FP&A.


Responsibilities

  • Execute and manage accounting processes related to the monthly and quarterly accounting close to ensure accuracy of AIG’s invested assets data of certain international entities
  • Support the preparation of certain Investment disclosures for AIG 10Q/K and Financial Supplement, including as appropriate the Investment, Lending, Fair Value, VIE Footnotes and Investment MD&A
  • Assist with the implementation of process improvements and new systems, in coordination with other areas of the department/organization
  • Point of contact and support for the various business unit and corporate controllers
  • Coordinate with various areas in the organization to develop an understanding of new investment transactions and to provide guidance/support that ensures the accounting results from these investments are accurately recorded in the AIG ledgers
  • Perform ad-hoc analytical requests

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance
  • At least 3 years’ experience in accounting and reporting for investment products
  • Understanding of investment products and accounting treatment for fixed maturity, equity, cash equivalent and alternative investments
  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principle (GAAP) and the recording of investments-related journal entries
  • Experience with foreign currency remeasurement and translation
  • Strong analytical skills, including experience performing investment data analysis including commentary
  • High level of competency using Microsoft Excel including pivot tables and formulas to create/manage investment data and perform analysis
  • Ability to work collaboratively with teams in multiple locations
  • Ability to balance multiple projects at once, to prioritize appropriately, and to approach the work with a sense of urgency and strong attention to detail to produce high quality results in a time sensitive environment
  • Team-player mindset geared towards process improvements and the implementation of accounting controls to ensure consistency and data quality of the team’s financial output
  • High level of motivation and initiative, ability to work independently, including strong organizational skills
  • Comfort level working within a dynamic and complex organizational structure
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to maintain relationships at all levels within the organization
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate effectively with staff, peers, and other external and internal audiences
  • Computer proficiency with a strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, database experience a plus

For positions based in New York, the base salary range is $87,000-$109,000. For positions based in Connecticut, the base salary range is $87,000-$109,000. For positions based in New Jersey, the base salary range is $88,000-$110,000. The position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. Your actual compensation will be dependent on your skills, experience, and qualifications.  In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here US Benefits

jobs.title: Associate Actuary, Central Reserving
jobs.description_html:
The Central Reserving team is seeking a highly analytical and innovative professional to help advance our reserving capabilities through the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced analytics. This role will be responsible for developing tools and models that identify and quantify key drivers of claims outcomes, uncover insights into loss development behavior, and enhance reserving accuracy across multiple lines of business.

In addition, this role will support the analysis, determination, and reporting of reserves for Extra-Contractual Obligations (ECO) and Corporate-Level Unallocated Loss Expense (ULE).

The successful candidate will partner with reserving actuaries, claims professionals, data scientists, and business leaders to transform complex datasets into actionable insights, modern analytical tools, and next-generation reserving methodologies.

This position offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of actuarial reserving by combining traditional actuarial expertise with cutting-edge AI and advanced analytics capabilities.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the quarterly process of determining the appropriate amount of IBNR to be booked across assigned reserving segments, including Extra-Contractual Obligations (ECO) and Corporate-Level Unallocated Loss Expense (ULE).
  • Analyze information to determine, document, and communicate the adequacy of loss and loss expense reserves.
  • Develop and apply advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI-based tools to identify and quantify key drivers of claims outcomes, improve reserve estimates, and generate business insights into loss development behavior.
  • Research, develop, and enhance reserving methodologies and models to improve reserve accuracy and support actuarial transformation initiatives.
  • Analyze and monitor loss development trends, claims emergence patterns, and relevant industry, regulatory, and operational changes, and effectively communicate findings to management.
  • Partner with Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) to analyze reserve risk for use in capital modeling purposes.
  • Assist with quarterly financial and regulatory reporting (quarter close) and provide data and exhibits for annual statement reporting, including ECO and ULE reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Claims, Finance, Pricing, Data Science, and Technology teams to improve data quality, streamline processes, and achieve reserving modernization objectives.
  • Work effectively both independently and as part of a team to achieve the organization's financial, strategic, and operational objectives.

Qualifications:

  • BS in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related area
  • ACAS or FCAS
  • 4 or more years of experience in reserving and/or pricing
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Work well both independently and as part of a team
  • Proficiency in Excel, SQL, SAS, Python, R, or other programming languages preferred
  • Strong business and collaboration skills and responsive to service needs and operational demands
  • Effective time management skill
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
  • Strong work ethic

For positions based in New York and Connecticut, the base salary range is $105,000-$130,000. The position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. jobs.title: Network Automation Engineer
jobs.description_html:
American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a leading global insurance organization. AIG member companies provide a wide range of property casualty insurance in approximately 70 countries and jurisdictions. These diverse offerings include products and services that help businesses and individuals protect their assets and manage risks.


We’re also committed to making a positive difference for our colleagues and in the communities where we work and live. We encourage colleagues to give back to the causes they care most about, supporting these efforts through our Volunteer Time Off and Matching Grants Programs.


Get to know the business

At AIG, technology is at the heart of everything we do, from underwriting risks to processing claims. The Information Technology team equips our colleagues with the latest tools to complete their work efficiently and with the highest standards of excellence. The team is responsible for shielding the company’s systems from security risks, while designing technology strategies that enable AIG’s businesses to achieve their goals. AIG’s Information Technology functions include enterprise architecture, software and systems engineering, cybersecurity, and technology risk and compliance.


About the Role

We are looking for a Network Automation Engineer to help build and scale automation across our enterprise network environment. You’ll combine strong networking knowledge with software and automation skills to reduce manual work, improve network reliability, and enable API-driven operations. A key part of the role will be developing and operating our Network Source of Truth (SSoT/NSoT) using Nautobot, and integrating it with network infrastructure, automation, observability, and other enterprise platforms. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving real network problems with Python, APIs, Ansible, Git, and modern automation practices, not simply administering network devices.


What Success Looks Like

Requirements

  • Design and build network automation for provisioning, configuration, validation, migrations, and operational workflows.
  • Help lead the implementation and ongoing development of Nautobot as the Network Source of Truth.
  • Integrate Nautobot and other network platforms using REST APIs, GraphQL, and Python.
  • Develop reusable automation using Python, Ansible, Jinja2, Terraform, and related technologies.
  • Automate synchronization and validation of network inventory, IPAM, configuration, and operational data.
  • Build automated pre-change and post-change validation to make network changes safer and more reliable.
  • Apply Git, CI/CD, testing, and Infrastructure as Code practices to network automation.
  • Integrate automation with network management, observability, and enterprise platforms.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues spanning networks, automation, APIs, and data.
  • Partner with network architects, engineering and operations teams to identify opportunities for automation and improve how the network is operated.
  • Evaluate and prototype emerging network automation technologies and capabilities.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of network engineering, network automation, or related experience in large enterprise environments.
  • Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, routing and switching, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and IPAM.
  • Strong Python development or scripting skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Ansible or similar automation platforms.
  • Experience building integrations using REST APIs and working with JSON/YAML.
  • Experience with a network Source of Truth, IPAM, DCIM, or inventory platform, ideally Nautobot or NetBox.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience automating network technologies from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, F5, or similar.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, architecture, operations, and technology teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Hands-on experience developing Nautobot Jobs, Apps/plugins, APIs, GraphQL integrations, or data models.
  • Experience with NetBox, Nornir, Netmiko, NAPALM, pyATS, Jinja2, or similar automation technologies.
  • Familiarity with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and Linux environments.
  • Cloud networking experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of VXLAN/EVPN, controller-based networking, intent-based networking, or SDN.
  • Relevant Cisco, Juniper, DevNet, cloud, or automation certifications.

You’ll help move network operations from manual, device-by-device processes toward automated, data-driven workflows, with Nautobot serving as a trusted source of network data and APIs, automation, validation, and CI/CD providing the foundation for scalable network operations.


Ready to step up to new challenges? We would love to hear from you.


For positions based in Jersey City, NJ, the base salary range is $99,000 - $143,000 and the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: 2025 Benefits Summary


Veteran's are encouraged to apply.

jobs.description_html:
At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Claims Analyst III – EPL and D&O to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make your mark in Claims

Our Claims teams are the proven problem solvers of choice for clients, delivering consistent technical excellence and showcasing our service differentiation to create an unparalleled global claims handling experience. Through a robust stakeholder feedback loop and supported by consistent processes and leadership, we take pride in delivering responsive, fair and professional service with empathy and efficiency.


How you will create an impact

As a Claims Analyst III, you will be responsible for identifying, investigating, and resolving multiple coverage issues at the earliest appropriate time and providing clear and concise written and verbal communication of policy coverage issues to insureds, brokers, underwriters and risk managers.

  • Timely coordinate with defense counsel/insureds/monitoring counsel to facilitate coverage, liability and damage analysis.
  • Explore the use of technology, structured settlements, and other means to find strategic and cost effective claims resolutions.
  • Effectively analyze and budget the litigation of each claim on pending through timely discussions with counsel, vendors and insureds.
  • Determine judgmental value on all files in pending within a reasonable time frame and make presentations to management as necessary.
  • Manage reserve adjustments and payments to avoid deficit payments.

What you will need to succeed

  • 1+ years of claims and/or litigation experience.
  • Financial experience preferred.
  • Ability to analyze policies of insurance and legal documents.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Strong computer skills (Microsoft Office).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent required. JD highly preferred.

Ready to make a bigger impact? We look forward to reviewing your application.


For positions based in New York, NY, the base salary range is $68,000-$91,000. For positions based in Illinois, the base salary range is $62,000-$82,500 and the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan.  In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here:  2026 Benefits Overview

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Senior Production Specialist to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make your mark in Lexington Underwriting

AIG’s Lexington Insurance Company is the leading US-based surplus lines insurer. For over 50 years, it has provided flexible solutions to companies and organizations of all sizes – from Fortune 100 corporations to small and middle market entities. Lexington is renowned for its ability to help brokers find solutions to the most challenging insurance needs of their clients. Drawing on their entrepreneurial spirit, colleagues are encouraged each day to rise to challenges and embrace opportunities to make a difference.

  • Communicate with agents regarding rating, underwriting and policy issuance issues.
  • Assist in the training of support staff within the team as well as within the Department. 
  • Assist, implement, or coordinate special projects and timetables such as revised forms, new coverages/classes, research, and Underwriting Guide revisions.

  • Represent the company in a professional manner at industry functions, conventions, and corporate events.

  • An undergraduate degree
  • Minimum 5 years of Commercial Insurance Company, Agency or Brokerage experience
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships
  • Working knowledge of US Casualty lines of business including product features, forms, regulatory environments and risks etc., knowledge of underwriting construction business would be beneficial
  • Demonstrated sales, marketing, and relationship building experience, ideally with the Wholesale marketplace
  • Ability to work in dynamic, rapidly changing environment, adapting to changing requirements and collaborating with a wide range of colleagues to quickly deliver solutions

jobs.description_html:
Senior Claims Analyst Severity, Excess Casualty

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Senior Claims Analyst Severity to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make your mark in Excess Casualty Claims

Our Claims teams are the proven problem solvers of choice for clients, delivering consistent technical excellence and showcasing our service differentiation to create an unparalleled global claims handling experience. Through a robust stakeholder feedback loop and supported by consistent processes and leadership, we take pride in delivering responsive, fair and professional service with empathy and efficiency.

How you will create an impact

Do you have experience with Bodily Injury and Property Damage claims? Are you interested in a Casualty claims position where you will handle some of the most complex claims in the industry? Are you looking for a position in which you will evaluate a wrongful death claim in New York, an employment practices claim in California and an oil field explosion claim in Texas all on the same day? This Excess Casualty position may be for you. 

  • This Senior Claims Analyst position in Excess Casualty involves handling claims for bodily injury, wrongful employment practices and property damage claims under Excess or Umbrella Commercial General Liability policies. 
  • The adjuster will handle claims in all 50 states on behalf of small companies, governmental entities and major corporations. The severity of these claims range from auto accidents with moderate injuries to multi-claimant litigation with severely injured plaintiffs, wrongful death, burn injuries, or property damage claims in the millions of dollars. 
  • Preparation and execution of investigation strategies which identify critical issues effecting liability, causation and damages and assess risk transfer and contribution opportunities.
  • Clear and concise communication and contact with internal and external customers, including insureds, brokers and underwriters, to provide guidance and manage expectations.
  • Proper documentation of exposure evaluation and resolution strategy.
  • Direct the litigation, attend mediations and trials, assess liability and damages and recommend reserves. 
  • Present high value cases to senior management. 
  • Effectively strategize and budget litigation of each claim through discussions with counsel, vendors and insureds.  Establish with defense and coverage counsel clear ground rules in order to maintain financial control of budget and expenses.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • 3+ years of Commercial/Industry claims experience preferred
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal/written) and strong negotiation skills
  • Advanced experience and capabilities in litigation claims management including ADR and mediation process
  • Experience attending and controlling cases- pre-suit, litigated and post trial- at mediations, settlement conferences, etc.
  • Property and Casualty licenses required, must be obtained within 6 months.
  • Motivated individuals who are interested in the potential for an upwardly mobile career path.

Ready to take your career to the next level? We would love to hear from you.


For positions based in New Jersey, the base salary range is $76,000 - $103,000. For positions based in New York, the base salary range is $70,000 - $95,000.  For positions based in Illinois, the base salary range is $72,500 to $96,700.  In addition, the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. jobs.title: Corporate Governance and Entity Management Analyst
jobs.description_html:
Corporate Governance and Entity Management Analyst


About the Role

As a member of the Service Delivery team within the Global Legal, Compliance & Regulatory organization, you will support AIG's global corporate governance and entity management activities. This role serves as a key partner to Corporate Secretary, Legal, and business stakeholders, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of corporate records, supporting governance processes, and managing entity lifecycle events across a complex global organization.

The role also acts as the primary administrator for AIG's entity management platform, leveraging technology and data to enable efficient governance, reporting, and compliance activities.


Key Responsibilities:


Corporate Governance & Entity Management

  • Support global entity management activities, including entity formation, dissolution, restructuring, officer and director changes, and other lifecycle events.
  • Maintain accurate corporate records and entity information to support governance and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Partner with Corporate Secretary, Legal, and executive stakeholders to support governance-related activities and special projects.
  • Assist with board and committee governance processes, including document management and meeting support.
  • Monitor and maintain compliance with corporate governance policies and entity reporting requirements.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource on entity management processes and best practices.

Systems Administration & Reporting

  • Act as primary administrator for AIG's entity management platform, ensuring data integrity, quality, and system functionality.
  • Manage production, quality assurance, and delivery of governance and entity management reporting.
  • Analyze entity data, identify inconsistencies, and implement sustainable solutions to improve data quality.
  • Partner with technology teams and business stakeholders to identify and implement process improvements and system enhancements.
  • Lead user acceptance testing, platform upgrades, maintenance releases, and reporting enhancements.
  • Maintain technical and process documentation and provide support for user inquiries and system-related issues.
  • Support board management technology platforms in partnership with technology teams and governance stakeholders.

Qualifications:


Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Experience supporting corporate governance, corporate secretary, or entity management functions within a legal department, law firm, financial services organization, or other regulated environment.
  • Experience managing corporate records, entity lifecycle events, and governance documentation.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to interact professionally with senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience serving as an administrator for an entity management platform such as Diligent Entities, GEMS, Blueprint OneWorld, or similar systems.
  • Paralegal certification or equivalent corporate governance/entity management experience.
  • Experience supporting board governance and Corporate Secretary functions.
  • Experience working within a global, highly regulated corporate environment.
  • Advanced reporting and data analysis skills.

The base salary range is $81,000-$110,000 and the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. Your actual compensation will be dependent on your skills, experience, and qualifications. jobs.description_html:
Account Executive – Mid-Atlantic, US Accident & Health (A&H) 


About the position

Join us as an Account Executive to play an influential role in driving sales growth at AIG Accident & Health, a leading provider of insurance products and services focused on managing risk for both commercial and personal customers. We offer a broad range of products through a diversified, multi-channel distribution network, including one of the world's most far-reaching property casualty networks. In this role, you will report to the Head of Sales and Distribution, North America Accident & Health and be responsible for overseeing the Mid-Atlantic sales territory. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated track record of developing relationships with internal and external trading partners and creating a pipeline of new business opportunities aligned with the business strategy.


How you will create an impact

  • Oversee a sales territory for Accident & Health products.
  • Work with licensed producers to solicit new business opportunities.
  • Coordinate with regional underwriting to build coverage plan designs to meet customer needs.
  • Leverage extensive A&H product capabilities to offer customized coverage solutions.
  • Collaborate with internal commercial lines partners to cross-sell accident products to new and existing clients.
  • Articulate AIG's Accident & Health value proposition to external business partners to drive new business and retain renewal business.
  • Evaluate successes and challenges in territory and leverage key takeaways for effective strategy development.
  • Create and execute business plans, including a broker segmentation strategy, to achieve or exceed growth through new business, renewal retention, and increasing GPW
  • Establish effective budgets reflecting growth and diversification within the territory.
  • Engage with internal business partners to leverage relationships and strategic alignments throughout the organization.
  • Use Salesforce to develop target pipeline for new business and measure quote-to-bind ratios in the region.
  • Accurately forecast the assigned territory's monthly, quarterly, and yearly premium production for upward reporting to leadership.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Relevant sales experience is preferred – ideally you will have experience of working in the Mid-Atlantic region
  • Strong communication, presentation and team-working skills.
  • A hard-working, self-motivated energetic approach with the ability to deliver results under pressure.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain the internal and/or external sales strategy and processes to maximize the organization’s profit potential
  • Promote the organization’s products and services to new and current clients
  • Ensure all clients are satisfied and that the quality of the services they provide meet or exceed customer expectations
  • Liaise with clients on regular bases to understand their needs, resolve client complaints and issues, develop new business, and to provide value
  • Review current and prospective clients accounts to identify business opportunities, analyze opportunities, and promote sales growth
  • Provide reports, presentations, and recommendations on market trends, customer trends, and competitors actions
  • Handle internal and client inquiries and complaints
  • Create sales strategies, action plans and budgets
  • Research and develop new sales opportunities or new markets

Requirements

  • 5+ years insurance experience, with Accident & Health industry experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of business development, plan execution, and attainment of specific production goals.
  • Enthusiastic attitude and cooperative team player, adaptable to new or changing circumstances.
  • Demonstrated organizational savvy with a high degree of initiative and endurance to prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter able to operate in an entrepreneurial environment that rewards goal achievement and execution.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, organizational, and analytical skills.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience required.
  • P&C or A&H Insurance license preferred.

jobs.title: Director, Security Intelligence & Response
jobs.description_html:
At AIG, our business spans the globe. To achieve our objectives, we must be able to navigate complex and rapidly changing landscapes with confidence. Reporting into the Chief Security Officer, this role is designed to help deliver that confidence, enabling the business to operate free from distraction. Delivering real-time exposure analysis and highly relevant proactive risk intelligence is our formula to making informed, security-based decisions. Making that work and delivering results requires the right people, structure, processes, partnerships, and evolving technology enablers.  At the core of this team is AIGs Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), responsible for asset monitoring, strategic threat detection & reporting, travel risk management, and incident response. This team acts as our around-the-clock eyes and ears; when a risk or crises event emerges, the GSOC provides real time intelligence and enhances our ability to proactively understand and mitigate risks, while always maintaining a network of partners and qualified response solutions when needed. The ideal candidate will have extensive program management and process development experience, strong international experience, and be highly collaborative. We are also seeking candidates who embrace change and innovation as a constant means to improve and evolve.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead AIG's global monitoring, intelligence, and response program, establishing strategic priorities, operational objectives, and long-term capabilities that protect employees, facilities, operations, and corporate reputation worldwide.
  • Serve as a principal security advisor to Global Security leadership and key business stakeholders, providing strategic counsel regarding geopolitical developments, emerging threats, security incidents, and organizational risk and exposure.
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators, operational metrics, and program maturity measures to evaluate effectiveness, identify improvement opportunities, and drive continuous enhancement of global security capabilities.
  • Constant evaluation and calibration of existing org design, process, and supporting technology stacks to best achieve the team’s core objectives.
  • Set the strategic direction and governance model for security platforms supporting executive protection, emergency notification, global incidents, travel risk, etc.
