jobs.title: Data Engineer III – Data Operations & Infrastructure
jobs.description_html:
Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The Data Engineer III will design, develop, and implement data pipelines, data integration and data storage solutions such as data warehouses, data lakes, relational and non-relational databases. The role will partner closely with IT Managers, Enterprise Business Intelligence, Data Governance and Data Science teams to solve business-significant data problems and enable data-driven decision-making, automation, and optimization. In the process, the role will have the opportunity to act as a Data Advisory member for the Actuarial, Business Intelligence (BI), Data Science, and Data Engineering teams, as well as a collaborator and contributor to Enterprise Data Architecture. Data is central to ICW Group’s business strategy and digital evolution, and the Data Engineer ensures optimal data delivery architecture is consistent throughout all projects.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Builds data solutions that ensure data integrity and information usability for enterprise-wide digital solutions and decision making.

  • Leads the design and build of scalable data pipelines and solutions (batch and/or streaming) that make the best use of traditional and cloud platforms (AWS or similar) by understanding the business, technology, and data landscape including real time data processing.
  • Provides analysis of complex data elements and systems, data flow and in development of conceptual, logical, and physical data models as well as verification and implementation of ETL/ELT mappings and transformation logic.
  • Designs, supports and peer reviews the data models and schemas for new and existing data sources for the data warehouse.
  • Conducts unit, integration, and system tests on our data sources to validate data against source systems, and continuously optimize performance to improve query speed and reduce cost.
  • Builds the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources using ‘big data’ technologies and tools.
  • Leads data initiatives to ensure pipelines are reliable, efficient, testable, and maintainable.
  • Maintains a strong understanding of the current landscape and proactively leads the analysis of the current environment to detect data deficiencies, gaps, and opportunities.
  • Drives the improvement of engineering team processes via data architecture, engineering, test, and operational excellence best practices.
  • Collaborates in implementing components of data strategy – Master Data Management (MDM), data virtualization etc.

Partners with various teams in delivering overall data solutions.

  • Works closely with BI and Data Science teams in implementing various data streams.
  • Partners with Enterprise Architecture, Technology, and Project teams to ensure consistency of solutions approach while maintaining data governance requirements.
  • Contributes to data governance and data quality best practices including design reviews, unit testing, code reviews, and continuous integration and deployment.
  • Collaborates with data architects to ensure the output of the physical models meet required needs— e.g., collaborates on data definition, data structure, data content and data usage.
  • Evaluates and conducts POC on new technologies for fitment in next generation data platform ecosystem.
  • Collaborates with the Enterprise Architecture team to drive tooling and standards to improve the productivity and quality of output for data engineers across the company.

SUPERVISORY RESPONISBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities but may mentor and/or train other team members. Acts as a resource for team members.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or any other technology related field required, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 6 years of experience in a data integration (Cloud/Traditional) engineering related role required. Experience with data practices (security, data management and governance) preferred. Experience in operations research, machine learning or optimization a plus. Insurance experience a plus.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • Data architecture or data engineering related certification strongly desired.
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner or more advanced AWS certification preferred.
  • DAMA certifications preferred.
     

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Expertise with database & data warehouse design, using MS-SQL, PostgreSQL etc.
  • Knowledge of Model and Design of DB schemas for read and write performance.
  • Working knowledge of API or stream-based data extraction processes.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Background in data modeling and performance tuning in relational and no-SQL databases.
  • Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, EC2, Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, DynamoDB, etc.
  • Experience with modern data architectures and modern data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks etc.
  • Experience with data technologies: Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Spark & Kafka Streaming, Python, Scala, Talend etc.
  • Knowledge and experience with data movement tools – SSIS, Profisee, Alteryx, Informatica.
  • Working knowledge of multiple data management domains such as data modeling, integration, warehousing, data quality, security, and governance.
  • A self-starter mentality that thrives in a rapidly changing, fast-paced environment and tolerates ambiguity while demonstrating problem-solving with limited supervision.
  • Strong analytical and time management skills. Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Must be organized, detail oriented, and able to multi-task. Ability to work well under pressure and deliver results with tight deadlines and under changing priorities.
  • Ability to cross collaborate with multiple teams and offer value-added solutions to meet objectives.
  • Ability to motivate and inspire team for maximum performance.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.  

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a professional office environment.  While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently will sit, stand, walk, and bend during working hours. Requires manual and finger dexterity and eye-hand coordination. Required to lift and carry relatively light materials. Requires normal or corrected vision and hearing corrected to a normal range. Ability to work additional hours, as required.


WORK ENVIRONMENT 

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier and other standard office equipment.


We are currently not offering employment sponsorship for this opportunity.

#LI-HYBRID

$121,624.81 - $217,710.99

This range is exclusive of fringe benefits and potential bonuses. If hired at ICW Group, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors unique to each candidate, including experience, education and the location of the role and considers employees performing substantially similar work.

  • Challenging work and the ability to make a difference
  • You will have a voice and feel a sense of belonging
  • We offer a competitive benefits package, with generous medical, dental, and vision plans as well as 401K retirement plans and company match
  • Bonus potential for all positions

  • Paid holidays throughout the calendar year

jobs.description_html:
Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB 

The Senior Product Owner plays a pivotal role in driving the successful development and delivery of innovative products that meet the needs of our customers and aligns with the company’s strategic goals. This role acts as the bridge between business stakeholders, development teams and end-users, ensuring clear communication and effective prioritization of features and enhancements throughout the product lifecycle. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Defines and communicates product vision, overall strategy and growth opportunities to business and IT stakeholders, with minimal guidance from leadership and other Product team members. 

  • Drives the continuous refinement of the product vision, roadmap, and strategy to drive optimum business value.

  • Works closely with business stakeholders across the organization to convert product ideas into a prioritized backlog according to business value or return on investment (ROI).

  • Participates in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, iteration reviews, and retrospectives to ensure continuous improvement and iterative development.

  • Facilitates Product Grooming Backlog sessions to align priority & strategy for better cross functional collaboration.

  • Remains accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product, evaluating progress and performance at each iteration and deciding whether the team can move on to the next steps.

  • Works closely with Technical Product Managers and Scrum master to ensure the successful execution of the product roadmap.

  • Anticipates product’s future needs by maintaining user personas and journey maps.

  • Creates annual and quarterly plans to align product groups to roadmap deliverables.

  • Independently manages and proactively identifies direction updates related to product areas.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of this job is to produce complex actuarial analyses and manage projects through establishing timelines and meeting high levels of service in a fast-growing company. This position exists to support and execute Company strategy as directed by the Chief Actuary. This position will manage, maintain, and improve the existing critical processes.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Provides complex analyses and participates in process development.

  • Provides technical/actuarial analyses in the areas of pricing, reserving, research, and systems integration.
  • Identifies potential issues and recommends mitigation strategies.
  • Participates in the development and documentation of actuarial processes.
  • Broadens knowledge around business rules, industry structure and emerging events, analytic tools and methods, and alternate data sources.
  • Responsible for at least one core/critical process within the department. 

Manages and follows through with assigned projects.

  • Assumes responsibility for concurrent projects assigned.
  • Completes assigned projects ensuring that they are delivered on time and within scope.
  • Provides regular status updates to project/task lead.
  • Ensures key stakeholders are identified and regularly informed of project status 

Collaborates within the Actuary team and with other departments.

  • Works with individuals in other departments in fulfilling the actuarial role within larger projects.
  • Establishes multiple, positive working relationships with others across the organization through various work assignments. 
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to maximize resources and contribute to the overall strategy. 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have direct reports but may mentor and/or train junior team members.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university required with a major or emphasis in Math, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of related experience required. Experience in commercial lines pricing preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 Casualty Actuarial Society (CAS) exams required.  

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

None required.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Thorough knowledge of traditional actuarial models of frequency and severity and ability to assess results. Ability to apply mathematical concepts, statistical methods, modeling, simulation techniques, trend, indexing, cash flow, and financial analysis. Skillful in Microsoft Excel, thorough knowledge of SQL and VBA, basic programming skills in R or Python. Ability to grasp analytic concepts and learn new tools and logic within established processes. Adaptable to shifting workloads and building positive working relationship within the department. Ability to cross-train others and ability to manage and to prioritize concurrent assignments and responsibilities.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.

The Director, Group Product Manager is a senior technology product leadership role accountable for end-to-end product delivery outcomes for the Specialty Business Unit, encompassing Excess Casualty and other specialty product builds, and shared function delivery (Billing, Claims, Portals, Distribution) as they serve the Specialty lines. This role leads a team of Technical Product Managers and oversees technology product strategy, vendor governance, and cross-functional delivery spanning policy administration, underwriting, billing, claims, portals, and distribution for their Business Unit. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  

  • Owns the product roadmap and delivery outcomes for the Specialty Business Unit, ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy and business objectives. 
  • Accountable for Business Unit delivery outcomes across shared insurance functions (Billing, Claims, Portals, Distribution, Marketing etc.) 
  • Develops and articulates a clear technology product roadmap for the Specialty Business Unit, aligning product goals with the Company’s overall goals, and customer needs. 
  • Oversees the product planning process by collaborating with cross-functional teams, prioritizing features, defining requirements, and creating a product roadmap for the entire product development lifecycle. 
  • Leads and inspires a team of technical product managers (TPMs) and coordinates their activities to ensure that they meet key performance indicators (KPIs) while fostering collaboration with engineering, business stakeholders, marketing, and other departments.  
  • Partners with LPM and Business Owners on market intelligence and industry trends; translates into technology product roadmap priorities for the Specialty Business Unit 
  • Represents the product roadmap to executive leadership, internal stakeholders, and customers to ensure alignment and transparency. 
  • Ensures product roadmap reflects customer needs as defined by business stakeholders and LPM 
  • Ensures consistent delivery of value by validating that all products meet customer needs and maintain high-quality standards. 
  • Manages vendor delivery execution at the Business Unit level — ensures vendor teams deliver against SOW commitments  
  • Sets Business Unit roadmap priorities for shared function TPMs 
  • Develops and leads a team of technical product professionals. 
  • Provides strategic and tactical direction to the team, communicating the organizational mission and values, and setting standards for performance excellence in technology product delivery. 
  • Establishes a collaborative team culture ensuring high engagement, recognition, and retention of team members. Ensures leadership practices promote continuous development and high performance. 
  • Manages hiring, onboarding, and training for incoming staff, setting clear expectations and developing career paths to build a resilient, skilled team capable of driving innovative solutions. 

SUPERVISORY RESPONISBILITIES 

Directly supervises employees within the Product Management teams and carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. These responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance and salary reviews; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems; coaching, mentoring, and developing team members to further their skills and knowledge; creating and monitoring development plans; setting performance expectations/goals; forecasting staffing needs and planning for peak times and absences; enforcing department policies and procedures. 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor’s degree required in business administration, marketing, computer science, software development, or related field. Master’s degree preferred. 
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in IT product management with at least 3-4 years in senior leadership roles, with a track record of successfully managing and launching insurance technology products.
  • Experience in P&C insurance technology delivery required.
  • Demonstrated experience in vendor governance, SOW negotiation, and investment proposals for enterprise technology platforms.
  • Experience with insurance SaaS platforms (Guidewire, Majesco) and vendor delivery models required.
  • Track record of delivering cross-functional outcomes across multiple concurrent initiatives.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

  • Working knowledge of underwriting workflows, policy administration, billing, and claims processes for Specialty lines.
  • Comfort with ambiguity in a scaling organization — this role requires someone who can build structure while delivering outcomes simultaneously.
  • A solid understanding of product management tools and processes, including proficiency in agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, market research techniques, and data analysis. 
  • Strong strategic thinking skills and a solid understanding of business dynamics to align product initiatives with overall business objectives. 
  • Strong leadership skills to inspire and motivate a team, set a clear vision, and guide them toward successful product outcomes. 
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, are important for conveying product vision to key team members and stakeholders and collaborating with cross-functional teams. 
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work with diverse teams, including engineering, architecture, business teams, etc.   
  • Strategic thinking and ability to make informed decisions about product direction, market opportunities, and competitive positioning while analyzing complex situations and leveraging your problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to embrace new technologies, methodologies, and agile strategies. 

PHYSICAL ENVIRONMENT

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk and hear.

Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB 

The purpose of this job is to handle all aspects of workers’ compensation cases with varying degrees of complexity and to provide other litigation and claim legal advice and services to all areas of the company. This role exists to provide high quality, proactive case handling utilizing legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of high exposure cases and complex litigation matters and deliver optimal results for ICW Group. 


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Provides litigation services and is responsible for all aspects of assigned Workers’ Compensation matters.

  • Manages the entire legal process, from investigation and discovery though trial prep and court proceedings, depositions, site inspections, court hearings, trials, etc. and negotiating settlements as required.
  • Litigates workers’ compensation cases in California before all state and federal courts, administrative boards, and other court proceedings.
  • Represents ICW Group, its related entities and insureds before administrative boards, state and federal courts, Court of Appeal, and the California Supreme Court.
  • Handles premium audit disputes before administrative boards or other court proceedings.
  • Assists in subpoenas and other third-party discovery.
  • Analyzes complex legal and factual issues; conducts extensive, well-reasoned legal research, as necessary; independently develop and present defense strategies on behalf of ICW Group.
  • Responsible for the prompt, efficient and effective disposition of assigned cases.

Provides accurate legal analysis and strategy recommendations to clients and claims personnel.

  • Assists in analyzing, reviewing, and distributing information on new legislation, regulations, court decisions and proceedings.
  • Provides strategic legal advice, recommendation, and implementation of clear, cost-effective, and efficient plans of action.
  • Delivers ongoing quality assessments of the law and facts and recommendations for timely resolution.
  • Analyzes all referrals from claims and determines need for outside investigation or other information from the insured or others.
  • Provides effective and timely communications, information, legal advice, and other services to clients and claims professionals on legal and factual issues.
  • Develops appropriate legal strategies for all stages of litigation and shares them with claims personnel and clients.

Provides leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.

  • Directs paralegals and other legal department staff in their duties and responsibilities in handling cases.
  • Ensures timely filing of all pleadings and motions or other documents with the court or administrative broads.
  • Builds and fosters internal and external client relationships with a customer-centric focus.
  • Adheres to all ICW Group’s policies and procedures and the California Rules of Professional Conduct.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities. Position will direct the work of support staff, which may include assistants and paralegals, in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including the California Rules of Professional Conduct.  These responsibilities include planning, assigning, and directing work; review, revise and approve legal documents; delegate tasks to the appropriate staff member; train, coach, and mentor, as appropriate, support staff to ensure the delivery of quality legal services.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

Bachelor’s degree from four-year college or university required.  Juris Doctorate (JD) from an accredited law school required. Minimum 7-10 years of workers’ compensation litigation experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS 

Licensed and in good standing with the State Bar of California required, with no history of public or private reprisals.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Expert knowledge in litigating California workers’ compensation matters with trial experience and prior experience handling cases with varying degrees of complexity.  Must have a deep understanding of workers’ compensation administrative rules, procedures, laws, and statutes.  Familiarity with business legal principles and practices is necessary, including knowledge of billing practices and procedures.  Demonstrated experience in working independently under minimal supervision, maintaining a strong work ethic, and exercising initiative.  Ability to communicate effectively with external and internal clients both verbally and in writing.  Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical documents, legal materials of all types, and medical records.  Strong negotiation and communication skills.  Ability to respond to inquiries, issues, or questions from internal and external clients, businesses, and members of the State Bar or Judiciary, and regulatory agencies, including effectively responding to the most sensitive inquiries or concerns.  Ability to effectively present information, verbally and in writing to clients, claims personnel, management, mediators, arbitrators, judges, juries, and members of the public.  Proficient use of a personal computer and skills with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Adobe, and PowerPoint.  Ability to learn various proprietary computer applications.  Ability to work with mathematical concepts and apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and algebra and geometry to practical situations.  Ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions and problem-solve.  Ability to define legal issues, collect necessary data, establish facts, draw legal conclusions, and implement a strategic legal resolution.  Expert at time management skills, appropriate delegation of activities and the ability to manage multiple legal matters at one time. 


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.  


WORK ENVIRONMENT  

This position operates in an office and court environment and requires frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, scanner, and other standard office equipment.  The position requires traveling to various court locations as well as other business locations.

This range is exclusive of fringe benefits and potential bonuses. Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB 

The purpose of the position is to partner with key stakeholders to drive the strategic direction for a portfolio of insurance product line(s) across all distribution channels and brands.  This position helps define product strategy and roadmap and champions the strategy and monitors product progression throughout the full life cycle. The position is responsible for monitoring and influencing all aspects of product performance to achieve Company revenue and performance targets.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Ideates and develops business initiatives using product knowledge and results.

  • Leads and participates in collaborations with the head of product line underwriting unit(s) to develop product strategy and action plan to achieve growth and profit objectives.
  • Owns inputs to bi-annual premium and exposure projections supporting financial budgeting and pro-forma processes and understand projection framework.
  • Provides expert insights regarding profitability, retention, and growth strategies through the integration of the underwriting, marketing, policyholder services, distribution, claims, actuarial, data analytics, customer, and digital experience.
  • Collaborates with other functional departments to coordinate timelines for delivery, maximize the effectiveness of programs, direct implementation of product strategies, and drive cross-functional alignment and engagement for initiatives supporting product objectives.
  • Develops and maintains templates to perform competitive research and deliver competitive analyses.
  • Utilizes and trains others in the use of internal analytical tools (spanning underwriting, marketing, customer behavior, and claims). 
  • Performs and reviews data analyses concerning loss patterns, market forces, risk distributions, and agency management to evaluate the success of current strategies to either modify or create new strategies targeting production, product pricing, underwriting, contract changes, or agency changes.
  • Assesses the impact of changes on the in-force book, new business production, and agency force.

Develops and drives initiatives for strategic product development.

  • Applies business content knowledge in identifying priorities and executing strategic product initiatives to achieve business objectives.
  • Monitors the marketplace to identify competitor and industry changes impacting effectiveness or compliance of current and proposed programs.
  • Partners with Actuarial team to determine and implement appropriate pricing and program structure to achieve product goals, and design and execute product rate plan and state level enhancements across jurisdictions ensuring all changes are communicated to field services, operations, underwriting, marketing, and system technology teams.
  • Partners with Underwriting team to facilitate changes to processes or systems, or respond to questions, and ensuring communication to affected parties.
  • Analyzes the performance of existing products; develops and leads the creation of business cases for the development of changes to existing products or development of new products.
  • Maintains knowledge of available internal and external data sources, including accuracy and completeness, to select the proper data set(s) for evaluation.
  • Organizes and structures product definitions to ensure efficiencies in downstream reporting processes.
  • Directs the implementation of underwriting guideline changes.
  • Collaborates with strategic planning groups to incorporate enterprise class system solutions supporting the future product roadmap.

Acts as product leader and subject matter expert in the maintenance of current products, filed product changes, and design and delivery of new products in development.

  • Develops internal partnerships and collaborates with Enterprise Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Underwriting, and Actuarial Departments to manage the implementation of all ratemaking bureau rules, forms and coverage changes, and company-initiated changes including coordination with the rate filing analyst.
  • Keeps abreast of distribution channel needs through involvement in agency facing initiatives, and regular reporting on direct to market strategies available in the industry.
  • Possesses expert knowledge of ratemaking bureau underwriting manuals and company exception rules and maintains knowledge of any changes.  Documents and memorializes changes.
  • Researches issues or concerns around underwriting rules, including historical company filings in independent ratemaking bureaus to confirm adherence and direct changes.
  • Maintains knowledge of rules, regulations, nuances in states of operation and engage with product line underwriting unit(s) to invoke needed changes or identify training in support of a self-sustaining culture.
  • Proactively engages with Underwriting and Legal to ensure insurance policy provisions comply with state law.
  • Partners with Compliance Department to identify and close any gaps in rules, respond to changes in rules, and remediate across systems, processes, reporting.
  • Participates in regulatory approval of filings, market conduct exams, and internal responses to any state filing objections to facilitate modifications.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 

This position has no supervisory responsibilities but may mentor and train junior team members. 


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree from a college or university required with a major or emphasis in Business, Computer Science, Math, or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.  MBA is a plus. 
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in insurance product management.  Insurance industry knowledge and demonstrated work experience required. 
  • Exposure to industry recognized product management curriculum, or demonstrated experience required. 
  • Experience managing complex, large-scale, high risk product development projects preferred.  

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Extensive knowledge of insurance industry; workers compensation or commercial lines required based on role designation.
  • Resourcefulness to research industry topics and develop proficient knowledge of internal systems and constraints to aid in managing individual state compliance.
  • Knowledge of actuarial practice area is a plus.
  • Highly developed quantitative analysis, decision making, and project management skills. 
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex business problems, consistent with a deep understanding of the strategic direction of the business. 
  • Deep knowledge of the insurance product lifecycle, financial drivers of profitability, insurance regulations and general insurance operations and business processes.
  • Ability to synthesize analytical results to guide business decisions. Strong leadership, written and oral communication, and teamwork skills required.  Strong organizational skills. 
  • Ability to hold effective meetings, including setting agendas and attendees, time management, and documentation of meeting outcomes.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS 

Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) preferred. 


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit or periodically stand and work on a computer for 80-90% of time.  The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms and climb or balance.  The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 5 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.  


WORK ENVIRONMENT  

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of the Actuarial Specialist is to produce complex analyses, manage projects, and oversee team workload to meet high levels of service within the Actuarial department. This position exists to support and execute Company strategy as directed by the Chief Actuary, while acting as a team leader and as a trusted advisor to other business leaders.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Provides technical analyses and participates in process development.

  • Provides technical actuarial analyses in the areas of ratemaking, reserving, analytics, and systems integration.
  • Participates in the development and documentation of actuarial department processes.
  • Takes responsibility to modify processes in order to improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • Develops new business processes or comprehensive analytic efforts.
  • Initiates project design within system constraints and demonstrates an understanding of dependencies.

Works with business leaders to develop and implement new products and expand into new markets.

  • Buildout of the Commercial Property pricing model.
  • Acts in the capacity of a trusted advisor to other business leaders.
  • Ensures that the work product supports business growth and profitability.
  • Takes a prominent role in communicating and explaining actuarial findings to business leaders.
  • Fosters positive, collaborative working relationships with higher level experts across the organization.
  • Works with individuals in other departments in fulfilling the actuarial role within larger projects.

Assists in developing the actuarial team and oversees subordinates’ work.

  • Maintains a positive work climate and fosters motivation and engagement.
  • Performs at the level of a subject matter expert and a team lead for a functional area (e.g. regulatory/filings, corporate including reserving, systems administrator, pricing, ratemaking).
  • Ensures soundness and integrity of actuarial analyses.
  • Reviews subordinate’s work to uphold consistency with Standards of Practice and provides valuable feedback.

Excess & Surplus Specific:

  • Supports development and enhancement of pricing tools for E&S product lines.
  • Performs individual large complex accounts pricing review and works closely with E&S underwriters.
  • Provides business requirements for system integration and set up data export functions for data reporting.
  • Builds business reports to monitor rate change and profitability of the portfolio.
  • Evaluates and refines pricing assumptions based on industry benchmark data and competitive analysis.
  • Demonstrated success in Commercial Lines (Property, GL, Auto, and etc.) and/or E&S market environments.
  • Proficient in Excel, Python and SQL; expert in actuarial and statistical modeling techniques. Experienced with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
  • Strong technical pricing skills with knowledge of exposure-based pricing, experience modelling, catastrophe modelling and stochastic simulation techniques.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities but may act as a team lead and mentor actuarial analysts.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university required in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science or related field. 
  • Minimum 5 years of related experience in actuarial roles required.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

ACAS designation highly desired but relevant work experience may be considered.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and proven project leadership abilities.
  • Thorough knowledge of actuarial models and ability to assess results.
  • Thorough knowledge of broad segments of ICW systems and related business areas.
  • Experience managing multiple projects and resources.
  • Dedication to building a working knowledge of emerging analytic techniques.
  • Ability to work independently in deriving solutions to new business problems.
  • Comfortable and competent in client interaction settings.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS 

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear. 


WORK ENVIRONMENT 

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! PURPOSE OF THE JOB 

The purpose of this job is to handle all aspects of workers’ compensation cases with varying degrees of complexity and to provide other litigation and claim legal advice and services to all areas of the company. This role exists to provide high quality, proactive case handling utilizing legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of moderate exposure cases and standard litigation matters and deliver optimal results for ICW Group. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Provides litigation services and is responsible for all aspects of assigned Workers’ Compensation matters.

  • Manages the entire legal process, from investigation and discovery though trial prep and court proceedings, depositions, site inspections, court hearings, trials, etc. and negotiating settlements as required with minimal supervision.
  • Litigates workers’ compensation cases in California before all state and federal courts, administrative boards, and other court proceedings.
  • Represents ICW Group, its related entities and insureds before administrative boards, state and federal courts, Court of Appeal, and the California Supreme Court.
  • Assists in premium audit disputes before administrative boards or other court proceedings.
  • Assists in subpoenas and other third-party discovery.
  • Analyzes legal and factual issues; conducts extensive, well-reasoned legal research, as necessary; independently develop and present defense strategies on behalf of ICW Group.
  • Responsible for the prompt, efficient and effective disposition of assigned cases.

Provides accurate legal analysis and strategy recommendations to clients and claims personnel.

  • Assists in analyzing, reviewing, and distributing information on new legislation, regulations, court decisions and proceedings.
  • Provides strategic legal advice, recommendation, and implementation of clear, cost-effective, and efficient plans of action.
  • Delivers ongoing quality assessments of the law and facts and recommendations for timely resolution.
  • Assists in the analysis of referrals from claims and determines need for outside investigation or other information from the insured or others.
  • Provides effective and timely communications, information, legal advice, and other services to clients and claims professionals on legal and factual issues.
  • Develops, with minimal supervision, appropriate legal strategies for all stages of litigation and shares them with claims personnel and clients.

Provides direction to legal support staff.

  • Directs paralegals and other legal department staff in their duties and responsibilities in the assistance of matters assigned to the attorney.
  • Ensures timely filing of all pleadings and motions or other documents with the court or administrative broads.
  • Builds and fosters internal and external client relationships with a customer-centric focus.
  • Adheres to all ICW Group’s policies and procedures and the California Rules of Professional Conduct.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities. Position will direct the work of support staff, which may include assistants and paralegals, in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including the California Rules of Professional Conduct.  These responsibilities include assigning, and directing work; review, revise and approve legal documents; delegate tasks to the appropriate staff member; train, coach, and mentor, as appropriate, support staff to ensure the delivery of quality legal services.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

Bachelor’s degree from four-year college or university required.  Juris Doctorate (JD) from an accredited law school required. Minimum 5 to 8 years of workers’ compensation litigation experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS 

Licensed and in good standing with the State Bar of California required, with no history of public or private reprisals.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Proficient knowledge in litigating California workers’ compensation matters with prior experience handling cases of various types.  Must have a solid understanding of workers’ compensation administrative rules, procedures, laws, and statutes.  Familiarity with business legal principles and practices is preferred, including knowledge of billing practices and procedures.  Demonstrated experience in working independently under minimal supervision, maintaining a strong work ethic, and exercising initiative.  Ability to communicate effectively with external and internal clients both verbally and in writing.  Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical documents, legal materials of all types, and medical records.  Strong negotiation and communication skills.  Ability to respond to inquiries, issues, or questions from internal and external clients, businesses, and members of the State Bar or Judiciary, and regulatory agencies, including effectively responding to the most sensitive inquiries or concerns.  Ability to effectively present information, verbally and in writing to clients, claims personnel, management, mediators, arbitrators, judges, juries, and members of the public.  Proficient use of a personal computer and skills with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Adobe, and PowerPoint.  Ability to learn various proprietary computer applications.  Ability to work with mathematical concepts and apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and algebra and geometry to practical situations.  Ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions and problem-solve.  Ability to define legal issues, collect necessary data, establish facts, draw legal conclusions, and implement a strategic legal resolution.  Expert at time management skills, appropriate delegation of activities and the ability to manage multiple legal matters at one time. 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.  

WORK ENVIRONMENT  

This position operates in an office and court environment and requires frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, scanner, and other standard office equipment.  The position requires traveling to various court locations as well as other business locations.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of this job is to serve as a litigation representative to attend hearings, depositions, and resolve disputes as it applies to aspects of workers’ compensation claims. This position exists to reduce allocated loss adjustment expenses and improve results by proactively analyzing and resolving workers’ compensation claims.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Manages litigation and claim disputes as they apply to workers’ compensation claims.

  • Attends claim hearings representing ICW Group.

  • Appears at WCAB lien conferences and trials; may need to appear at status, priority, and mandatory settlement conferences on occasion.

  • Schedules and attends settlement walk-through hearings with claimants and/or counsel.

  • Reduces loss adjustment expenses by quickly and effectively resolving disputed claims and litigation, including liens.

  • Resolves claims fairly and equitably, acting in the best interest of the insured. 

Prepares documentation necessary for assigned cases.

  • Prepares court pleadings, reports, and settlement documents in accordance with statutory and case law as well as pertinent regulations.

  • Prepares for and attends depositions; maintains notes and correspondence.

  • Prepares and submits timely Hearing Reports to claims personnel and claims management.

  • Reviews and analyzes the billed invoices and liens and compares with professional bill review analysis. 

Provides subject matter expertise in the litigation aspect of workers’ compensation claims.

  • Applies appropriate legal defenses and negotiates resolution or set for trial.

  • Provides guidance and expertise to other department’s operations, including Underwriting and Risk Management Services.

  • Partners with Claims Examiner to determine solutions. 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university in Business Administration, Management or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.  Minimum 2-5 years of experience in workers' compensation required, with claims examiner experience preferred.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

None required.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Working knowledge of claims and insurance industry preferred.  Familiarity with and ability to effectively utilize the CA Labor Code, CA Code of Regulations, and CA Schedule for Rating Permanent Disabilities to rate disability impairment. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical journals, financial reports, and/or legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from counsel, claimants, customers, regulatory agencies, and/or members of the business community. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors. Strong ability to negotiate to resolution various legal issues before the WCAB with opposing counsel, proper claimants, and co-defendants. Strong oral skills to articulate company’s position in contested legal matters to opposing side, Information Officers, and WCAB judges.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS 

This position requires some travel – up to 20 hours per week. Works with computers and computer screens for multiple hours per day; must be able to lift and carry 25-40 pounds. Position is sedentary approximately 80% of time. Must be able to drive and be comfortable working independently.

WORK ENVIRONMENT 

This position is a hybrid field/office position. Field environment includes appearing at various WCAB district offices, driving to and from appointments/appearances, meeting with attorneys/judges, and use of cell phone/email. Office environment includes use of a computer, telephone, copier and other standard office equipment.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of the Product Business Support Specialist is to partner cross functionally in the execution of insurance product design, implementation, and project management. This role will facilitate effective planning and execution of product business solutions that align to overall department and company strategy. This role will serve as a liaison between business and technology subject matter experts to coordinate and implement projects and solutions to meet business needs.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Provides project management for product business solutions, from end-to-end, to ensure that project objectives are met.

  • Partners with business leaders and executives to identify gaps in processes, write requirements and define project roadmap(s) aligned with company strategy.
  • Elicits, analyzes, and documents detailed business solutions that arise from changes across multiple teams and systems.
  • Works with business partners to plan and convert project roadmap(s) into phases and workstreams.
  • Gathers rates, rules, and forms requirements (proprietary or ISO based) from Product and Actuarial teams and coordinates with IT and Underwriting (UW) implementation liaison(s) as needed to align regulatory filings and effective dates across multiple systems.
  • Coordinates updated requirements as filing objections may change rates, rules, or forms implementation.
  • Works with business and technical subject matter experts to track dependencies and gaps in processes and clearly define and document solutions.
  • Works with participating business and technical teams to ensure proper resource allocation to achieve the successful outcome of product business solutions.
  • Creates touch points and provides updates to stakeholders regarding project objectives, schedule, status, conflicts, and dependencies.
  • Pro-actively monitors project activities, resource constraints, and working team progress. Communicates with IT and other partners any issues that require attention.

Coordinates Product and Actuarial user acceptance testing (UAT) and user access to appropriate environments.

  • Coordinates test case documentation with UW and Product and logs test case results.
  • Ensures test errors are reported with appropriate documentation to IT partners.
  • Follows up with IT for timing and resource availability for testing fixes with business subject matter experts.
  • Provides support for UAT and test defect resolution. Coordinates and documents test cases and results to ensure accurate and timely reporting and re-testing of issues.

Supports implementation of product business solutions and provides post-implementation support of deployed business solutions.  

  • Participates in coordinating the deployment and implementation of business solutions for product changes as they relate to rates, rules, and forms.
  • Partners with PMO, IT, and Underwriting in planning and execution to align deployment deliverables.
  • Communicate with LOB partners to resolve and align expectations where there are shared system impacts.
  • Fast tracks progress of internal development work and provides support for feature enhancements, including documentation, and project management.
  • Provides ongoing production support, including responding to user issues, collaborating with technical teams to analyze and resolve reported issues.
  • Assigns, documents, and tracks business issues as they evolve through the entire implementation life cycle, ensuring resolution. Escalates delays and roadblocks and works with SMEs to ensure system implementation and business processes are aligned on effective dates and filed and approved for rates, rules, and forms.

SUPERVISORY RESPONISBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND SKILLS

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university required with a major or emphasis in Business, Information Technology, Insurance, or related field. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Minimum 5 years of insurance experience required.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant technical insurance product (rates, rules, forms) experience required.
  • Project management experience in prior roles desired.  

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU), Associate in Insurance (AINS) or other insurance industry designation desirable. Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Project Management Professional (PMP), or CAPM certifications a plus.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Knowledge of the insurance end-to-end process.
  • Understanding of dependencies, process when changes are made in one area that affects others downstream.
  • Outstanding communication and documentation skills, in both business process and technical formats required. 
  • Expertise in project management techniques is foundational. 
  • High level business knowledge in at least one functional business area is expected. 
  • Working experience interacting with Information Systems and Technical Engineers is essential.
  • Strong analytical skills, ability to create compelling business cases; Team-oriented focus; ability to conduct effective meetings with business and project teams; ability to create and interpret business user needs into specifications.  
  • Understanding of the insurance product implementation lifecycles and experience in writing business requirements and business test specifications.
  • Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence and Visio preferred.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a professional office environment.  While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently will sit, stand, walk, and bend during working hours. Requires manual and finger dexterity and eye-hand coordination. May be required to lift light objects. Requires normal or corrected vision and hearing corrected to a normal range.


WORK ENVIRONMENT 

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of computer, telephone, copier and other standard office equipment.


We are currently not offering employment sponsorship for this opportunity.

  • Challenging work and the ability to make a difference
  • You will have a voice and feel a sense of belonging
  • We offer a competitive benefits package, with generous medical, dental, and vision plans as well as 401K retirement plans and company match
  • Bonus potential for all positions
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid holidays throughout the calendar year
  • Want to continue learning? We’ll support you 100%

PURPOSE OF THE JOB  


The purpose of the Senior Accountant is to create and analyze financial information to provide accurate and useful information to Management for review and decision making. This position performs and coordinates accounting duties within the Accounting department. This position exists to ensure accounting processes are completed thoroughly and accurately, while aligning with Company standards. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
 

Accounting Operations and Reconciliations  

  • Performs reconciliations monthly and resolves all reconciliation issues timely and independently. 
  • Reviews and verifies the accuracy of journal entries and accounting classifications assigned to various records and makes corrections as needed to ensure provision accuracy. 
  • Assembles, creates, and reconciles month-end accounting entries resolving discrepancies. 
  • Prepares all account entries by compiling and analyzing account information.  
  • Investigates and resolves moderately complex accounting discrepancies by evaluating root causes and recommending corrective actions. 
  • Supports month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes and tax processes. 

  

Process Improvement and Governance 

  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders through the effective communication of accounting concepts, policies, and practices. 
  • Supports internal and external audits as well as regulatory examinations by coordinating requests, preparing documentation, and responding to inquiries 
  • Leads and implements process improvement initiatives related to financial reporting, analysis, system functionality, internal controls, and operational efficiency. 
  • Upholds financial security by following internal controls.  
  • Provides guidance, training, and mentoring to tax provisional inquiries by teammates.  

  

Financial Reporting & Analysis 

  • Prepares key components of income and balance sheet statements, consolidated statements, and various other accounting statements and reports. 
  • Maintains, records, and reconciles all accounting information across source systems. 
  • Coordinates special projects, ensures integrity of accounting information, and develops new or improved methods and procedures. 
  • Independently analyzes complex financial transactions and accounting issues, identifies trends and risks, and provides recommendations to management. 
  • Research and interpret accounting standards, policies, and procedures to ensure appropriate accounting treatment and effectively communicates any changes 
  • Leads assigned accounting projects and process improvement initiatives within the department. 
  • Coordinates and leads assigned accounting projects and department initiatives, ensuring timely completion of objectives and deliverables. 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES  

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities. 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE  

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university required with a major or emphasis in Accounting, Finance, or related field.  
  • Minimum 5-7 years of related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience required.   

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS  

None required. Certified Public Accountant (CPA) preferred. 

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

  • Intermediate knowledge of General Accounting, A/P, A/R and/or in an accountant role required.   
  • Experience with automated accounting and financial management systems.  
  • Solid knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). 
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing and interact effectively with management, employees, and auditors.  
  • Ability to convey complex financial issues to non-financial users.  
  • Ability to work independently and meet stringent deadlines; detail-oriented and highly organized. Ability to collect, analyze, and summarize data and to prepare clear and concise reports.  
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite applications.   
  • Ability to support effective partnerships with key groups and individuals and have good consultation and change management skills. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate accounting issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions. 
  • Ability to interpret accounting policies, procedures, and regulations and apply professional judgment to complex situations. 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS   

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.   

WORK ENVIRONMENT   

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB 

The purpose of this job is to drive strategic recruiting responsibilities and oversee the complete lifecycle recruitment process, including candidate sourcing and assessment, onboarding and maintaining good hiring practices. This position exists to attract and place high quality talent across the enterprise that performs well, while providing exceptional candidate experiences to promote the brand and generate engagement to support Human Resources (HR) initiatives. 


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Participates in the planning and execution of Talent Attraction strategies.

  • Coordinates the placement of ads utilizing online job boards, internal job postings, and school postings.
  • Recommends and participates in pro-active recruitment strategies, such as college relations, job fairs, and military recruiting as warranted.
  • Creates and maintains contacts within the industry.
  • Places and maintains internal and external job postings for all positions including schools, professional organizations, and other sources in alignment with Recruiting Plan.
  • Develops comprehensive recruiting and sourcing plans for open positions, working closely with HR Business Partners as needed.
  • Develops a network of industry, academic, and community contacts to create a pipeline of candidates for future openings.
  • Attends events representing ICW Group and promotes the benefits of working at the Company.

Manages the candidate selection and onboarding process.

  • Sources qualified candidates for assigned positions using the most effective means including internal and external job boards such as LinkedIn, Indeed, professional associations, schools, or other target sources to minimize the use of agencies and provide high caliber candidates.
  • Pre-screens and recommends candidates to hiring managers.
  • Partners with Talent Coordinator to ensure timely scheduling of candidate interviews.
  • Advises hiring managers on market conditions, candidate pipeline, and offer recommendations.
  • Works closely with Hiring Managers and HRBPs to determine staffing needs and timeliness of the recruitment process.
  • Closes candidates and negotiates salary and hiring terms. Prepares offer letter and secures acceptance.
  • Creates and documents leads within a centralized tracking system. Follows-up with leads in an effort to convert into active candidates. 

Engages in Team Member Process Management and Talent Acquisition programs.

  • Promotes Employee Referral Program by developing campaigns and promotions to expand the use of employee referrals as a primary source of candidates.
  • Identifies key academic institutions and programs to target for college recruiting.
  • Establishes relationships with college leaders and faculty and seeks opportunities for involvement in student organizations.
  • Engages ICW Group Team Members to promote insurance industry careers and Company opportunities.
  • Works with Sr HR Administrator for the Visa process, for new employees.
  • Partner with talent coordinator on all aspects of temporary employee placement.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities but may mentor and/or train junior team members on Company and Recruiting procedures.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university required with a major or emphasis in Business Administration, Human Resources, or related field.  An equivalent combination of education/training and experience may be considered in lieu of degree. Minimum 5 years of related talent acquisition/recruiting experience required. 


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS 

Certified Internet Recruiter (CIR), Certified Social Media Recruiter (CSMR) or related certifications preferred. 


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

 Working knowledge of professional HR recruiting experience in a fast-paced environment, corporate environment experience preferred. Strong verbal communication skills; demonstrated good judgment; solid project management skills; competent in the use of technology and Microsoft Office applications. A wide degree of creativity, near- and long-term recruiting vision, business understanding, and personal organization is required. Strong sourcing experience using Indeed. LinkedIn Recruiter, or other job boards, Boolean searches, networking groups, etc. Exposure and desire to engage in social networking strategies to engage potential talent. Demonstrated skills in negotiating, multi-tasking, organization, and execution; Current knowledge base of Recruiting best practices, California, federal and local labor laws relative to staffing; Sophisticated interpersonal skills that project a sense of optimism, “can-do” spirit, and fun with the ability to adapt style depending on situation.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.  

WORK ENVIRONMENT  

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

  • Challenging work and the ability to make a difference

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of this role is to develop and manage a profitable book of business within assigned line(s) of business, while building and maintaining strong agency relationships and driving production results. Business Development Underwriters are assigned primary underwriting responsibility for specific line(s) of business (e.g., Workers’ Compensation or Commercial Package and its component coverages). In addition, this role supports broader Commercial Lines growth by identifying cross-sell opportunities and actively marketing all Company products in coordination with other underwriting partners. This role exists to ensure the Company achieves its underwriting profitability and distribution objectives through disciplined risk selection, pricing, and agency engagement.


Location: This is a remote/field role. Candidates ideally will reside in or near Dallas, Texas or the surrounding metro area or other nearby communities.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Underwriting & Portfolio Management

  • Underwrite, select, and price risks within assigned line(s) of business in accordance with Company guidelines
  • Maintain accountability for the profitability, growth, and retention of assigned portfolio
  • Evaluate risk characteristics including operations, financials, management, and loss history to determine acceptability
  • Apply appropriate pricing, credits/debits, and underwriting judgment to achieve target returns
  • Accept or reject risks within delegated authority while ensuring alignment with underwriting guidelines and profitability objectives
  • Monitor book performance and take corrective action as needed
  • Utilize underwriting authority to effectively price and manage business within assigned line(s)
  • Remain current on regulatory, rating, and coverage changes (e.g., WCIRB/NCCI, ISO/AAIS) impacting assigned line(s) of business

Business Development, Production & Distribution

  • Drive new business production and achieve growth objectives through proactive agency engagement, prospecting, and cross-sell execution
  • Develop, manage, and maintain a producer force capable of generating profitable business
  • Monitor production, quality, and profitability of assigned producers and hold producers accountable to expectations
  • Drive profitable sales of all Company products, including increasing penetration of existing products and supporting new product introductions
  • Actively identify and pursue cross-sell opportunities across all Commercial Lines products, regardless of primary underwriting assignment
  • Promote all Company Commercial Lines offerings in agency interactions, supporting a total account approach
  • Prospect, prequalify, and appoint new producers aligned with Company strategy
  • Set, communicate, and monitor production expectations with agency partners
  • Maintain thorough knowledge of assigned territory, including production sources, competitor activity, and market trends
  • Identify opportunities for growth, new distribution, and market expansion and provide feedback to leadership

Producer & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary Company contact and representative for assigned and prospective producers
  • Build and maintain collaborative relationships through regular agency visits, meetings, and presentations
  • Provide underwriting and production support, including participation in account strategy and marketing discussions
  • Provide responsive, high-quality service to agents and insureds, resolving inquiries and coverage decisions promptly
  • Maintain consistent communication through in-person visits, calls, and Company technology
  • Present agency performance insights, opportunities, and agency management strategies to internal stakeholders and agency partners

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university with a major or emphasis in Business, Accounting, Statistics, or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 1 year of related experience and/or training required.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Current driver’s license required.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with agents and brokers while delivering high-quality customer service
  • Ability to apply fundamental underwriting principles, concepts, and guidelines within assigned line(s) of business
  • Ability to evaluate and interpret submissions, financial information, loss control reports, and policy forms/endorsements
  • Working knowledge of commercial insurance products, including Workers’ Compensation and/or Commercial Package and its component coverages (e.g., General Liability, Property, Commercial Auto, Inland Marine)
  • Ability to balance underwriting discipline within assigned line(s) of business with business development, production, and cross-sell expectations across Commercial Lines
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills
  • Ability to analyze risk, identify exposures, and make sound underwriting decisions aligned with Company objectives

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS 

  • Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.
  • Role requires 40%-50% travel to meet with clients, attend industry events, and develop new business opportunities.
  • Travel is usually limited to automobile but occasional air travel is required.
  • Requires regular visits to outside locations such as producer's offices.

WORK ENVIRONMENT 

  • This position operates in a home office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier and other standard office equipment.
