We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?
Data, analytics and AI are critical enablers of AXIS' strategic ambitions. The Insights & Analytics Lead – North America will be a hands-on technical leader who turns business questions into high-quality insights, analytical solutions and clear recommendations for North American underwriting teams.
This role is responsible for translating business requirements into well-defined data, analytics, data science and AI requirements. You will explore and analyse large and complex data sets, identify trends and opportunities, determine the most appropriate analytical approach, and communicate conclusions in ways that support better, faster and more informed decisions.
Working within an agile delivery model, you will partner closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Architects and Technology experts to design, test and deliver solutions that are practical, scalable and aligned to measurable business outcomes.
Reporting to the Insights & Analytics Director – North America, you will combine technical depth, business understanding and strong delivery skills. You will provide day-to-day technical leadership on initiatives while remaining personally involved in analysis, solution design and the development of analytical outputs.

What will you do in this role?

  • Translate Business Needs into Analytical and AI Requirements
    Partner with North American underwriting and business teams to understand business objectives, decision points, pain points and opportunities.
  • Translate business requirements into clear data, analytics, data science and AI requirements, including hypotheses, data needs, analytical methods, success measures and delivery acceptance criteria.
  • Challenge and refine requests to ensure the proposed solution addresses the underlying business problem and is proportionate to the value and complexity involved.
  • Recommend the right approach for each problem, whether descriptive or diagnostic analysis, reporting and visualisation, predictive modelling, machine learning, generative AI or workflow automation.
  • Deliver Hands-On Analysis and Insight
  • Frame analytical questions, develop hypotheses, select appropriate methods and validate findings before drawing conclusions.
  • Convert analysis into practical recommendations, explaining the business implications, limitations and actions required.
  • Identify opportunities where advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities could improve underwriting effectiveness, portfolio management, operational efficiency or customer outcomes.
  • Shape solution concepts and technical requirements, including use cases, user journeys, required data, model or AI behaviour, controls, evaluation criteria and expected business value.
  • Rapidly prototype analytical and AI-enabled solutions to test feasibility and value before wider development.
  • Work with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to support model development, testing, validation, deployment and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Ensure solutions are explainable, fit-for-purpose and developed in line with AXIS data, AI governance, security and responsible AI requirements.
  • Work as an active member of cross-functional agile delivery teams, partnering closely with Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Architects, Technology experts and business product owners.
  • Contribute technical analysis, solution design, backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, demonstrations, testing and retrospectives.
  • Promote reuse of common data products, analytical methods, models and components across the wider Insights & Analytics community.
  • Define and track outcome-focused success measures, using feedback and performance evidence to improve solutions after release.
  • Explain analytical and AI concepts in clear business language and build confidence in the appropriate use of data-driven insights.

Success Measures
Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Delivered solutions contribute to measurable improvements in underwriting effectiveness, portfolio insight, operational efficiency or customer outcomes.
  • Solutions use the right level of analytical sophistication for the problem and are practical, explainable and fit-for-purpose.
  • Strong collaboration and trusted working relationships are established across North America business teams, Data & Analytics and Technology.
  • Insights and solutions are adopted and used within day-to-day business decisions and workflows.
  • Analytical assets, methods and components are documented, reusable and continuously improved.

About you:
We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table. While there are qualifications and experiences we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might help you fulfil this role and contribute to our goals.
What you need to have:

Experience

  • A minimum of 7 years’ experience in analytics, business intelligence, data science or AI roles, with substantial hands-on experience analysing complex data and delivering data-driven solutions.
  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience in the insurance or reinsurance industry, ideally partnering with underwriting, portfolio management or specialty insurance business functions.
  • Demonstrated experience translating ambiguous business problems into structured analytical, data science or AI requirements and deliverables.
  • Experience delivering analysis or analytical products from initial discovery and data exploration through to recommendation, implementation and adoption.
  • Experience working as part of a cross-functional agile delivery team with data engineering, AI engineering, data science, architecture and technology colleagues.
  • Experience communicating complex analysis and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders through clear visualisations, written conclusions and presentations.
  • Strong practical skills in SQL and at least one analytical programming language, such as Python or R.
  • Good understanding of data science and machine learning methods, model evaluation and the lifecycle required to move analytical solutions into production.
  • A strong problem solver who combines technical depth with commercial judgement and a focus on practical business outcomes.
  • Clear and credible communicator who can present complex findings simply and adapt the message for technical and business audiences.
  • Collaborative and delivery-focused, with the ability to work effectively across business, Data & Analytics and Technology teams.
  • Comfortable working iteratively, managing ambiguity and balancing pace with quality, control and maintainability.

What we prefer you to have:

  • Experience in North American specialty or commercial insurance underwriting analytics.
  • Experience developing or deploying AI, machine learning or advanced analytical solutions into production in an underwriting or portfolio management context.
  • Experience with cloud data and AI platforms and modern development practices, such as version control, testing and reusable code.
  • Education: A degree or advanced degree in a relevant field, such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Analytics, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Role Factors:
Be in the office 3 days per week

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $160,000 to $185,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Reinsurance Claims Specialist
jobs.description_html:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance.  We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Claims Lead – Grade I

Job Family Grouping: Claims Group

Job Family: Claims Specialist

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

The Claims Specialist plays an important role in protecting AXIS Re's balance sheet, reputation, and client relationships through the timely, accurate, and consistent handling of reinsurance claims. The role supports effective claim resolution, sound reserving practices, and high-quality service to internal and external stakeholders while ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and regulatory requirements.

By working closely with underwriting, actuarial, finance, brokers, cedents, and fellow claims professionals, the Claims Specialist contributes to loss analysis, reserve monitoring, and portfolio understanding. Through disciplined claim management and effective communication, the role helps deliver reliable claims outcomes and supports informed business decision-making. Through effective communication and knowledge sharing, the Claims Specialist helps bridge the gap between claims activity, business strategy, and operational decision-making. The role transforms complex claims information, loss data, and emerging risk developments into practical insights that support underwriting, actuarial, finance, and management stakeholders.

Ultimately, the Claims Specialist helps AXIS Re maintain strong claims governance, operational excellence, and trusted client service while supporting the broader objectives of the Reinsurance Claims team.

What will you do in this role?


  • Handle assigned reinsurance claims and claim portfolios in accordance with AXIS Re claims guidelines, delegated authorities, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure claims are promptly and accurately documented, evaluated, reserved, and processed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Analyze claim submissions, loss notices, and supporting documentation to assess coverage, liability, financial exposure, and reporting requirements.
  • Identify and escalate coverage issues, large losses, accumulation concerns, and other material developments in a timely manner.
  • Maintain case reserves and monitor claim activity and loss development on assigned accounts.
  • Partner with underwriting, actuarial, finance, and legal teams to support effective claim management and informed business decision making.
  • Communicate directly with brokers, cedants, and other stakeholders regarding claim developments, information requests, coverage matters, and reporting requirements.
  • Participate in claims audits, including audit planning, file selection, audit attendance, preparation of audit reports, and communication of findings and recommendations.
  • Monitor legal, regulatory, and market developments that may impact claims handling, reserving practices, or portfolio performance.
  • Maintain high-quality claim files and ensure accurate, complete, and reliable claims data within company systems.
  • Contribute to management reporting, portfolio reviews, and other initiatives that support effective oversight of the claims portfolio.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including underwriting, actuarial, finance, brokers, cedants, auditors, and service providers.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance claims handling practices, operational efficiency, reporting capabilities, and data quality.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of training materials, desk guides, reference tools, and process documentation to promote consistency and operational effectiveness across the Claims team.
  • Translate complex claims, coverage, legal, and reserving concepts into clear and concise communications tailored to a variety of business audiences.
  • Support the effective use of data, reporting tools, automation, and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence solutions, to improve workflows and business processes.
  • Collaborate across global teams and functions to improve the quality, consistency, accessibility, and usability of claims information.
  • Contribute to a culture of learning, collaboration, and continuous professional development by sharing knowledge, best practices, and lessons learned.

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.


What you need to have:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in insurance and/or reinsurance claims handling.
  • Good understanding of insurance and reinsurance principles, coverage analysis, and claims handling practices.
  • Working knowledge of legal processes and laws applicable to insurance claims.
  • Familiarity with reinsurance customs and practices and laws applicable to reinsurance.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Experience using claims management systems; knowledge of SICS is beneficial.

What we prefer you to have:

  • Experience handling casualty, professional liability, cyber, specialty, or other complex insurance and reinsurance claims.
  • Experience participating in claims audits, portfolio reviews, or file quality assurance initiatives.
  • Experience working directly with brokers, cedants, reinsurers, underwriters, or other external stakeholders.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and familiarity with data visualization, reporting, or analytics tools such as Power BI.
  • Experience working in data-intensive environments and leveraging information to support business, operational, or claims-related decision making.
  • Familiarity with B2B operational processes and stakeholder engagement.
  • Interest in or experience supporting the use of automation, data solutions, artificial intelligence, or other emerging technologies within insurance or financial services environments.
  • Experience developing training materials, process documentation, job aids, or knowledge-sharing resources.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical, legal, financial, or operational concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • Experience supporting onboarding, mentoring, coaching, or training initiatives within a professional environment.
  • Knowledge of emerging issues, market developments, and trends affecting the insurance and reinsurance industry.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) designation preferred but not required.

Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Maintain a regular onsite presence of a minimum of three days per week, in line with AXIS Re office attendance expectations.
  • Travel occasionally to support claims audits, market meetings, and stakeholder engagement activities.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders including Underwriting, Actuarial, Finance, and Legal, as well as external partners such as cedants, brokers, auditors, and service providers.

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $90,000 to $120,000. The specific salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors, including the experience of the successful candidate and work location. In addition, all employees are eligible for competitive incentive opportunities based on overall corporate and individual performance.

You will also be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including medical plans for employees and their families, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid annual leave, and much more.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.description_html:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance.  We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?
Data, analytics and AI are critical enablers of AXIS' strategic ambitions. The Head of Insights & Analytics – Claims will lead the delivery of insights, analytics and AI solutions that support Claims teams in making better, faster and more informed decisions.
This role is accountable for translating Claims priorities into impactful data products, analytics solutions and AI-enabled capabilities that improve claims outcomes, operational efficiency, customer service, leakage management, reserving effectiveness and operational performance.
As the senior Insights & Analytics leader aligned to the Claims organisation, you will act as a strategic partner to Claims leadership, ensuring that data and AI investments are focused on measurable business value. You will work closely with the Claims, Reserving, Actuarial, Finance, Underwriting and Transformation teams to develop a coherent view of claims performance, emerging trends and opportunities for improvement across the claims lifecycle.
The role combines business partnership, people leadership and delivery accountability, ensuring that AXIS continues to evolve its use of analytics and AI to drive better claims outcomes and operational excellence.

What will you do in this role?
Strategic Partnership with Claims Leadership

  • Act as the primary Data & Analytics partner for Claims leadership
  • Develop a deep understanding of Claims priorities, challenges, operating models and strategic objectives.
  • Translate business needs into a prioritised portfolio of insights, analytics and AI initiatives.

Lead Delivery of Claims Insights & Analytics

  • Own the delivery of Claims-focused reporting, dashboards, analytics solutions and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Drive the evolution of Claims MI from operational reporting towards predictive and prescriptive insights.
  • Champion self-service analytics and scalable data products that enable Claims teams to access trusted information when needed.

Partner Closely with Reserving

  • Work closely with the Insights & Analytics Lead - Reserving and Reserving leadership to ensure alignment between Claims and Reserving analytics priorities.
  • Support a consistent view of claims performance, loss development, claims trends and portfolio movements across Claims and Reserving.
    Lead AI and Automation Opportunities
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, advanced analytics, automation and innovative technologies across the Claims function.
  • Work with Analytics, AI Delivery and Insights Delivery teams to ensure solutions can be implemented effectively and sustainably.
  • Promote responsible, controlled and value-focused adoption of AI capabilities within Claims.

Deliver Business Value

  • Ensure analytics and AI initiatives are clearly linked to business outcomes.
  • Define measures of success and track the value delivered by solutions.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement and evidence-based decision making.

Stakeholder Engagement and Influence

  • Build trusted relationships with senior Claims leaders and business stakeholders.
  • Act as a bridge between business priorities and technical delivery teams.
  • Communicate complex analytical concepts in a way that is understandable and actionable for non-technical audiences.

Leadership and Team Development

  • Lead and develop a team of Insights & Analytics professionals aligned to the Claims value stream.
  • Encourage reuse of common solutions, patterns and best practices across the wider Insights & Analytics function.

Governance and Standards

  • Ensure solutions are delivered in line with AXIS data governance, AI governance and information management standards
  • Partner with Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Operations and Platform teams to ensure Claims solutions are built on trusted data foundations.

Experience

  • Experience leading analytics, business intelligence, data or AI teams.
  • A minimum of 10 years’ experience in analytics, business intelligence, data or AI, including at least 3 years leading teams.
  • Experience partnering with Claims, Insurance Operations, Actuarial or Reserving functions within the insurance industry.
  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience in the insurance or reinsurance industry, partnering with Claims, Insurance Operations, Actuarial or Reserving functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into practical analytics and AI solutions.
  • Experience delivering measurable business outcomes through the use of analytics, data products or AI capabilities.
  • Experience directly managing a team of at least 6 people, including team leads or senior individual contributors.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of insurance claims processes, operational performance measures and claims data.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution.
  • Knowledge of modern analytics, business intelligence and AI technologies.
  • Ability to operate effectively within a complex, matrix organisation.

Leadership Characteristics

  • Business-focused and outcome-oriented.
  • Collaborative and relationship-driven.
  • Able to simplify complexity and provide clear direction.
  • Comfortable leading change and challenging the status quo.

What we prefer you to have:

  • At least 3 years’ experience in claims analytics within specialty insurance or reinsurance.
  • Experience deploying AI or machine learning solutions into production within claims or insurance operations.
  • Education: An advanced degree in a relevant field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or similar) is highly desirable, or equivalent professional experience.

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Business Impact of Insights: Demonstrable improvements in claims outcomes, operational performance, claims handling efficiency and decision-making driven by insights, analytics and AI solutions.
  • Stakeholder Trust & Adoption: Strong engagement and satisfaction from Claims leadership and business stakeholders, with analytics products routinely used to support business decisions.
  • Delivery of Strategic Priorities: Successful delivery of agreed Claims analytics and AI priorities, with clear linkage to business value and strategic objectives.
  • Innovation with Control: Increased use of AI, automation and modern analytics approaches within Claims

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $175,000 to $200,000 (NY), Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is [Exempt/Non-Exempt] for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Job Description: Head of Finance Transformation
 

Reporting To: Chief Financial Officer
 

About the Team
 

The Finance function at AXIS plays a central role in enabling enterprise strategy, capital stewardship, regulatory integrity, and performance insight. As AXIS continues to evolve, Finance is undertaking significant transformation to modernize its operating model, strengthen scalability and controls, and enhance its strategic contribution to the business.


This role sits within the CFO organization and operates as a senior Finance transformation leader, working alongside the CFO and Finance Leadership Team to modernize Finance processes, capabilities, systems and ways of working across a multi-year horizon.


How does this role contribute to our collective success?
 

The Head of Finance Transformation is accountable for shaping and delivering the Finance transformation strategy and roadmap in line with Finance priorities and AXIS business objectives. Acting as the CFO’s senior adviser on Finance transformation, the role ensures Finance has the operating model, capabilities, technology and ways of working needed to support AXIS’s strategic objectives over a multi-year horizon.


The role exists to improve Finance’s scalability, decision support, control maturity and adoption of modernized ways of working, helping Finance operate as a more integrated and insight-driven partner to the business.


Scope
 

Transformation is delivered through functional leadership, not around it. The role develops and recommends Finance transformation standards, target-state designs, and prioritization approaches, while execution accountability remains with Finance functional leaders.


The role partners across Finance (e.g., FP&A, Controllership, Finance Operations, Treasury, Investor Relations, Tax, and other Finance teams) and with enterprise partners (BTS, Data, Operations, Underwriting, Actuarial, Risk, and others) to drive integrated solutions and consistent adoption of the future state.
The role owns the Finance transformation strategy, roadmap, governance and benefits framework. The Chief of Staff integrates transformation progress, dependencies and decisions into the broader CFO agenda and executive operating cadence.


What will you do in this role?
 

  • Define and maintain the Finance Transformation strategy, roadmap, and target operating model aligned to Finance priorities and approved investment plans.
  • Serve as the senior Finance transformation adviser to the CFO, providing recommendations on transformation investment, capability development, modernization priorities and key decisions requiring CFO or Finance Leadership Team direction.
  • Shape and coordinate the Finance technology, data and analytics roadmap in partnership with BTS, Data and Risk, embedding advanced analytics and AI-enabled capabilities into Finance workflows such as forecasting, variance analysis, controls monitoring and management reporting.
  • Establish and lead governance for the Finance transformation portfolio, including recommendations on investment trade-offs, sequencing, prioritization and resource allocation to ensure initiatives are value-driven, risk-managed and controlled.
  • Build alignment across the Finance Leadership Team and key stakeholders on the Finance target operating model, transformation roadmap, design standards and adoption of future-state processes and ways of working, reinforcing accountability and addressing resistance as needed.
  • Provide oversight of major Finance transformation programs, ensuring delivery aligns to strategic intent, regulatory requirements, and enterprise risk appetite—while monitoring benefits and outcomes (efficiency, effectiveness, control strength, analytic maturity, and business value).
  • Partner with the CFO and Finance Leadership Team to evaluate Finance operating structures, resource deployment, and capability requirements needed to support future business priorities.
  • Contribute to the development and enhancement of Finance policies, operating standards, governance frameworks, and transformation practices that improve effectiveness, scalability, and organizational performance.
  • Represent Finance transformation in senior leadership forums, contributing to broader enterprise strategy and change discussions.
     

Outcomes and how success is measured

jobs.description_html:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance.  We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Design, develop, and operationalize secure agentic AI capabilities in risk & security operations

  • Build, deploy, and maintain AI-powered security agents to augment detection, investigation, and response workflows
  • Identify high-value use cases where AI agents can accelerate analyst productivity and improve outcomes
  • Continuously validate agent performance, accuracy, and reliability in real-world operations

Ensure responsible and secure use of AI across risk & security operations

  • Enforce strong security controls for enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry)
  • Mitigate AI-specific risks including data leakage, prompt injection, oversharing, and unauthorized access
  • Establish evaluation practices for agent accuracy, hallucination risk, false positives/false negatives, failure modes, explainability, audit logging, and measurable operational impact.
  • Ensure human-in-the-loop oversight to include analysts challenge, refine, and retrain AI-driven outcomes

Implement and manage data protection controls for AI and enterprise data

  • Deploy and optimize Microsoft Purview capabilities (DLP, Information Protection, Insider Risk) across M365 and AI platforms
  • Implement DLP controls for AI interactions and outputs to prevent sensitive data exposure
  • Monitor and tune data protection policies to meet regulatory and business requirements

Secure AI agents, automation, and data flows

  • Define and enforce access controls, data handling policies, and auditability for AI agents and automated workflows
  • Ensure all AI-driven processes align with Zero Trust and least privilege principles
  • Evaluate and onboard new AI tools and agents with a security-first approach

Operational monitoring, detection, and response

  • Monitor AI platform activity and data usage to detect anomalies, misuse, or policy violations
  • Support incident response and investigations involving AI systems and data exposure scenarios
  • Integrate AI agent workflows directly with SIEM/XDR platforms to allow autonomous context enrichment and preliminary incident triage.
  • Support enterprise rollout of AI governance and data security programs

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.


What you need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field (Master’s preferred), OR equivalent experience leading enterprise-scale security engineering initiatives
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, data protection, or security engineering
  • Proven experience designing and securing enterprise AI platforms, including:
    • Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Azure AI Foundry
    • Governance, data grounding controls, prompt injection protections, and AI risk management
    • Development or oversight of security controls for AI-driven workflows and autonomous/agent-based systems.
  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft security and compliance ecosystems, including:
    • Microsoft Purview (end-to-end deployment, governance, and optimization)
    • Microsoft 365, Azure, and Entra ID security architecture
    • Collaboration platforms (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams) with a strong focus on data protection and insider risk
  • Proven expertise in Data Security and Protection, including:
    • Data Loss Prevention (DLP) strategy, engineering, and tuning at scale
    • Data classification, sensitivity labeling, and lifecycle management
    • Insider Risk Management and Information Protection programs
  • Demonstrated ability to architect and lead enterprise security solutions, including:
    • Defining strategy, roadmaps, and reference architectures
    • Driving cross-functional initiatives across Security, IT, Legal, and Business teams
    • Acting as a technical authority and escalation point for complex security challenges
  • Strong development and automation capabilities, including:
    • Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, TypeScript or similar languages; secure API integration; Microsoft Graph and security platform APIs; CI/CD practices; test automation; and experience deploying AI-enabled workflows using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, or comparable cloud-native services.
    • Building automation pipelines for detection, response, and data governance workflows
  • Experience with security analytics and telemetry, including:
    • Interpreting logs and signals from Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoints, and AI systems
    • Supporting detection engineering and threat-informed defense strategies
  • Ability to lead in complex, ambiguous environments, including:
    • Rapidly assessing risk and prioritizing high-impact outcomes
    • Driving technical decision-making with incomplete information
    • Mentoring junior engineers and elevating overall team capability

What we prefer you to have:

  • Experience with prompt engineering techniques or semantic caching.
  • A firm understanding of the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs.
  • Experience working with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) tools.
  • Experience supporting data leakage or insider threat programs
  • Relevant Cybersecurity certifications
    • AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate)
    • AI-900 (Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals)
    • SC-400 (Information Protection Administrator)
    • MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator)
    • CompTIA Security+
    • CompTIA SecAI+

Role Factors:

In this role, you will support enterprise-wide data protection and governance initiatives leveraging Microsoft 365 platforms. This includes safeguarding sensitive data, enabling secure collaboration, and supporting emerging AI technologies like Copilot by ensuring proper data classification and protection standards are in place. The work is highly visible and directly impacts how the organization securely manages and scales its data environment.


What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $90K - $110K Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is exempt for FLSA purposes.


This posting is for an existing vacancy.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?
 

Reporting to the Chief Operations Officer, this role drives transformation and optimization across AXIS Global Operations teams. It ensures alignment between business needs and delivery teams, supporting strategic goals and improving operational efficiency through agile product ownership.
 

What will you do in this role?

  • Define and communicate a product vision and roadmap aligned with AXIS strategy and stakeholder needs.

  • Lead operational readiness for product launches, ensuring systems and processes are aligned.

  • Translate requirements into user stories and acceptance criteria for agile delivery teams.

  • Manage and prioritize the Operations product backlog to focus on high-impact initiatives.

  • Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups with delivery teams.

  • Track and report Agile delivery metrics to monitor team performance and product impact.

  • Champion Agile principles and coach team members on best practices and continuous improvement.

  • Ensure user feedback is continuously gathered and integrated into product iterations.

  • Empower cross-functional teams to make decisions and deliver value independently.

  • Use Agile tools to manage backlogs, track progress, and communicate priorities.

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities, and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About You
 

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise. While some qualifications are required, we welcome diverse backgrounds that support our goals.
 

What you need to have:

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Insurance with minimum 3 years of experience as a Product Owner in an Agile environment

  • Background in Operations transformation and insurance systems integration.

  • Knowledge of P&C Commercial and Specialty lines, including North American and Global Operations.

  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to express complex ideas clearly and visually.

  • Familiarity with Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or related field.

What we prefer you to have:

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar certification.

  • Experience with AI tools in Specialty Insurance Operations.

Role Factors
 

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week

  • Travel internationally as needed

What we offer
 

We expect to offer a base salary between for $175,000 and $260,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

You will also receive incentive compensation based on performance.
Benefits include medical plans, wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and more.
 

This role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

While the focus of this role will be on U.S. operations, the Accident & Health (A&H) Business Unit is growing internationally. You'll collaborate with U.S., Canadian and cross-functional partners to support broader organizational goals. If you enjoy problem-solving across new markets and want to grow beyond pure regulatory work into corporate and strategic advisory matters, this role is for you.

You will serve as a day-to-day legal advisor for U.S. healthcare, regulatory, and compliance matters, translating complex laws, rules and regulations into clear, actionable business guidance across departments. You will provide guidance on new products launches, product revisions, enhancements and implementation of services.

This individual will work hand-in-hand with all A&H business units including Actuarial, Claims, Finance, IT, Product, Operations and Underwriting, as well as interact with TPAs, vendors and service partners. The position will require a strict adherence to corporate policies and business ethics, a strong sense of individual responsibility and an attention to detail. A team player mentality is required as the position will interact with a diverse group of personalities.

You will support the A&H Business Unit Segments:

  • AXIS Group Benefits

  • Specialty Accident & Health

  • Pet Insurance


What will you do in this role?

  • Work with A&H Product Development, Marketing, Underwriting, Claims and Operations: 

  •  Provide legal review and practical guidance for A&H product launches, marketing campaigns and implementation of new products and services

  • Provide regulatory advice and legal review of advertising and marketing materials related to the sale of A&H products, including consumer-facing disclosures, enrollment platforms, customer communications and fulfillment packages

  • Draft, review and negotiate A&H insurance and reinsurance transactional agreements such as NDAs, insurance program manager agreements, administrative services agreements, letters of credit, security agreements, letters of authority, vendor contracting, third party claim handling agreements, etc.

  • Responsible for company and vendor regulatory fraud training and reporting for U.S. legal entities

  • Provide legal assistance in connection with the preparation and submission of A&H form and rate filings, including responding to form/rate filing objections from Departments of Insurance

  • Provide legal assistance in response to complaints, regulatory inquiries and market conduct investigations/exams

Senior Analyst, Operational Readiness - Claims Shared Services, Axis Global Claims

AXIS is seeking a Senior Analyst, Operational Readiness, to join the Global Claims Shared Services (GCSS) team. Reporting to the Head of Optimization, Claims Shared Services, this role ensures approved technology, process, vendor and operating model changes are ready for implementation, adopted by AXIS Global Claims, and stabilized into business-as-usual operations.

The role is responsible for business readiness, cutover, adoption, operational handoff, hypercare and BAU transition, but does not own requirements, solution design, product roadmaps, project delivery or portfolio prioritization.

Working with Product Owners, business sponsors, project managers, technology teams, vendors and operational leaders, the role confirms Claims is prepared to receive, use and sustain new processes and technology.

The Successful Candidate Will Be Responsible For:

Operational Readiness & Cutover

  • Operational readiness assessments and readiness sign-off processes for approved technology, process, vendor and operating model changes, ensuring assessments are completed on time and aligned to defined go-live criteria.
  • Develop and maintain readiness frameworks, checklists and go-live criteria that establish clear expectations for operational capability, resource readiness and support model readiness.
  • Lead business cutover planning and execution activities against approved readiness, handoff and service acceptance plans.
  • Coordinate business operational handoffs and service acceptance activities, with clear ownership, success criteria and support model handoff.
  • Identify, document and escalate readiness gaps to accountable owners before implementation.
  • Establish transition-to-BAU plans, stabilization criteria and measurable success indicators for each implementation.

Training & Business Adoption

  • Implementation communications and stakeholder readiness plans, ensuring impacted users understand what is changing, when it is changing and what action is required.
  • Coordinate business training delivery and completion tracking, with the goal of meeting training completion and stakeholder preparedness targets before go-live.
  • Measure user adoption, operational utilization and preparedness to adopt new capabilities before and after implementation.
  • Identify adoption and readiness gaps before implementation and coordinate remediation with accountable owners.
  • Support post-deployment adoption reviews and feedback loops to improve future readiness execution.

Process Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Support development of functional process maps, SOPs, workflow documentation and operational playbooks required for successful go-live and BAU transition.
  • Ensure functional process documentation remains current following operational or system changes.
  • Support establishment of centralized knowledge repositories and documentation standards that enable consistent sustainment after implementation.
  • Coordinate documentation, SOP, job aid and knowledge repository updates as part of implementation closure.

Hypercare & Stabilization

  • Lead business hypercare activities following go-live, with clear issue intake, escalation and closure disciplines.
  • Monitor adoption, operational performance and issue trends during stabilization, with focus on reducing unresolved issues and supporting faster stabilization.
  • Coordinate business inputs to issue triage, escalation and closure during the transition period.
  • Track vendor and service readiness issues, knowledge transfer actions and adherence to agreed operating procedures.
  • Coordinate lessons learned and transition closure activities, ensuring insights are captured and applied to improve future readiness, cutover and stabilization execution.

Reporting & Value Realization

  • Partner with Global MI & Insights to support adoption, utilization and benefits reporting.
  • Track readiness, stabilization, adoption and implementation outcome metrics to confirm approved changes are landing effectively.
  • Support development of implementation scorecards and executive reporting materials that highlight readiness status, adoption trends, stabilization issues and transition-to-BAU progress.
  • Assist with post-implementation reviews and outcome measurement, including lessons learned, realized benefits and continuous improvement actions.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Claims Operations, Claims Optimization, Compliance & QA, Third Party Management, Product Owners, Technology, Data & Analytics and Claims Business Leadership to support successful readiness outcomes.
  • Clarify readiness, cutovers, adoption and BAU handoff ownership across impacted teams.
  • Provide visibility to readiness gaps, operational dependencies and transition risks for accountable business owners to resolve.
  • Foster strong working relationships across GCSS and partner teams to ensure change lands effectively and is sustained in BAU.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in business operations, operational readiness, project coordination, business analysis, change management, claims operations or process improvement; claims project or optimization experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting implementation, technology deployment, operational change, business transformation, vendor transition or BAU handoff activities.
  • Strong organization, communication, analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to develop and maintain documentation, SOPs, job aids, training materials and knowledge resources.
  • Experience with claims systems, operational workflows, insurance operations, AI, automation or systems modernization preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Copilot, SharePoint, Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience required; familiarity with project management, change management or process improvement methodologies preferred.
  • Some Travel is associated with this role.

Locations

  • New Jersey
  • New York

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of 125-140K. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is [Exempt/Non-Exempt] for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance.  We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Senior Underwriter - Management Liability

D&O, EPLI, FLI and Crime

The Senior Underwriter, Private Company Management Liability (D&O, EPL, Fiduciary Liability, and Crime) will act within established guidelines and market to analyze, review, evaluate, and monitor new and renewal accounts for our Private Company Management Liability Practice. Senior Underwriters exercise independent judgment in processing accounts and managing underwriting activities. Sr. Underwrites typical support of $5 Million in GWP.

Candidate Profile

We seek a Senior Underwriter with expertise in Private Company Management Liability (including D&O, EPL, Fiduciary Liability, and Crime) to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a proven history of success in a top-tier Insurance carrier and will focus on developing a comprehensive Private Company Management Liability book that targets private clients under $3billion in revenues.

Qualified candidates should have strong connections within Management Liability Retail broker channels. They should be experienced in portfolio management, including soliciting submissions, underwriting analysis, preparing and issuing indications/quotations/binders, and marketing.

In addition to technical expertise, we are looking for a candidate with an executive presence skilled in communication, influencing, and building solid relationships that add value to our business and contribute to longer-term strategic initiatives.

Work Profile

The work profile for this exciting position entails a unique hybrid work environment and being present in our bustling Chicago office.

In addition to the hybrid work environment, this position requires regular travel to meet with brokers and clients face-to-face. As part of this role, you will also attend industry and company events. These events are an excellent opportunity to network with industry leaders, learn about the latest industry trends and innovations, and stay up-to-date with the latest developments in your field.

Key Duties and Responsibilities


  • Retain existing business while strategically prospecting new opportunities, targeting Private Company Management Liability.
  • Manage a book of business regarding new lines, renewals, and cross-marketing of product lines within AXIS, typically more than $5 Million in GWP.
  • Meet established divisional servicing objectives related to quote turnaround, policy issuance, phone management, renewal management, file maintenance, and documentation.
  • Analyze and underwrite individual risks. Develop appropriate limit structure, retention, pricing, and endorsements within underwriting guidelines.
  • Continue to develop and update product and underwriting knowledge.
  • Participate in prospecting by identifying new business targets, opportunities, and work closely with retail brokers to ensure the department receives the opportunity to offer proposals. Make strategy recommendations to the supervisor.
  • Review and evaluate primarily new business based on company underwriting guidelines, competition, and geographic focus. Develop strategy and make recommendations.
  • Perform the required number of broker marketing calls, including out-of-state travel as needed.
  • Solicit new accounts, gather market intelligence, and deliver up-to-date department information on products and services.
  • Manage select agency relationships to ensure objectives are achieved.
  • Maintain up-to-date familiarity with economic and legal factors impacting the department’s business lines and the insurance industry.
  • Participate in special projects department initiatives.
  • Coordinate with branch marketing representatives and profit center representatives to allow for cross-marketing.

Required Education/Training & Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years’ experience in underwriting Management Liability (D&O, EPL, FL, and Crime)
  • Direct background targeting insureds with revenues under $3billion in Revenue
  • Strong presentation and people skills
  • Ability to establish broker relationships within the region.
  • In-depth knowledge of management liability products and market trends
  • Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong broker relationships
  • Experience with underwriting systems and risk modeling tools.
  • Adaptability to changing market conditions and emerging risks.
  • Team player with a collaborative approach to problem-solving
  • Self-motivated with excellent time management and organizational skills.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development

We expect to offer a base salary of $145K to $165K for this position. The specific salary offer will be based on an assessment of various factors, including the successful candidate's experience and work location. In addition, all employees are eligible for competitive incentive targets, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, we offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package that includes medical plans for employees and their families, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Associate
jobs.description_html:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance.  We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Job Description: Senior Tax Associate

About the Team

The North America Tax team supports tax reporting, planning, and compliance across the U.S., Canada, and Bermuda. The team partners with Finance, Legal, HR, Underwriting, Operations, and external advisors to ensure accurate reporting and strong governance. The Senior Tax Associate plays a key role in delivering timely and reliable tax outcomes.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

This role strengthens AXIS’ global tax function by supporting accurate tax reporting, maintaining compliance across multiple jurisdictions, and improving processes that support financial integrity. The Senior Tax Associate helps ensure AXIS meets regulatory requirements while supporting business decisions with clear and reliable tax insights.

What will you be doing in this role?

  • Supporting day‑to‑day tax activities for the U.S., Canada, and Bermuda

  • Assisting with quarterly GAAP and STAT tax provisions under ASC 740 and SSAP 101

  • Partnering with international tax teams to align global provisions with U.S. GAAP

  • Helping consolidate global tax calculations for management reporting

  • Supporting internal and external reporting, including Board materials and annual tax footnotes

  • Coordinating compliance activities across U.S., Canadian, and Bermuda tax regimes

  • Supporting withholding tax documentation, including residency certificates and FATCA

  • Performing tax research to interpret authoritative guidance

  • Responding to audits and notices across multiple jurisdictions

  • Maintaining accurate process documentation and contributing to internal training

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About you:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What we’re looking for from you:

  • Possess a CPA or Tax LLM

  • Bring at least three years of tax experience in public accounting or a multinational company with extensive experience with ASC 740, account reconciliation, tax compliance and return-to-provision analysis

  • Demonstrate strong technical tax knowledge across U.S. federal, state, and indirect taxes

  • Demonstrate familiarity with BEAT, Pillar II and other international tax concepts

  • Apply knowledge of SOX 404 requirements

  • Use advanced Microsoft Office skills

  • Communicate clearly and build strong relationships across teams

  • Manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment

  • Show strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to detail

Role factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Be in the office 3 days per week

  • Travel within the U.S. and internationally as needed

What we offer:

You will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid annual leave, and much more.

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $90,000 to $110,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance.

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is exempt for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Accident and Health Senior Claims Specialist (Provider XS/ESL)
jobs.description_html:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance.  We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

AXIS is seeking an experienced Accident & Health Senior Claims Specialist to provide technical claims expertise and oversight across a diverse product portfolio. This role partners with Third-Party Administrators (TPAs), Managing General Underwriters (MGUs), underwriting, actuarial, legal, compliance, and operations to support consistent claims administration, strong partner oversight, and regulatory compliance.

The position is primarily focused on Employer Stop Loss, HMO/Managed Care, Medical Excess, and Provider Excess products, while also supporting the broader Specialty Accident & Health portfolio.

What You'll Do

Serve as a senior claims resource for complex, high-severity, and escalated matters, including appeals and authority referrals.

• Conduct claims and operational audits of TPAs and MGUs, report findings, and monitor corrective actions.

• Support due diligence reviews and onboarding of delegated claims partners.

• Monitor compliance with delegated authority, service standards, and claims handling guidelines.

• Coordinate responses to complaints, regulatory inquiries, attorney correspondence, carrier reviews, and benefit interpretation requests.

• Analyze claims and operational data to identify trends, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.

• Partner across functions to support product performance, business initiatives, and process improvements.

What You'll Bring

• 4–6 years of relevant Accident & Health claims experience.

• Strong expertise in Employer Stop Loss, HMO/Managed Care, Medical Excess, and Provider Excess products.

• Experience overseeing TPAs, MGUs, delegated claims operations, and claims audits.

• Knowledge of medical claims, provider reimbursement, cost containment, exposure evaluation, and reserving.

• Knowledge of ERISA and applicable state claims handling requirements.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-management skills.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience; insurance designation preferred.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Employer Stop Loss, HMO/Managed Care, Medical Excess, and Provider Excess products, along with working knowledge of Specialty Accident & Health lines, including Leisure Travel, Excess Accident, Pet, Firefighter Line of Duty, Limited Medical Benefits, and Voluntary Benefits.

Work Environment • Hybrid schedule with an expectation of three days per week in the office. • Periodic travel within the U.S. and Canada to support audits and business initiatives.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range is $95,000–$130,000, based on experience and location. AXIS also offers incentive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; health and wellness programs; retirement plans; tuition reimbursement; and paid time off. Accident & Health Senior Claims Specialist

Why AXIS?

Join a growing Accident & Health organization where you can influence claims quality, strengthen delegated partner oversight, and contribute across a broad portfolio of products. This role offers meaningful collaboration with experienced business partners and the opportunity to help shape claims practices and operational improvements.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.description_html:

Job Description: North America Programs/MGA Cash and Receivable Lead Manager

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

This role will be part of the North America Insurance Premium Accounting team.  The team is responsible for collection of all premium receivables and cash allocations for the Insurance premium written on US writing companies – including Canada.  This team is instrumental in making sure premiums are paid timely and are key to the cash flow of the company overall.

What will you do in this role?

  • Lead the North America Insurance Premium Accounting team - providing guidance on how to resolve differences/issues on cash allocations and premium receivables and assist in escalation process if required.

  • Ensure the team is following up on premium receivables and cash variances as expected.  Escalate items where internal/external contacts are not responding timely

  • Work in conjunction with the internal departments and external brokers to research and resolve any outstanding issues and/or inquiries.

  • Communicate with brokers and Axis internal customers on past due premium receivables.

  • Review the overdue receivables report produced by the BPO vendor and work with Axis internal departments and/or brokers to resolve discrepancies.

  • Track the entry of the cash receipts into the premium accounting system by the BPO vendor daily while ensuring adherence to established process and delivery standards.  Ensuring controls are being followed by the BPO vendor for cash processing.

  • Month-end close processing for the legacy system

  • Review and approve bank reconciliations produced by the BPO vendor

  • Review and authorize disbursement requests.

  • Assist the BPO team in researching issues.

  • Conduct other duties as assigned.

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance or equivalent work experience.

  • Minimum of 5 years P&C insurance industry experience

  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of related automated financial systems.

  • Demonstration of strong software skills including Excel, Access, and Outlook.

What we prefer you to have:

  • Excellent communication, analytical and proven problem-solving skills with a commitment to meeting daily, weekly, and monthly deadlines.

  • Hands-on manager that will dive into details

  • Detail oriented, deadline driven, organized, able to handle multiple tasks while working independently or as part of a team.

  • Highly motivated and dedicated to contributing to the growth and success of the company.

  • Problem solver – identification, analysis, recommend, implement.

  • Ability to prioritize and learn quickly.

  • BPO management experience or equivalent work experience

Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Be in the office 3 days per week – with the exception of the last week of the month for month-end

  • Be flexible during month-end with higher work demands

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $95,000 to $115,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.description_html:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance.  We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture.  As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Job Description: Strategic Sourcing Operations Lead

About the Team
 

The Strategic Sourcing & Procurement team helps AXIS make informed supplier, sourcing, contracting, and purchasing decisions. The team partners with business stakeholders to manage supplier value, improve procurement discipline, support contract governance, and identify opportunities to reduce cost, risk, and complexity across the organization.


How does this role contribute to our collective success?
 

The Strategic Sourcing Operations Lead supports effective procurement decision-making by providing analysis, sourcing coordination, supplier research, contract administration, and stakeholder support across assigned spend categories. The role helps AXIS improve savings visibility, contract discipline, supplier performance, and procurement governance while building future capability within the Strategic Sourcing & Procurement function.
 

What will you do in this role?

  • Supporting Category Managers with category plans, sourcing pipelines, savings trackers, supplier documentation, and leadership-ready updates.

  • Coordinating sourcing activities by managing documentation, supplier communications, timelines, bid analysis, stakeholder meetings, and recommendation materials.

  • Analyzing spend, supplier, contract, and pricing information to identify savings, consolidation, risk reduction, and process improvement opportunities.

  • Managing contract administration activities by tracking renewals, expiration dates, notice periods, pricing obligations, service commitments, and key contractual requirements.

  • Preparing contract summaries, renewal options, supplier comparison materials, total cost summaries, dashboards, reports, and other decision-support materials.

  • Conducting supplier research and market scans to identify potential vendors, alternative supply options, emerging providers, market trends, and supplier risks.

  • Supporting supplier onboarding, due diligence, performance tracking, issue follow-up, supplier business reviews, and compliance documentation.

  • Serving as a day-to-day procurement operations contact for assigned internal stakeholders and helping them navigate sourcing, contracting, onboarding, and procurement processes.

  • Maintaining accurate procurement records, templates, process documentation, trackers, systems data, and audit-ready supporting materials.

  • Escalating complex commercial, contractual, supplier performance, governance, or risk-related matters to Category Managers or senior procurement professionals when appropriate.

  • You may also be asked to perform other reasonable duties, as required, to support the needs of the business.


About You
 

What we’re looking for:
 

  • Possess a bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Operations, or a related field, or demonstrate equivalent relevant experience.

  • Demonstrate experience supporting procurement, sourcing, supplier management, contract administration, finance, consulting, operations, data analytics, or a related business support function.

  • Able to analyze data, prepare reports, identify trends, and translate findings into practical business insights and recommendations.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, records, and stakeholder requests with accuracy and consistent follow-through.

  • Demonstrate experience working with contracts, suppliers, purchasing processes, business stakeholders, or highly transactional operational work.

  • Able to communicate clearly with internal stakeholders and suppliers, including summarizing information, documenting requirements, and preparing concise materials for review.

  • Able to work independently on routine and lower-risk matters while recognizing when to escalate complex commercial, contractual, supplier, or risk-related issues.

  • Demonstrate a service-oriented, collaborative, curious, and proactive approach to supporting stakeholders and building procurement capability.

  • Possess working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including the ability to organize, compare, and analyze data; experience with pivot tables, lookup formulas, or dashboards is preferred.

  • Experience with procurement, sourcing, contract lifecycle, spend analytics, reporting, or supplier management platforms is preferred.

Role Factors
 

  • This is a hybrid role with onsite office attendance required at least 3 days a week minimum.

  • This role may require participation in supplier or stakeholder meetings across different time zones, depending on business needs.

  • Travel is not expected to be a regular requirement, but occasional travel may be required for business meetings or supplier-related activity.

What we offer
 

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary of $76k to $95k in Alpharetta, Georgia. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.
 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate performance and your individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.
 

Where this role is based in the United States of America, the FLSA exemption status should be reviewed and confirmed by HR before posting.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
