jobs.title: Assistant Controller
jobs.description_html:
*****NO RECRUITERS PLEASE*****

Assistant Controller (CPA Required) | Hybrid

Experienced Senior Accountants and Accounting Managers with an active CPA license are encouraged to apply. We are seeking professionals with expertise in budget preparation, leadership of month-end close processes, team management, and driving process improvement initiatives.

POSITION SUMMARY

Windward Risk Managers is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant Controller (CPA Required) to support the Controller in leading the organization's accounting and financial reporting functions. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for overseeing month-end close. financial reporting, budgeting, cost allocation, financial analysis, and accounting operations while providing guidance and mentorship to the accounting team.

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in financial reporting, budgeting, and process improvement, along with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Hybrid Schedule: This position offers a hybrid schedule of four days in the office and one day remote following the initial training period. During training (up to six months), the position is fully onsite five days per week.
 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

General Ledger and Financial Reporting

  • Lead month-end closing and preparation of monthly internal financial statements and reporting packages.
  • Review journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and reports.
  • Work closely with the Commissions team to develop, analyze, and reconcile reports and statements.
  • Support Accounts Payable and Claims Billing functions as needed.
  • Train and mentor junior staff.
  • Assist with annual audit preparations.
  • Assist with system reviews and process improvements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Budgeting & Financial Analysis

  • Lead the annual operating budget process in coordination with department heads.
  • Maintain department-level budgets and support models.
  • Prepare monthly budget-to-actual variance analyses.
  • Partner with department leaders to review variances and support corrective actions.
  • Ensure budgets align with organizational objectives and cost structures.

Cost Allocation & Expense Management

  • Develop, document, and maintain cost allocation methodologies across departments, entities, and cost centers.
  • Ensure cost allocations are applied consistently, accurately, and in accordance with internal policies.
  • Collaborate with Accounting to reconcile allocated costs to the general ledger and resolve discrepancies.
  • Assesses allocation methodologies periodically to ensure continued appropriateness and transparency.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune’s Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting
  • Active CPA License (Required)
  • More than five years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in publicly traded and multi-entity environments
  • Experience in budgeting, cost analysis, and cost allocation
  • Experience leading month-end close
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and meeting deadlines

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas and financial models
  • Solid understanding of general ledger accounting and expense structures
  • Ability to communicate financial concepts to non-financial audiences
  • Proven ability to collaborate across departments
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Work Authorization Requirement:

  • This role requires permanent U.S. work authorization and does not offer employer sponsorship now or in the future.

​​​​WRM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

Notice to Third Party Agencies: WRM does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting firms. Absent a signed Service Agreement by WRM’s Human Resources Department, WRM reserves the right to pursue and hire these candidates without financial obligation to recruiters or agencies.

jobs.title: Business Analyst I, II, III (Personal & Commercial Residential Insurance)
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with solid expertise in personal and/or commercial residential property insurance to support and enhance our Policy and/or Claims Administration systems. This role will partner with business stakeholders and technology teams to analyze workflows, define requirements, support system enhancements, and resolve production issues that impact critical insurance operations.

This position may be filled at the BA I, BA II, or BA III level, depending on the candidate’s experience, skills, and demonstrated ability to work independently, lead initiatives, and influence outcomes. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, regulated environment with evolving priorities.

Essential Functions:

Business & Systems Analysis

  • Partner directly with Underwriting, Product, Operations, Compliance, Claims, and Technology teams to gather and document business requirements
  • Translate underwriting and/or claims guidelines, eligibility rules, rates, forms, endorsements, and workflows into functional system requirements
  • Support enhancements and configuration of online quote/bind applications and policy/claims administration systems
  • Create user stories, business process flows, requirement documentation, acceptance criteria, and traceability artifacts
  • Analyze impacts of product or regulatory changes to system functionality and business processes
  • Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned to support business objectives.

Project Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Participate in or lead requirements workshops, discovery sessions, and backlog refinement meetings.
  • Manage changing priorities and scope while ensuring requirements remain clear, documented, and approved.
  • Participate in testing validation, defect triage, and production implementation activities
  • Provide clear, timely communication and status updates to stakeholders.

Documentation & Quality Assurance

  • Create and maintain documentation while ensuring Confluence is consistently updated and serves as the single source of truth for requirements including workflows, business rules, system behaviors, and configuration details.
  • Develop and execute test plans, track defects and coordinate fixes.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and compliance expectations.

Production Support & Issue Resolution

  • Troubleshoot system issues, identify root cause, and coordinate resolution with IT and development teams.
  • Support production incidents and escalated help desk tickets related to our systems.
  • Communicate issue status, risks, and resolution progress effectively to business partners.
  • Review escalated Service Desk tickets to identify opportunities for process improvement, knowledge base development, and training, facilitating the transition of repeatable support activities and issue resolution from higher support tiers to Level 1 Service Desk teams.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Professional experience in the Property & Casualty Homeowners and/or Residential Commercial insurance industry functioning in a Business Analyst capacity, including requirements elicitation, documentation, and collaboration with technical teams to implement changes to insurance or policy administration systems.
  • Proven experience analyzing business problems, troubleshooting issues, and applying logical, detail-oriented approaches to develop effective solutions with limited supervision.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple assignments simultaneously, prioritizing work, managing scope, and driving work to completion with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and technical resources, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working in Agile / Scrum or sprint-based delivery environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in a Business Analyst role within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
  • Experience supporting Homeowners and/or Residential Commercial lines of business for Florida, Texas, and/or California risks, including familiarity with state-specific products, forms, rating, underwriting, or regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with Duck Creek.
  • Familiarity with regulated environments such as Florida and/or Texas.
  • Insurance carrier or MGA background strongly preferred.
  • Business Analyst certification (CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA) a plus.

Essential Skills:

  • Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate effectively with developers and system vendors.
  • Strong attention to detail especially when working with policy, forms, rating, claims, or billing system changes.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate business needs and translate them into clear, well-defined requirements.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accountability for quality and timeliness of deliverables.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to research issues, recreate steps, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Ability to understand complex business processes, system workflows, and dependencies.
  • Proficiency with business analysis, documentation, and collaboration tools used to support project delivery.
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Work Authorization Requirement:

  • This role requires permanent U.S. work authorization and does not offer employer sponsorship now or in the future.

​​​​WRM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

Notice to Third Party Agencies: WRM does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting firms. Absent a signed Service Agreement by WRM’s Human Resources Department, WRM reserves the right to pursue and hire these candidates without financial obligation to recruiters or agencies.

jobs.title: Claims Supervisor - Catastrophe
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our firm by driving industry leading best practices in front line claims adjusting. This role engages directly with partners in the oversight of Functional and Team Leads for maintaining best practices, response logistics, facilitation of ongoing training, quality assurance and operational management.

Essential Functions:

  • Claims Supervisor works closely with Claims leadership and supports the coordination of aspects of catastrophe responses such as CAT team mobilization, vendor staffing, process management, training, desk examiner adjusting, reserving, payment and approvals, claim reopens, reporting, metrics, and performance management.
  • Provides consistent high-quality training to partners, provides feedback for performance trends and metrics.
  • Participates in off-season training and logistical planning with external adjusting firms and vendors.
  • Supports catastrophe claims process design, testing and implementation.
  • Works within assigned limits of authority to manage and control the proper adjustment of catastrophe claims requiring a high degree of technical complexity and coordination.
  • Evaluates large and complex claims.
  • Addresses file escalations and complex claim situations.
  • Effectively manages loss costs and claim expenses.
  • Maintains and ensures partner firm’s compliance with the claim handling guidelines.
  • Participates in files reviews and supports the Quality Management program.
  • Conducts regular reviews of reserves, along with a routine reserve reconciliation as needed.
  • Travel may be a part of this role to support catastrophe response as well as to attend key internal and vendor meetings.
  • Extended hours and weekend support during catastrophe event may be required.
  • Support daily claims team when needed.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • HS Diploma or GED Required
  • 7 years of Daily/Catastrophe property claims experience, at least 5 of which are in Florida Property.
  • Knowledge of common residential building and construction methods and practices.
  • Must maintain a Florida licensed All-Lines adjuster (620/720) and yearly Continuing Education as required by licensing division of DFS. 
  • California adjusters license may be required in the future.

Competencies and Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree
  • Prior Insurance Carrier Experience
  • 3 years management experience
  • Deep expertise in Florida Homeowners Claims and Litigation
  • Commercial Claim experience a plus
  • Experience in strategy, process management and improvements and analytics related to P&C claims
  • Experience completing claim file reviews
  • Excellent analysis, communication, presentation, and project management skills
  • Works collaboratively to effectively implement claims handling and quality
  • Proven track record in supporting the development and implementation of claims strategies, best practices, handling processes, programs, and controls leading to increased productivity and quantifiable loss cost and expense savings
  • Ability to work in a team environment, and demonstrates a keen attention to detail  
  • Strong internal customer focus with ability to develop and manage relationships with claims personnel, and claims project team members
  • Strong interpersonal skills – team leadership, relationship building, communication
  • Strong performance management, financial awareness, and colleague development skills
  • Demonstrates personal qualities of sound planning, deep claims domain expertise, problem dissection and resolution, commitment to excellence, and decisiveness
  • Fluency in Microsoft Office applications-excel, ppt, MS word etc.
  • Fluency in Xactimate estimation program
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

WRM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

Notice to Third Party Agencies: WRM does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting firms. Absent a signed Service Agreement by WRM’s Human Resources Department, WRM reserves the right to pursue and hire these candidates without financial obligation to recruiters or agencies.

jobs.title: Help Desk Analyst III (Contract)
jobs.description_html:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Windward Risk Managers is seeking an experienced Help Desk Analyst III to serve as a senior technical
resource within the IT Help Desk. This hands-on position handles complex incidents and escalations that
exceed Level 1 and Level 2 capabilities, independently drives issues through resolution, and partners with
Infrastructure, Systems, Network, and Security teams on advanced troubleshooting. The successful candidate
will also mentor junior technicians, strengthen documentation and operational standards, and contribute to
endpoint management and technology rollouts while maintaining responsive end-user support.

WORK LOCATION: 
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office during regular business hours. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.
 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own and resolve advanced Level 2 escalations and complex Level 3 incidents; conduct root-cause
analysis, document findings, and coordinate with specialist teams when infrastructure-level changes are
required.
• Provide expert remote and onsite support for Windows 11 and macOS endpoints, including recurring
operating system failures, application conflicts, device performance, encryption, driver and peripheral
issues.
• Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online issues involving Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, shared
mailboxes, permissions, licensing, authentication, and user productivity.
• Perform advanced Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID account, group, access and identity
troubleshooting; follow approved access controls and change procedures.
• Diagnose client-side network and remote access issues using DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, Wi-Fi and VPN
troubleshooting; collaborate with Network and Security teams on upstream causes.
• Use NinjaOne and other approved remote management tools to investigate endpoint health, deploy
software, execute vetted scripts, support patch remediation, and improve endpoint consistency.
• Lead technically complex onboarding, offboarding, device replacement, reimaging and hardware lifecycle
tasks, ensuring accurate provisioning and asset records.
• Provide technical ownership for Help Desk workstreams in system migrations, operating system upgrades,
software deployments, service catalog improvements, and ticketing platform initiatives.
• Mentor Level 1 and Level 2 analysts through ticket reviews, troubleshooting guidance and knowledge
transfer; help establish clear escalation standards and reduce repeat incidents.
• Maintain accurate tickets, troubleshooting notes, knowledge articles and SOPs; adhere to security, audit,
change management and documentation requirements.
• Identify recurring incidents, propose automation and preventive fixes, and contribute to service quality,
response-time and resolution improvements.
• Communicate clearly with end users, management and cross-functional technical teams during
high-priority incidents and outages.
 

WHY WINDWARD RISK MANAGERS:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• At least 5 years of progressive hands-on IT support experience, including substantial Level 2
troubleshooting and demonstrated ownership of senior-level escalations; equivalent relevant experience
will be considered.
• Strong practical knowledge of Windows endpoint support, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Active
Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
• Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose complex hardware, software, identity, connectivity and
endpoint management issues rather than relying solely on scripted troubleshooting.
• Working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN connectivity and common network troubleshooting tools.
• Experience with RMM platforms, remote support, patching, software deployment and endpoint lifecycle
management.
• Experience using an ITSM ticketing platform and maintaining thorough, audit-ready ticket documentation.
• Strong judgment, prioritization, customer service, communication and mentoring skills; ability to work
effectively in a fast-paced onsite support environment.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• CompTIA Network+, Security+, Microsoft MD-102, or comparable relevant certification.
• Hands-on experience with NinjaOne, HaloITSM or ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus.
• Experience with PowerShell for troubleshooting and approved endpoint automation.
• Experience supporting a multi-site, security-conscious or regulated organization, including documented
access controls and change management.
• Exposure to endpoint security tools, Microsoft Intune, and cross-functional incident response.


ROLE EXPECTATIONS:

This is a senior individual-contributor position, not a people-management role. The Analyst III remains
actively engaged in the support queue while taking primary ownership of escalated technical issues,
mentoring junior analysts, and helping improve Help Desk operations.
 

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

WRM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

Notice to Third Party Agencies: WRM does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting firms. Absent a signed Service Agreement by WRM’s Human Resources Department, WRM reserves the right to pursue and hire these candidates without financial obligation to recruiters or agencies.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary: 

We are seeking a strong, hands-on Network Engineer to join our IT infrastructure team. Reporting to the Senior Network Engineer, this role owns the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and improvement of the company's network, firewall, and connectivity infrastructure across on-premises data centers and a growing Microsoft Azure environment, including the Cisco compute fabric, NetApp storage networking, and Palo Alto security platforms that support it. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical engineer with strong fundamentals, disciplined troubleshooting, and excellent documentation.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Technical Environment: 

  • Security: Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls (PAN-OS) across on-premises data centers and Azure, GlobalProtect VPN, Cloudflare, and Zero Trust / network access control.

  • Routing and WAN: BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP across a multi-site WAN (MPLS / DIA circuits) with site-to-site IPSec VPN.
  • Storage networking: NetApp ONTAP (FAS / AFF) with SnapMirror replication; Tintri.
  • Cloud: a substantial and growing Microsoft Azure networking footprint (hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes).
  • Wireless and monitoring: UniFi wireless; Site24x7 monitoring.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate, maintain, and monitor enterprise LAN, WAN, and UniFi wireless infrastructure across multiple sites.
  • Administer Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, threat prevention, URL filtering, and GlobalProtect VPN; tune App-ID and SSL / TLS decryption.
  • Design, implement, and support Microsoft Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) across Cisco Catalyst and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) switches and the Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnect environment in a multi-site network.
  • Build and maintain site-to-site IPSec VPN connectivity with business partners and vendors.
  • Support NetApp ONTAP storage networking and replication.
  • Administer network monitoring platforms; maintain alerting, dashboards, NetFlow, and device-health visibility.
  • Administer and support network security applications and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Respond to network alerts and incidents; perform root-cause analysis and permanent remediation.
  • Participate in planned maintenance windows, including change preparation, verification, and rollback procedures.
  • Create and maintain network documentation, diagrams, IP address management (IPAM), and runbooks.
  • Install, rack, and cable network hardware; support equipment lifecycle and refresh projects.
  • Assist with network security tasks, including certificate management, vulnerability remediation, and access reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting

  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on network engineering or network administration experience.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP fundamentals, including subnetting, routing, NAT, DNS, and DHCP.
  • Production experience with enterprise-class routers and switches, including Cisco Catalyst, Cisco Nexus (NX-OS), and Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnects.
  • Hands-on production experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, and VPN.
  • Working knowledge of at least one dynamic routing protocol (OSPF, EIGRP, or BGP).
  • Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Azure networking (VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, NSGs, and routing).

  • Experience supporting network security applications.
  • Methodical troubleshooting skills using packet captures, logs, and device diagnostics.
  • Strong written documentation skills.
  • Works well in a collaborative team environment, with strong self-motivation to drive projects through to completion.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Project Manager to support the planning, execution, and delivery of projects in an Agile environment. This role is accountable for coordinating project activities, managing timelines and deliverables, tracking risks and dependencies, and communicating status to stakeholders. The Project Manager will lead Scrum-based delivery activities as part of the overall project execution, ensuring work is planned, monitored, and delivered in alignment with business objectives.

Essential Functions:

  • Project Planning & Execution:
    Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables. Track progress against plans and support on-time, on-scope delivery.
  • Individual Work & Progress Tracking:
    Actively track each team member’s planned and completed work, including commitments made during daily stand-ups and sprint planning. Retain and follow up on prior-day and sprint-level commitments to ensure transparency, accountability, and forward momentum.
  • Delivery Awareness & System Understanding:
    Develop a working understanding of the systems, applications, and business processes the team supports in order to effectively track progress, ask informed questions, and identify delivery risks or bottlenecks.
  • Scope, Schedule & Resource Coordination:
    Assist in defining project scope, managing changes, and coordinating resources across cross-functional teams to meet delivery commitments.
  • Agile & Scrum Delivery Oversight:
    Lead Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as part of the project execution framework. Ensure Agile practices are applied to support delivery predictability and transparency.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication:
    Serve as a primary point of contact for project communications. Provide regular status updates on progress, risks, issues, and dependencies to business and technical stakeholders.
  • Risk, Issue & Dependency Management:
    Identify, document, and track project risks, issues, and dependencies. Support mitigation plans and escalate concerns as needed to minimize delivery impacts.
  • Reporting & Documentation:
    Maintain project documentation, schedules, and status reports. Ensure project information is accurate, current, and accessible.
  • Delivery Governance & Controls:
    Support adherence to project management standards, processes, and governance requirements while ensuring alignment with Agile delivery practices.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    Capture lessons learned and contribute to process improvements to enhance project execution and delivery outcomes.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, or a related field.
  • Project management certification (PMP, CAPM)
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience managing projects within the homeowner’s insurance domain, including coordination of cross-functional teams and delivery of business or system initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in tools like JIRA, Trello, Miro, Smartsheet, or MS Project

Essential Skills:

  • Strong foundational understanding of project management principles (scope, schedule, cost, risk).
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery within a project-managed environment.
  • Clear and professional communication skills with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a structured, deadline-driven environment.
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.description_html:
This role supports Broward and Miami-Dade Counties. Candidates residing in Broward or Miami-Dade County are strongly preferred.

Position Summary:

The Sales Development Manager (SDM) will be responsible for continual contact with agencies in their region to provide assistance to the agents with the goal of superior customer service and increased sales.

Essential Functions:

The SDMs measure of success is broken into key annual objectives with specific metrics agreed upon with the Director of Sales:

  • Production
    • The SDM will be measure against metrics areas of Quotes, Applications, Profitability and Retention
  • Sales Card
    • This will measure the number of agents with the defined bands at the beginning and the end of the calendar year. The goal for the SDM is to move a % of agents into a higher premium ban while maintaining agents with existing premium.
  • Sales Call Quality
    • Works with team to implement a consultative selling approach in which we obtain an in-depth understanding of how our agents do business and what needs are important to them.
  • Functional and Administrative
    • Collecting Agency Profile Information goal is to have all profile fields completed for 90% of our full appointed agents
    • Contact Management implement and track the number of face-to-face visits and phone contact with agencies. All contact information to be entered in Sugar database
    • Competitive Intelligence Surface and comment any changes taken place in the marketplace by our competitors. Document information on weekly report that is submitted to Director
    • Weekly Reporting Update and document a weekly activity report that will be discussed on weekly departmental conference call
    • Territory reviews periodically meet with senior management to review regional goals per agent; strategies for contact management and competitive intelligence
    • Utilizing ISA

jobs.title: System Administrator
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

Windward Risk Managers is seeking a highly skilled System Administrator to serve as the primary administrator for backup, recovery, and cloud infrastructure across the company’s on-prem and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Veeam, vCenter, and Microsoft Azure, with a focus on continuously improving, optimizing, and validating data protection and high-availability architecture. This role leads disaster-recovery planning and testing in partnership with the Systems, Network, Database, and Security teams to keep business-critical systems protected and recoverable.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Continuously improve and evolve the company’s disaster-recovery environment across our data centers and Azure; lead DR planning, runbooks, and failover testing, engaging the Systems, Network, Database, and Security teams; configure fault-tolerant features and maintain Recovery Time Objective and Recovery Point Objective documentation.
  • Design, implement, and optimize the Veeam Backup & Replication environment, including job architecture, repositories, replication, retention and immutability policies, and storage usage.
  • Administer the VMware vSphere / vCenter environment as it relates to data protection, including replication and recovery validation, along with the supporting SAN / NAS storage (NetApp, Tintri), deduplication appliances (ExaGrid), and immutable backup repositories.
  • Validate backup integrity through regular restore testing and automated verification; confirm all critical systems are covered, configurations follow best practices, and gaps are remediated.
  • Contribute to the company’s business continuity program, supporting business impact analysis, recovery strategies for critical business functions, and the ongoing maintenance and testing of business continuity plans as infrastructure and systems change.
  • Manage and expand the company’s Microsoft Azure footprint, building out cloud infrastructure to support business continuity, backup, and DR targets while maintaining storage, access control, and cost governance as adoption grows.
  • Monitor backup health, capacity, and SLA compliance; perform root cause analysis on failures and implement preventive measures.
  • Support compliance and audit requirements related to data protection, backup retention, and recoverability, including evidence gathering and remediation of audit findings.
  • Automate verification and reporting with PowerShell; maintain runbooks and documentation; serve as the escalation point for backup and recovery issues.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for data protection, storage management, and recovery operations.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 to 8 years of systems administration experience in a hybrid (cloud and on-premises) environment.
  • Hands-on production experience designing and managing Veeam Backup & Replication and VMware vSphere / vCenter environments.
  • Administrator-level experience with Microsoft Azure (resources, access control, storage, cost governance).
  • Solid understanding of backup and disaster-recovery concepts, including Recovery Point Objective and Recovery Time Objective, replication, snapshots, immutability, and DR testing.
  • Practical PowerShell scripting skills; working knowledge of Windows Server and enterprise storage (NetApp and / or Tintri preferred).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, the ability to prioritize effectively, and clear written and verbal communication.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE)
  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

The FPI Corporate Internship Program provides qualified students an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand business experience with a homeowners insurance carrier. jobs.title: Cashier- Commercial Lines
jobs.description_html:
Why Join Marshall+Sterling?

As a 100% employee-owned company with roots dating back to 1864, Marshall+Sterling offers the strength of a time-tested organization and the energy of an ownership-driven culture. Guided by our mission to empower clients to predict, prepare for, and preempt risk, we are relentlessly focused on helping people and businesses protect what matters most — so they can move forward with confidence. Our vision of creating a future that’s safer and more secure drives everything we do.

Innovation is not optional here — it's imperative. We constantly seek better, smarter ways to serve our clients and improve as a company. Collaboration is at our core, because we know we are stronger together — across teams, with our clients, and in the communities we serve. Our employee-owners are not only valued and empowered, but also directly invested in our collective success.

At Marshall+Sterling, you’re not just joining a company — you’re joining an inclusive culture built on integrity, impact, and people-first values. Your ideas matter, your growth is prioritized, and your work helps shape a more secure future for all.

This role will be based out of Marshall+Sterling’s St Croix Office

We are looking for a Cashier to join our team in St. Croix, where you’ll play an important role in supporting daily financial operations and providing excellent service to our clients. You’ll process payments, maintain accurate records, prepare bank deposits, assist with account inquiries, and help keep our financial operations running smoothly. If you’re organized, detail-oriented, and enjoy working with people, we’d love to have you on our team!

  • Accurately prepare cash receipt for each payment received.
  • Prepare daily bank deposits.
  • Post deposit to automated agency system.
  • Assist client with account balance inquiries.
  • Maintain and reconcile cash drawer.
  • Open, sort and distribute daily incoming mail.
  • Provide support services to Financial Department as well as other projects as directed by the Financial Manager.

Qualifications

  • College degree preferred, high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Experience and knowledge of Microsoft Office programs.
  • Experience with Vertafore a plus.
  • Works effectively and relates well with others including superiors, colleagues, and individuals inside and outside the company in a professional manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively.
  • High level of organizational ability with attention to detail.

Total Rewards Package:

Compensation: $37,500 - $42,500, based experience.

Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), thirteen paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, employee assistance fund and programs, wellness perks, and more!

Employee Stock Ownership Program

As a 100% employee-owned company, Marshall+Sterling offers you the unique opportunity to build long-term wealth while growing your career. Here’s what makes our ESOP so valuable:

  • Long-Term Rewards: The value of your ESOP account grows over time, rewarding your commitment and contributions to the company’s success.
  • Collaborative & Engaged Culture: Employee ownership fosters a team-oriented environment where everyone has a stake in the company’s growth and success.
  • No Out-of-Pocket Costs: Unlike stock purchase plans, our ESOP is entirely company-funded, meaning you gain equity without any personal investment.

  • Lead and develop the region’s leadership team by recruiting, retaining, mentoring, and supporting high-performing Account Managers and Supervisors.

  • Champion quality, consistency, and innovation by identifying and sharing best practices, strengthening workflows, and supporting the adoption of new technology and agency-wide initiatives.
  • Build a strong employee-owner culture and promote Marshall+Sterling, fostering collaboration across teams while representing the organization positively with employees, clients, and the community.

Qualifications

  • College degree preferred; high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Appropriate state insurance licenses and required continuing education. Active P+C insurance license preferred
  • Five years of related insurance or business experience, including one to three years of supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of insurance products and brokerage/consulting practices.
  • Strong business, leadership, and strategic decision-making skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and email; Vertafore experience a plus.

  • Lead client meetings including policy reviews, renewal discussions, and coverage planning—both in person and online.
  • Build strong carrier relationships to secure competitive coverage options and resolve client service needs.
  • Review and prepare applications, policies, endorsements, audits, and proposals for accuracy using Microsoft Office and agency systems.
  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends, regulations, carrier guidelines, and coverage changes to provide clients with informed recommendations.

  • FL 2-20 License
  • A four-year college degree in business or related field
  • Experience with basic office automation software, such as Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Must have own transportation or access to reliable transportation and maintain a valid driver's license throughout employment.
  • Experience managing a commercial residential book of business
  • AMS360 + ImageRight Proficiency

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Compensation: $60,000 - $100,000 based on experience, education, and work location.

Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), thirteen paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, employee assistance fund and programs, wellness perks, and more!

  • Underwrite individual risk situations to ensure that they meet our agency standards and those of the insurance companies we represent
  • Make individual policy placement decisions based on the needs of the customer, our Agency and the Companies we represent
  • Manage all account transactions including but not limited to endorsements, binders, cancellations & correspondence.

  • Timely follow up on company/clients suspense/diaries
  • Keep abreast of change in the insurance industry
  • Maintain professional accreditation

  • Maintain confidentiality

Qualifications

  • Active Florida 4-40 License required (2-20 preferred)
  • High level of organizational ability with attention to detail
  • Ability to be part of a team
  • Experience w/rating, underwriting and procedural skills
  • Experience with AMS360 / Image Right

You will play a key role in supporting clients in either personal or commercial insurance, collaborating with internal teams to provide a seamless service experience.

  • Review policy coverage, identify areas for enhancement, and coordinate with the Account Manager.
  • Underwrite individual risk situations to meet agency and carrier standards.
  • Secure applications for coverage from Sales Executives, Account Managers, and/or clients.
  • Review policies for accuracy and completeness, ensuring updates are made per workflow procedures.
  • Address cancellation requests and assist in retaining accounts.
  • Treat each service contact as an opportunity for account development, including upgrading coverage and obtaining referrals.
  • Regularly communicate with clients to thank them for their business and document all interactions regarding coverage and exposures.
  • Perform financial duties as directed by management.

Qualifications

  • College degree preferred, high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Prior experience in insurance lines of coverage, fundamental rating, underwriting and procedural skills.
  • Experience and knowledge of Microsoft Office programs.
  • Experience with Vertafore a plus.
  • Proven ability to exceed expectations.
  • Appropriate state insurance licenses and continuing education required.
  • Works effectively and relates well with others including superiors, colleagues, and individuals inside and outside the company in a professional manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively.
  • High level of organizational ability with attention to detail.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Salary Range is $47,500 - $52,500.The specific salary offered may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate's relevant experience, education, and work location.

Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), thirteen paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, employee assistance fund and programs, wellness perks, and more!

jobs.title: Client Service Specialist- Commercial Lines
jobs.description_html:
Why Join Marshall+Sterling?

As a 100% employee-owned company with roots dating back to 1864, Marshall+Sterling offers the strength of a time-tested organization and the energy of an ownership-driven culture. Guided by our mission to empower clients to predict, prepare for, and preempt risk, we are relentlessly focused on helping people and businesses protect what matters most — so they can move forward with confidence. Our vision of creating a future that’s safer and more secure drives everything we do.

Innovation is not optional here — it's imperative. We constantly seek better, smarter ways to serve our clients and improve as a company. Collaboration is at our core, because we know we are stronger together — across teams, with our clients, and in the communities we serve. Our employee-owners are not only valued and empowered, but also directly invested in our collective success. 

At Marshall+Sterling, you’re not just joining a company — you’re joining an inclusive culture built on integrity, impact, and people-first values. Your ideas matter, your growth is prioritized, and your work helps shape a more secure future for all.

This position will be based out of Marshall+Sterling's Middletown Office.

We are seeking a licensed and client-focused Client Service Specialist with strong communication skills and a passion for delivering top-tier service in the insurance industry. This role is perfect for a proactive professional who holds a Property+Casualty Insurance license and thrives on building strong client relationships, ensuring policy accuracy, and contributing to account retention and growth. You will play a key role in supporting clients in either personal or commercial insurance, collaborating with internal teams to provide a seamless service experience.

  • Review policy coverage, identify areas for enhancement, and coordinate with the Account Manager.
  • Underwrite individual risk situations to meet agency and carrier standards.
  • Secure applications for coverage from Sales Executives, Account Managers, and/or clients.
  • Review policies for accuracy and completeness, ensuring updates are made per workflow procedures.
  • Address cancellation requests and assist in retaining accounts.
  • Treat each service contact as an opportunity for account development, including upgrading coverage and obtaining referrals.
  • Regularly communicate with clients to thank them for their business and document all interactions regarding coverage and exposures.
  • Perform financial duties as directed by management.

Qualifications

  • College degree preferred, high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Prior experience in insurance lines of coverage, fundamental rating, underwriting and procedural skills.
  • Experience and knowledge of Microsoft Office programs.
  • Experience with Vertafore a plus.
  • Proven ability to exceed expectations.
  • Appropriate state insurance licenses and continuing education required.
  • Works effectively and relates well with others including superiors, colleagues, and individuals inside and outside the company in a professional manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively.
  • High level of organizational ability with attention to detail.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Salary Range is $47,500 - $52,500.

The specific salary offered may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate's relevant experience, education, and work location.

jobs.title: Sales Executive- Employee Benefits
jobs.description_html:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Group Benefits Sales Executive with exceptional communication skills and in-depth knowledge in the commercial insurance industry. This role is ideal for a highly motivated professional who excels at building relationships, identifying opportunities, and closing deals. You will be responsible for driving new business growth, expanding existing commercial lines accounts, and maintaining a strong book of business. 

This position can be based out of any of Marshall+Sterling's Group Benefits offices.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive new business growth while maintaining and expanding your book of business.
  • Proactively build and manage a pipeline of prospects to achieve sales and retention goals.
  • Craft a compelling value proposition, leveraging your expertise and the powerful tools provided by Marshall+Sterling.
  • Gather and analyze detailed risk and underwriting information to tailor insurance solutions.
  • Create and present professional, customized insurance proposals using Marshall+Sterling’s advanced online system.
  • Follow structured renewal workflows to ensure strong client retention and long-term partnerships.
  • Identify opportunities to refer clients and prospects to other divisions within Marshall+Sterling to meet their broader needs.
  • Partner with internal teams, delegating client service tasks effectively for seamless support.
  • Foster strong, professional relationships with colleagues, contributing to a positive and collaborative work environment.

Qualifications

  • Active state insurance license is required, with a commitment to maintaining compliance through ongoing continuing education.
  • Demonstrated success in pursuing and closing sales, with a strong track record of meeting and exceeding goals.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to connect with diverse individuals and teams.
  • Valid driver’s license
  • College degree preferred, high school diploma or equivalent required.

Compensation 

  • Compensation: $100,000 - $175,000, based on demonstrated insurance sales experience and measurable achievements.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, medical paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more!

Why Join Marshall+Sterling? Our ESOP Sets Us Apart!

As a 100% employee-owned company, Marshall+Sterling offers you the unique opportunity to build long-term wealth while growing your career. Here’s what makes our ESOP so valuable:

  • Ownership & Wealth-Building: Every eligible employee earns shares in the company at no cost, creating a meaningful path to financial security.
  • Long-Term Rewards: The value of your ESOP account grows over time, rewarding your commitment and contributions to the company’s success.

  • Collaborative & Engaged Culture: Employee ownership fosters a team-oriented environment where everyone has a stake in the company’s growth and success.
  • No Out-of-Pocket Costs: Unlike stock purchase plans, our ESOP is entirely company-funded, meaning you gain equity without any personal investment.
  • Stability & Legacy: With over 150 years of success, our ESOP ensures that Marshall+Sterling remains strong, independent, and employee-driven for generations to come.

Join us and experience the benefits of true employee ownership!

Join us and experience the benefits of true employee ownership!

jobs.title: Aerospace & Defense Sales Account Orchestrator
jobs.description_html:
About Siemens Digital Industries Software

We are a leading global software company dedicated to computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company and the energy of a software start-up, we create a world-class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth.

Position Overview

Drive revenue growth through strategic Named Accounts in the Aerospace & Defense market. You'll independently manage complex customer relationships at senior and executive levels, selling integrated PLM and CAE/Simulation solutions that address high-level business challenges. With minimal supervision, you'll develop strategic account plans, identify new business opportunities, and maintain trusted relationships that expand our footprint in this critical vertical.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Account Management 
• Generate revenue through Named Accounts in Aerospace & Defense using a strategic, consultative approach 
• Establish and maintain independent customer relationships up to senior management and executive levels 
• Develop and execute strategic account plans with focus on new business development and account expansion 
• Understand and articulate customer strategy and PLM solution strategy to drive competitive positioning

Sales & Solution Development 
• Sell integrated PLM and CAE/Simulation solutions that address high-level business problems with minimal assistance 
• Create ROI-based solutions incorporating all Siemens PLM product lines 
• Understand competitive landscape and effectively position Siemens PLM software against competitors 
• Manage personal sales targets and quota achievement

Customer Relationship & Support 
• Maintain strong customer relationships and troubleshoot specific customer problems 
• Build relationships with C-level contacts and senior management within accounts 
• Support sales management in devising strategic account plans and strategies 
• Operate with wide latitude for independent judgment and decision-making

Required Qualifications 
• Minimum 5 years of sales or sales support experience selling/supporting CAE or PLM enterprise software in Aerospace & Defense 
• Currently reside in the continental USA 
• Strong history of quota achievement throughout career 
• 4-year college degree or equivalent work experience 
• Excellent public speaking, written, and oral communication skills 
• Ability to understand customer strategy and PLM solution strategy independently 
• Understanding of complex, long sales cycles at the strategic level 
• Legally authorized for employment in the United States

Preferred Qualifications 
• Proven experience generating revenue through Named Accounts in Aerospace & Defense vertical markets 
• Track record of building relationships with senior and C-level contacts 
• Experience selling integrated PLM and CAE/Simulation solutions with emphasis on ROI 
• Knowledge of competitive PLM software solutions 
• Demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal supervision

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Work Environment

Remote role based anywhere in the USA with some travel to customer sites. Normal office or home office environment with flexibility to support customer engagement and strategic account management.

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

#LI-Remote #LI-PLM #SaaS


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $ 110,900 - $ 221,800 annually with a target incentive of 30-40% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Electrical Products
jobs.description_html:
Position Title: Project Manager, LV Electrical Products, Industrial Distribution

Location: Peachtree Corners, GA (Remote)

Are you looking for a company that empowers talent?

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation!

From Day 1, you are empowered to create an impact with your full potential and creativity to make a difference for tomorrow.

We truly have an inclusive and diverse team culture where you can be yourself. Our extensive global presence offers a diverse range of career opportunities across various industries, nations, and job domains, empowering our workforce to continuously enhance their skills and stay competitive.

Create a better tomorrow with us!

We are looking for a Dynamic Project Manager for Low Voltage Electrical Products including Switchgear, Switchboards, Busway, and downstream products. This position reports to the Director of Industrial Vertical in the Project Management Organization. The successful candidate will interface with both internal and external customers to execute mid and high-level complexity electrical distribution projects within the Industrial Market that include Chemical, Oil & Gas, Automotive, Food & Beverage, EV Infrastructure, and Aerospace among others. This position allows for remote working with less than 20% travel required.

Where you will shine:

  • Decision clarity under pressure—you separate noise from facts and act decisively
  • Customer stewardship—you reset expectations when confronted with customer issues and can make the best decision for Siemens and the customer while maintaining the customer relationship.
  • Resourcefulness—you make progress with limited authority and unlock cross‑functional help.

Over your first 90 days you can expect the following.

  • 30 days: You will receive training on our products, systems, processes, and organization. You will shadow a live project and then be assigned a new project with assistance from a buddy that is on our Team. You are receiving on the job training as you are managing the phases of your project.
  • 60 days: You will be assigned a second new project to manage and/or take over 1–2 projects that are already in progress. 
  • 90 days: You own a project portfolio consisting of 3–5 projects of varying sizes and scope. 

You will make an impact with the following responsibilities:

  • Project manager for multiple projects across the country
  • Accountable for order execution including schedule, financial, and commissioning performance
  • Create baseline project schedules and reset customer expectations (if required) upon project kickoff.
  • Set firm expectations on expected product release dates.
  • Use COMPAS to make configuration changes related to project changes or material adds to orders.
  • Collaborate with multiple internal and external stakeholders to resolve project issues.
  • Increase business unit margins through positive value adds to change orders, price escalations and selling extended warranties.
  • Track and keep customers updated on pressing project issues.
  • Track ship shorts
  • Provide Financial Invoice Summaries and reconciliation support to closeout project at the completion of contracted scope of supply.
  • Coordinate deliveries with project site
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex issues and challenges.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive improvements across organizations.
  • Apply skills to resolve complex problems to ensure successful delivery of projects pursuant to customer deliverables and agreed upon contract terms.
  • Display a high level of critical thinking in bringing successful resolution to high impact,
  • complex and/or cross-functional problems.
  • Develop risk mitigation plans to preempt potential problems through the application of
  • concepts, techniques, knowledge, processes, and lessons learned.
  • Comply with Siemens’ policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrate ownership of the project with minimal intervention from Sales.
  • Assist and support in warranty related claims while balancing best bottom-line results and customer experience.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • BA/BS in engineering or business administration.
  • 3 plus years of experience in the application and concepts of Low Voltage Products.
  • Experience with SAP, and exposure to Tableau etc.
  • Must be eligible to work in the US with no sponsorship now or in the future. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • BS in engineering
  • Working with distributors, contractors (electrical and general), and in construction market
  • Current PMI Project Management Professional certification or equivalent 
  • Demonstrates problem solving skills to stakeholders on various Low Voltage Electrical Systems products.
  • Maintains excellent organizational skills to store critical company and customer files including Emails, Purchase Agreements, Contract Drawings and Specifications, Bid Proposals, Project
  • Schedules, Meeting Minutes, Submittal documents
  • Proven ability to demonstrate and apply strong interpersonal, negotiating, influencing and leadership skills.
  • Experience with COMPAS
  • Achievement & Results Orientation Able to identify complex problems, analyze options, and reach positive, effective, and practical solutions.
  • Customer Service Orientation Works well with Internal and External customers utilizing strong Interpersonal and Communication skills.
  • Industry Knowledge Understands our Channels of Distribution Direct and Indirect and is aware of risk of litigation, makes key managers aware of and works to mitigate exposure from affiliates, distribution, Joint Ventures, EPC, and General Contractors
  • Discernment Develop ability to cut through the clutter to see and address the real issues facing the Project Stakeholders
  • Perspective See clearly beyond their own vantage point across functional areas specifically manufacturing facilities to successfully coordinate related products.
  • Communication Effectively and efficiently communicate knowledge across functional areas both with internal and external Project Stakeholders
  • Resourcefulness Exhibit creative ways to make things happen with less authority and fewer resources.
  • Accountability & Responsibility for Results Understand the difference between fault and responsibility throughout the life of the project and accept ultimate accountability for project results

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

Benefits and Perks:

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

The pay range for this position is $74,970 - $128,520. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

jobs.title: Electrical Switchgear Project Manager
jobs.description_html:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We empower customers by combining the real and digital worlds to improve how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We know a business thrives when its people are thriving, which is why we put our people first. Our global, diverse team will support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

The Siemens Electrification and Automation business provides power distribution systems and service solutions that help customers improve the reliability, safety, and performance of their electrical infrastructure.

We are looking for a Project Manager, Customer Services to join our Project Management Office. In this customer-facing role, you will lead service projects from initiation through final closeout while managing safety, scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, and customer expectations.

You will work across a matrixed organization and coordinate with engineering, field service, commercial, finance, vendors, contractors, and customers. This position may be performed remotely or based in Wendell, North Carolina, with travel required approximately 10% to 25% annually.

You’ll make a difference by:

  • Directing all phases of assigned service projects from initiation through completion, including project planning, execution, monitoring, closeout, and lessons learned.
  • Managing project scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, resources, revenue forecasting, and overall performance while developing recovery plans when projects are not meeting expectations.
  • Identifying project risks, including potential safety risks, and developing mitigation strategies that support the safe and successful completion of service activities.
  • Communicating project milestones, field activities, financial status, risks, changes, and performance updates to customers, project teams, leadership, finance partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Coordinating internal and external resources, including engineering teams, field service personnel, vendors, suppliers, consultants, and contractors, to support project requirements and site schedules.
  • Managing contractual requirements, change orders, claims processes, supplier agreements, requests for quotation, and customer expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

Project and system experience may include:

  • Installation, commissioning, maintenance outage testing, electrical retrofits, and electrical system emergency response or disaster recovery.
  • Turnkey, design-build, and engineer-procure-construct projects.
  • Power system studies and field service projects involving internal teams and third-party suppliers, consultants, and contractors.
  • Low-voltage and medium-voltage air-insulated switchgear, medium-voltage gas-insulated switchgear, switches, panelboards, and automatic transfer switches.
  • Transformers, motor control centers, medium-voltage contactors, integrated electrical house systems, cable systems, busways, connectors, and supporting systems.
  • Solar photovoltaic systems, inverters, battery systems, and related electrical infrastructure.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, construction management, or related discipline or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years direct project management experience 
  • 7+ years experience working in field service operations or a field service environment, such as a field service technician, engineer, project manager, or project specialist.
  • Demonstrated experience with low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear.
  • Ability to travel approximately 10% to 25% annually.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Project Management Professional certification. If not currently certified, ability to obtain the certification within one year of employment.
  • Project management experience in electrical switchgear field service, engineer-procure-construct projects, construction, energy, manufacturing, or a related industrial environment.
  • Experience leading cross-functional project teams that include engineering, field service, commercial, finance, suppliers, and contractors.
  • Experience interpreting project contracts and managing change orders, claims, liquidated damages, specifications, supplier scope, schedules, and budgets.
  • Experience using Microsoft Project to develop, maintain, and communicate project schedules.

 Managing contractual requirements, change orders, claims processes, supplier agreements, requests for quotation, and customer expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

 Installation, commissioning, maintenance outage testing, electrical retrofits, and electrical system emergency response or disaster recovery.

 Power system studies and field service projects involving internal teams and third-party suppliers, consultants, and contractors.
 Low-voltage and medium-voltage air-insulated switchgear, medium-voltage gas-insulated switchgear, switches, panelboards, and automatic transfer switches.

 Solar photovoltaic systems, inverters, battery systems, and related electrical infrastructure.
