jobs.title: Customer Solution Architect, Chemicals, Glass and Energy
jobs.description_html:
Customer Solution Architect, Chemicals, Glass and Energy 

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people ﬁrst. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

As a Customer Solution Architect within Sales Acceleration, supporting the Chemicals, Glass and Energy, you will be a key individual contributor reporting to the Manager of Sales Acceleration, Chemicals, Glass and Energy. You will empower vertical sales teams and customers by driving adoption of Siemens' Digital Industries (DI) portfolio, with a focus on automation and digitalization solutions. This role maximizes solution and product sales by applying the Digital Thread methodology and leveraging the Challenger Sales Approach to deliver meaningful customer outcomes, and accelerating their realization. You will translate customer insights into effective, cost-efficient solutions that align with the Siemens Sales Engagement Model, serving as a trusted advisor to vertical sales teams and customers.

This position is remote and can be located anywhere in the continental US.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Expertise across the oil and gas value-chain: Have a firm and thorough understanding of one/more of the U.S. upstream (onshore, offshore), midstream (Pipelines, LNG) and Refinery value-chain. Key aspects of knowledge/expertise should reside in understanding the industry value-chain, customer segmentation, budget centers, competitive insights, product-market fit analysis and track record in positioning/selling automation and software related engagements across Tier I, II and III operators.
  • Solution Development & Architecting: Translate complex customer challenges into clear, actionable requirements and work to deliver innovative automation and digitalization solutions that meet their evolving needs.
  • Driving Sales Engagement: Independently drive and apply a Sales Engagement Model with your assigned accounts to achieve the sales acceleration targets.
  • Trusted Advisory: Serve as a primary technical and strategic advisor to customers and internal sales teams, guiding them through the adoption of Siemens' cutting-edge technologies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster strong collaboration with Sales teams, Marketing & Communication, Product Management in the Zone, and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless value delivery and maximize market opportunities.
  • Market & Customer Identification: Identify key and emerging markets and support the definition and identification of target customers across the Digital Industries Automation portfolio nationwide.
  • Assessing portfolio/productmarket fit for the instrumentation portfolio: Having a strong knowledge on process industries is essential as you will own the process of portfolio fit with strategic customer markets that have a high willingness to buy. 

You’ll win us over by having the following qualiﬁcations: 

Basic Qualiﬁcations:

  • 8+ years of proven experience in a technical sales, solution consulting, application engineering, or similar individual contributor role within industrial automation or digitalization
  • Strengthening the familiarity with the automation ecosystem in the oil and gas market. 
  • Identify opportunities to co-create reference architectures, standards, preferred vendor positions, and reusable engineering approaches that increase Siemens specification rates.
  • Familiar with key Tier I, II and Tier III oil and gas operators.
  • Leverage industry relationships, market knowledge, and professional networks to expand Siemens' visibility and credibility throughout the oil and gas ecosystem.
  • Translate Siemens' automation, instrumentation, digitalization, and software portfolio into solutions that help oil and gas projects. 
  • Lead technical strategy and value messaging that aligns Siemens capabilities with the unique needs of process industries such as Oil & Gas, LNG, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Power Generation, and Energy Transition projects. 
  • Drive cross-business-unit collaboration to present a unified Siemens solution strategy spanning Process Automation, Instrumentation, Digital Industries Software, Industrial Communications, AI, and Digital Twin offerings.
  • Experience working with End Users, primarily in process and energy-oriented industries, such as oil and gas, chemicals, hydrogen, carbon capture, LNG to name a few
  • Technical expertise in Siemens Industrial Automation and Digitalization Portfolio, with a proven track record of applying these technologies to solve complex customer problems
  • Comprehensive knowledge of industrial automation market drivers, trends, and evolving customer needs, particularly in the context of digital transformation
  • Exceptional customer interaction, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a strong customer-centric approach
  • Experience with various project collaboration models and sales processes
  • Excellent verbal, written and time management skills
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically up to 35%, with occasional international travel
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States permanently, without company sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualiﬁcations:

  • 10+ years of experience in process automation, industrial digitalization, ecosystem business development, solution consulting, application engineering, or technical sales. 
  • Existing relationships within U.S. based oil and gas operators, EPC’s and solution partners to aid in the industry growth for Siemens. 
  • Experience supporting automation and software projects in oil and gas during concept, FEED, detailed engineering, procurement, construction, or commissioning phases. 
  • Deep familiarity with one or more CGE segments including Oil & Gas, LNG, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Energy Transition, Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Power Generation, or related industries. 
  • Proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and influence technical standards before projects reach the bid stage. 
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage both C-suite leaders and hands-on engineering teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Petroleum Engineer, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Strategic Agility: Ability to foresee future trends in industrial automation and digitalization, contributing to competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans, and influencing outcomes without direct authority
  • Business Acumen: Deep understanding of business operations and market dynamics, with knowledge of current and future practices, trends, and information impacting the industrial business landscape
  • Organizational Agility: Knows how to get things done through formal and informal networks. Works effectively in a matrix structure to exploit opportunities. Rallies the team behind the right opportunities and initiatives
  • Exceptional Customer Focus: A dedication to understanding and meeting customer needs, leveraging insights to drive continuous improvement in products, solutions, and services
  • High Degree of Professional Ownership: Demonstrate strong personal accountability and take initiative to drive projects to completion, even in large, complex working groups
  • Proven ability to work autonomously and thrive in a remote, virtual work environment
#LI-VM1

You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $91,463.00 - $188,006.00 annually with a target incentive of 30% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role is remote.


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

  

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


The Cybersecurity Engineer designs, implements, and supports secure Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) solutions for federal and mission-critical environments. This role works across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Engineering, and Operations to develop Risk Management Framework (RMF) compliant solutions and ensure cybersecurity requirements are addressed from pre-sales and design through implementation, testing, and commissioning.


As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you will:

  • Design and support secure IT/OT architectures for building automation and mission-critical systems.
  • Develop and maintain RMF documentation, cybersecurity deliverables, and compliance packages.
  • Perform system hardening, vulnerability assessments, risk reviews, and security control validation.
  • Support secure configuration of field controllers, servers, workstations, switches, routers, firewalls, databases, and applications.
  • Perform cybersecurity testing, validation, troubleshooting, and commissioning support.
  • Provide Tier 2 technical support and guidance to field and operations teams.
  • Support pre-sales activities including specification review, solution development, scope definition, estimates, and technical proposals.
  • Contribute to internal cybersecurity standards, processes, ATO initiatives, and knowledge sharing.

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Experience in cybersecurity, IT/OT systems, networking, systems engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Knowledge of networking, system hardening, vulnerability management, and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Strong troubleshooting, technical documentation, and communication skills.
  • Up to 50% travel required.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Relevant cybersecurity, networking, or infrastructure certifications are preferred.
  • Experience with RMF, ATO, STIG/SRG, SCAP/Nessus, federal cybersecurity requirements, or Building Automation Systems is preferred.

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role is supports our Miramar, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Miami, Broward, and Palm Beach Counties.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


Fire Inspectors play a vital role in preventing, detecting, and mitigating the impact of fires. You will perform tasks such as minor repairs and visual and functional testing on fire alarm systems in accordance with all national and local standards. In addition to your primary responsibilities, you will also act as a mentor, providing on-the-job training to entry level fire alarm inspectors, fostering a culture of growth and knowledge-sharing within our team.  Our fire inspectors significantly contribute to public safety, property protection, and overall emergency preparedness.

As a Fire Inspector, you will:

  • Follow and maintain high structured inspection schedules providing inspection, testing, and performing minor service and deficiency repairs for fire alarm equipment to comply with NFPA72 standards as well as state and local codes. Note deficiencies, remedies, and review pricing with customers. Complete service ticket documentation before leaving the customer site. Follow-up on corrective actions
  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation of all tests performed. Generate reports within Siemens tools and upload to city municipality websites
  • Provide instructions to customer personnel regarding proper operation and routine inspections. Assist with training
  • Work overtime when needed, and maintain stock, tools, and equipment in vehicles
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures
  • Complete required training and certifications within the time requirements for this role


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 1+ year of experience performing Inspections, Testing, and Maintenance (ITM) of Fire Alarm and/or Fire Life Safety Systems or low voltage electrical or mechanical experience
  • Ability and willingness to work in a variety of environments in and around mechanical and electrical equipment, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high-lift equipment, working in ducts, above ceilings, and in outside/inside/heat/cold/day/night conditions; use hand tools, laptop (Microsoft proficient), email, smartphone, and tablet; carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must be able to differentiate types/colors of wire
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship
  • Must obtain NICET Fire Alarm Certification Level I within 12 months

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field preferred
  • 3+ years’ experience performing Inspections, Testing, and Maintenance (ITM) of Fire Alarm and/or Fire Life Safety Systems
  • Ability to read/understand design and construction documents

jobs.title: Electrical Switchgear Project Manager
jobs.description_html:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We empower customers by combining the real and digital worlds to improve how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We know a business thrives when its people are thriving, which is why we put our people first. Our global, diverse team will support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

The Siemens Electrification and Automation business provides power distribution systems and service solutions that help customers improve the reliability, safety, and performance of their electrical infrastructure.

We are looking for a Project Manager, Customer Services to join our Project Management Office. In this customer-facing role, you will lead service projects from initiation through final closeout while managing safety, scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, and customer expectations.

You will work across a matrixed organization and coordinate with engineering, field service, commercial, finance, vendors, contractors, and customers. This position may be performed remotely or based in Wendell, North Carolina, with travel required approximately 10% to 25% annually.

You’ll make a difference by:

  • Directing all phases of assigned service projects from initiation through completion, including project planning, execution, monitoring, closeout, and lessons learned.
  • Managing project scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, resources, revenue forecasting, and overall performance while developing recovery plans when projects are not meeting expectations.
  • Identifying project risks, including potential safety risks, and developing mitigation strategies that support the safe and successful completion of service activities.
  • Communicating project milestones, field activities, financial status, risks, changes, and performance updates to customers, project teams, leadership, finance partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Coordinating internal and external resources, including engineering teams, field service personnel, vendors, suppliers, consultants, and contractors, to support project requirements and site schedules.
  • Managing contractual requirements, change orders, claims processes, supplier agreements, requests for quotation, and customer expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

Project and system experience may include:

  • Installation, commissioning, maintenance outage testing, electrical retrofits, and electrical system emergency response or disaster recovery.
  • Turnkey, design-build, and engineer-procure-construct projects.
  • Power system studies and field service projects involving internal teams and third-party suppliers, consultants, and contractors.
  • Low-voltage and medium-voltage air-insulated switchgear, medium-voltage gas-insulated switchgear, switches, panelboards, and automatic transfer switches.
  • Transformers, motor control centers, medium-voltage contactors, integrated electrical house systems, cable systems, busways, connectors, and supporting systems.
  • Solar photovoltaic systems, inverters, battery systems, and related electrical infrastructure.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 5+ years direct project management experience supporting service projects involving low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear.
  • 3+ years experience working in field service operations or a field service environment, such as a field service technician, engineer, project manager, or project specialist.
  • Demonstrated experience with low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear.
  • Ability to travel approximately 10% to 25% annually.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, construction management, or a related field.
  • Project Management Professional certification. If not currently certified, ability to obtain the certification within one year of employment.
  • Project management experience in electrical switchgear field service, engineer-procure-construct projects, construction, energy, manufacturing, or a related industrial environment.
  • Experience leading cross-functional project teams that include engineering, field service, commercial, finance, suppliers, and contractors.
  • Experience interpreting project contracts and managing change orders, claims, liquidated damages, specifications, supplier scope, schedules, and budgets.
  • Experience using Microsoft Project to develop, maintain, and communicate project schedules.

jobs.title: Senior Business and Digitalization Professional
jobs.description_html:
Senior Business and Digitalization Professional


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

Join our Smart Infrastructure (SI) team as our Senior Business and Digitalization Professional to help us to successfully manage all digitalization and AI strategy and projects across our network of factories. The successful candidate will report to the Electrical Products Finance Operations Manager of Governance and Performance Controller, partner closely with the Head of Finance, North America Operations, Fin. Director of Operations, Systems, EP NA Factories, the Segment Fin teams and other functions while owning and improving digitalization transparency to improve accuracy of books and records, planning and controlling, measuring the achievement of KPIs and driving improvement projects



We are looking for Senior Business and Digitalization Professional. This position will be based preferably at Peachtree Corners, GA or at one of our US Plant locations, Remote work would also be considered.

You’ll make an impact by:


  • Lead the Digitalization and AI agenda for EP NA Finance Operations across the North American factory network, with a focus on improving financial transparency, performance management, governance, and productivity.

  • Develop and execute the Finance Operations Digitalization and AI strategy, translating business needs into scalable solutions.

  • Coordinate and align Data Analysts and TEA Coordinators across the plant finance network to promote common standards, methodologies, and solutions.

  • Partner with Finance, Operations, and technical teams to implement dashboards, automation, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases.

  • Lead standard and ad hoc analytics, Digitalization and AI projects, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Develop management presentations, business reviews, and decision proposals that translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for leadership.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert, providing governance, guidance, and best practices for reporting, analytics, Digitalization, and AI.

  • Continuously improve business intelligence and reporting solutions to increase transparency, standardization, efficiency, and data-driven decision-making.

  • Analyze business performance against targets and identify emerging trends, risks, anomalies, and improvement opportunities.

  • Lead fact-based performance discussions with factories and key stakeholders to drive accountability and business results.

  • Provide backup support across Finance Operations Governance and Performance Controlling and support additional strategic priorities as needed.


Key Competencies

  • Digitalization & AI Leadership

  • Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

  • Strategic & Analytical Thinking

  • Financial & Performance Controlling

  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

  • Project & Change Management

  • Executive Communication

  • Process Improvement & Standardization

  • Stakeholder Management & Influencing

  • Continuous Learning & Innovation

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • BS in Accounting, Finance and/or Data Science

  • 8-10 years’ experience in Finance and Digitalization/AI, preferably in a manufacturing plant environment

  • Very strong in depth knowledge of Digitalization, AI, automation tools (Tableau, Knime, Snowflake etc), SAP (FI/CO)

  • Strong Networking-, Collaboration- and Stakeholder Management skills

  • Strong communication and presentation skills

  • Project Management Skills and Experience / Change Management experience

  • Solution oriented thinking and ability to practically apply methodic approaches to overcome business challenges

  • Ability to effectively manage deadlines, prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience and in-depth know how of large and complex manufacturing environments

  • Comprehensive SCM- and manufacturing process understanding (beyond finance)


Job Level Disclosure

This position will be posted and hired at one of two job levels based on candidate qualifications and experience in a related field and successful demonstration of Key Responsibilities and Knowledge as presented above

Level 6: Requires a minimum of 8+ years of applicable professional experience- Salary Range: $91,463-$156,794

Level 5b: Requires a minimum of 10+ years of applicable professional experience- Salary Range: $109,670 - $188,006

The final level will be determined at the time of offer and will be based on the selected candidate’s skills, experience, and overall alignment with the role.

From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

We value your unique identity and perspective. jobs.title: Area Head Of Finance
jobs.description_html:
Area Head of Finance

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way our business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


The Area Head of Finance  works to meet business goals while partnering with area, sales and operations managers, project/service teams, Finance and Business Administration (FBA) colleagues, and auditors. This position is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days onsite and can be located in Orlando or Miami, FL.


As an Area Head of Finance, you will:

  • Acts as commercial partner to the Branch Managers and assumes responsibility for Area financial performance. Along with Branch management, is responsible for the Area’s financial performance including P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow.
  • Leads, manages, and oversees finance, accounting, and business administration activities for all SI RSS Businesses.
  • Responsible for assigned Areas’ day-to-day business transactions and strategic initiatives in strong collaboration with Area GMs and drives, implements and monitors in cooperation with the Branches Management – productivity initiatives to further improve profitability and competitiveness.
  • Partners with Commercial Project Managers, Sales, and Operations Managers on large, more impactful projects in the Areas to ensure adequate project controlling.
  • Ensure compliance with external and internal accounting and reporting guidelines and operational Area performance (operational balance, slip, absorption, & utilization).
  • Area cost center controlling and Mentor/lead Commercial Project Managers and other team members as applicable, as well as participate in special projects related to either the local business or in support of field or home office initiatives.
  • Analyze and report financial risks, opportunities, inconsistencies, and potential fraud indicators to Branch/Region Finance and Business Administration leadership.
  • Monitor operating expense controls and recommend cost-savings and continuous improvement actions to support financial performance goals.
  • Oversee inventory valuation by maintaining sound financial control policies, procedures, and reporting practices.
  • Provide financial guidance and support to enable high-quality employee performance, development, and accountability.
  • Deliver or coordinate financial training for sales, operations, and finance teams to strengthen understanding of policies, procedures, and controls that impact the integrity of the P&L and Balance Sheet.
  • May manage, directly or indirectly, employees performing finance and accounting functions in the region.
  • Participate in special projects supporting local business priorities, field operations, or home office initiatives.
  • Support contract execution and review contract terms to provide financial guidance, improve Net Working Capital, and mitigate contractual risk.
  • Serve as a company representative and liaison with customers and local authorities to build productive relationships and reinforce a positive Siemens Smart Buildings image.
  • Review and approve contracts, purchase orders, and change orders within delegated signature authority across relevant business activities.
  • Maintain relationships with the largest and most critical customers, as appropriate, to support business continuity and customer satisfaction.

You will make an impact with these qualifications: 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field 
  • 6+ years of broad Accounting / Finance experience
  • Demonstrated understanding of GAAP/IFRS and internal controls.
  • Demonstrated a history of taking on ever increasing levels of responsibility and being able to demonstrate ability to take initiative and act independently.
  • Competencies: Results driven; client-driven; ability to interact effectively within cross functional teams; collaborative style
  • Skills: Strong financial, leadership, interpersonal, analytical; proficiency with MS Suite of applications
  • Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States and will not require employer-sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United State

You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $109,670 - $188,006 annually with a target incentive of 15% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Machine Builder Solution Manager
jobs.description_html:
Machine Builder Solution Manager

Siemens Digital Industries Automation (DI AUT) is one of the world’s leading providers of industrial automation. Our innovative automation portfolio enables companies of all sizes in both the process and discrete manufacturing industries to accelerate their automation—and thus their digital transformation—across the entire value chain. This allows our customers to increase productivity and flexibility and become future-ready through technologies such as software-defined systems and artificial intelligence. Siemens Xcelerator—the open digital business platform—helps to implement this more easily, quickly, and at scale. Together with partners and a broad ecosystem, Siemens supports its customers on their journey toward becoming a Digital Enterprise.

Create and drive scalable, ready-to-sell Machine Builder solution offerings for Zone Americas that enable industry-specific applications.

Help machine builders transition from hardware-centric automation to software-defined, data-driven, and AI-enabled machine architectures.

Drive IT/OT integration and support Siemens’ Industrial Operations X strategy by leveraging:

  • Software-Defined Automation (SDA): SIMATIC AX, SIMATIC S7-1500V Virtual PLC, Industrial Edge, and related technologies.
  • Industrial AI: Eigen Engineering Agent and other AI-enabled automation solutions.
  • Simulation & Digital Engineering: TIA Simulation Cloud, SIMIT, Digital Twin and Digital Drivetrain solutions, including S7-PLCSIM Advanced, DriveSim Engineer, and related engineering and simulation tools.
  • Advanced Automation & Motion: SIMATIC S7 T-CPU applications, motion control, safety, Industrial IoT, and integrated digital threads across the machine lifecycle.
  • Cybersecurity: Promote secure-by-design machine architectures that help machine builders address EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) requirements, protect the installed base, and leverage embedded security capabilities and CRA-ready DI AUT offerings.

Connect customer and market needs with Siemens’ cross-portfolio capabilities to develop standard applications, reusable solution toolboxes (e.g., Packaging, Intralogistics, Converting, Data Center, Material Handling and others), and end-to-end machine concepts, ranging from cabinet-level solutions, where required, to holistic digital-thread scenarios that address customer business and machine-lifecycle challenges.

Collaborate across businesses, technology organizations, Sales and Marketing, regions, and global teams to bring together the required capabilities, enabling Machine Builder Sales and technical teams to win complex opportunities, accelerate solution adoption, and turn successful customer concepts into scalable, repeatable solutions for deployment across the Americas.

Machine Builder Portfolio & Solutions

  • Scout technologies across industry, technology, and general machine builder segments to identify relevant developments and opportunities.
  • Evaluate customer, market, and competitive trends to identify leading automation, digitalization, and Machine Builder solution opportunities.
  • Capture, consolidate, and prioritize Zone-specific customer and solution requirements, translating them into actionable inputs for Global Machine Builder Solution Management, PLM, and portfolio owners.
  • Translate global portfolio strategies, solution standards, and value propositions into effective Zone and LCB execution while feeding regional market intelligence and customer requirements back to Global.
  • Collaborate with Global Machine Builder Solution Management and Zone Market Development on Standard Application Development, reusable application concepts, and scalable solution toolboxes.
  • Enable Machine Builder Sales and technical teams with industry-, application-, and system-level expertise, localized content, solution know-how, and pre-sales standards to strengthen sales readiness and portfolio adoption.
  • Provide machine concept consulting for complex and high-value opportunities, developing end-to-end, cross-portfolio concepts ranging from cabinet solutions to Software-Defined Automation and holistic digital-thread scenarios.
  • Support customer workshops, demonstrations, pilots, and Proof-of-Concepts to validate technical feasibility, customer value, and business potential.
  • Convert successful customer concepts into scalable, repeatable solutions and reusable toolboxes, and support deployment and adoption across LCBs in the Americas.
  • Facilitate alignment across LCBs, Sales, SAC-MB, technical teams, Global Solution Management, and portfolio organizations to ensure consistent solution positioning and effective execution.

What you bring

We are looking for a strategic and technically driven Machine Builder Solution Manager to support commercialization, solution strategy, and technical enablement of the Machine Builder portfolio across the Americas, with a strong focus on Software-Defined Automation, Industrial AI, simulation and digital engineering, advanced automation and motion technologies, and cybersecurity.

The successful candidate will drive solution management, technical enablement, market intelligence, and Machine Builder growth initiatives, translating emerging technologies and customer needs into scalable, repeatable solutions while strengthening alignment among regional market requirements, global strategy, and portfolio development.

Education

  • Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Industrial Automation, or a related technical field.

Experience & Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in industrial automation, machine automation, digitalization, application engineering, solution management, OEM sales, portfolio management, technical sales, or a related customer-facing role.
  • Deep understanding of Machine Builder and OEM customer segments.
  • Demonstrated experience defining or deploying machine automation solutions that integrate PLCs, motion control, drives, HMI, safety, industrial networking, and software such as TIA Portal.
  • Experience with Software-Defined Automation, Industrial IoT, advanced automation and motion-control technologies for standard applications (e.g., Packaging, Intralogistics, Converting, Data Center, Material Handling and others), safety, and cybersecurity.
  • Working knowledge of SIMATIC S7 T-CPU applications, or the ability to rapidly develop expertise and translate the technology into Machine Builder use cases.
  • Experience converting customer requirements into scalable use cases, standard applications, reusable toolboxes, technical concepts, or portfolio requirements.
  • Experience supporting complex opportunities, customer workshops, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concepts, pilots, or early-adopter programs.
  • Understanding of interface concepts, interoperability, industrial data integration, cybersecurity, and lifecycle considerations for cross-portfolio solutions.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and machine-automation applications.

Business & Collaboration Skills

  • Strong customer-back mindset with the ability to connect technical capabilities to customer value, business potential, and scalable growth.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in clear business language for customers, Sales, management, and global portfolio teams.
  • Strong analytical, prioritization, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Collaborative working style and ability to operate effectively across countries, cultures, business units, and technical disciplines.
  • Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders in a matrix organization.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20-30% across the Americas.

Languages

  • Fluent English required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Industrial Automation, or a related technical field.
  • Experience in Machine Builder or OEM markets, with knowledge of packaging, material handling, robotics, machine tools, food and beverage, or related discrete-manufacturing segments.
  • Spanish and/or Portuguese fluency.
  • Hands-on experience with Siemens automation, motion, drives, industrial software, engineering, simulation, or virtual-commissioning portfolios.
  • Working knowledge of Eigen Engineering Agent, SIMIT, S7-PLCSIM Advanced, DriveSim Engineer or other related Siemens Simulation and Digital Engineering offerings.
  • Experience developing value propositions, go-to-market content, reference architectures, sales playbooks, or customer success stories.
  • Knowledge of applicable industrial standards, cybersecurity requirements, functional safety, regulatory compliance, or machine-lifecycle services.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.

jobs.title: Fire Alarm Systems Technician
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Tampa, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Tampa, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


Fire Alarm Technicians play a crucial role in ensuring the safety and efficiency of our Smart Buildings. You will participate in the installation, programming, start-up, and commissioning of state-of-the-art fire alarm equipment, including fire safety, mass notification, detectors, and field peripherals. Our Fire Alarm Technicians are the face of Siemens, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customer will help keep their buildings and inhabitants safe.


As a Fire Alarm Technician, you will:

  • Assist with the commissioning of new fire alarm systems on construction ensuring seamless integration
  • Assist with testing and inspecting of existing fire alarm systems
  • Plan work with mentor, Lead Technician, and Team Leader
  • Complete commissioning within planned timelines
  • Submit accurate time and expense logs
  • Work overtime when needed


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Electro-mechanical experience (either from a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skill and low voltage experience; proficient in Microsoft Office 
  • Must be willing and able to differentiate types/colors of wire; use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet; carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must obtain NICET Fire Alarm Certification Level 1 within 18 months
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field preferred
  • 6+ months experience installing commercial fire alarm equipment 
  • Ability to read/understand design and construction documents

jobs.title: U.S. Customs Assurance Manager
jobs.description_html:
U.S. Customs Assurance Manager

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a U.S. Customs Assurance Manager. This position is remote.

We are seeking a U.S. Customs Assurance Manager to support U.S. Customs Operations through data analysis, compliance monitoring, reporting, and process improvement. This role combines practical customs knowledge with strong analytical skills to identify risks, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and translate complex trade data into actionable business insights.

The successful candidate will be comfortable investigating issues beyond system-generated results, explaining the regulatory basis for conclusions, and partnering across functions to improve customs compliance and operational performance. You use data and sound customs judgment to uncover risk, explain why an issue occurred, and help build scalable reporting and controls that strengthen U.S. Customs Operations.

You will make an impact by:

  • Develop and maintain customs reports, scorecards, and key performance indicators.
  • Analyze import and broker data to identify entry errors, recurring trends, compliance risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and support corrective actions for classification, valuation, country-of-origin, and entry discrepancies.
  • Design or support data validations, exception reporting, and monitoring controls that improve customs data integrity.
  • Support HTS classification reviews, USMCA and other free trade agreement activities, audits, and compliance assessments.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for Customs Operations and business stakeholders.
  • Partner with brokers, supply chain, logistics, procurement, finance, technology teams, and other stakeholders to resolve data and process issues.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual activities and improve reporting, visibility, and operational efficiency.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in International Trade, Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Logistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in customs compliance, customs operations, brokerage, trade analytics, supply chain analytics, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. import regulations and customs processes, including entry requirements, HTS classification, valuation, and country-of-origin principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify anomalies and trends, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, data validation, and reporting.
  • Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional environment.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in customs compliance, customs operations, brokerage, or trade analytics.
  • Hands-on experience applying customs regulations to classification, audit, USMCA or other free trade agreement, origin, valuation, or post-entry activities.
  • Experience creating dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, validations, or automated compliance reports.
  • Proficiency with Tableau, Power BI, Snowflake, SAP, Alteryx, Power Automate, or comparable analytics and automation tools.
  • Experience evaluating broker performance, entry accuracy, compliance trends, and root causes.
  • Experience supporting internal or external audits, corrective-action tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Licensed Customs Broker certification is a plus.

About Siemens

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

jobs.title: Global Commodity Engineer (f/m/d) – Integrated Circuits
jobs.description_html:
Location: Any Siemens location in the world

You’ll make an impact by

  • You define and drive the implementation and continuous evolution of the global Integrated Circuit commodity strategy ensuring a high-quality, competitive and future-ready portfolio. You identify emerging technologies, industry trends, and supplier capabilities, and translate them into a technology roadmap that supports current and future business requirements. 
  • You collaborate closely with R&D, Procurement, Engineering and Supply Chain to ensure that technical requirements, product expectations, and customer needs are effectively translated into supplier specifications and qualification criteria. 
  • You lead and coordinate the global Commodity Engineering network for ICs and ensure effective collaboration across locations. You foster knowledge sharing, drive alignment on  technical standards and engineering approaches, and act as the key technical authority for IC-related topics. 
  • You Drive standardization, risk mitigation, second-source strategies and cost optimization.  
  • You coordinate supplier qualification and material approval activities ensuring that suppliers meet all technical, quality, and regulatory requirements. You define qualification standards, assess manufacturing capabilities, and drive risk mitigation measures throughout the supply chain. 
  • You monitor supplier performance through defined KPIs and establish improvement plans where necessary. You lead supplier development activities, coordinate corrective and preventive actions, and support root-cause analysis for supplier-related quality issues. 
  • Monitor market developments, technology trends, obsolescence risks and supplier roadmaps.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President of Sales, Americas - Grid Software
jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management, empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are seeking an experienced Senior Vice President of Sales for the Americas to lead and grow our regional sales organization across the United States, Canada, and Central and South America — driving revenue for Siemens Grid Software’s software and services portfolio that powers the digital transformation of electric grid operators worldwide. This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting into senior global sales leadership, with direct responsibility for a team of regional Vice Presidents of Sales and full ownership of revenue generation and growth across the Americas.

This is a role based in the United States, with regular travel across the Americas region to engage regional teams, partners, and customers.

You’ll make an impact as you:

  • Connect global strategy to regional execution. Understand and be an active partner in shaping Siemens Grid Software’s global sales strategy, then interpret and translate that strategy into an actionable plan for the Americas — adjusting the approach as needed to fit the realities of the U.S., Canada, and Central and South American markets.
  • Lead a multi-country sales leadership team. Directly manage, coach, and develop Vice Presidents of Sales for the U.S./Canada and Central/South America sub-regions, building a high-performing, accountable leadership bench.
  • Drive revenue generation and growth. Own orders and revenue targets across the Americas, with disciplined forecasting, pipeline management, and consistent quota attainment across all sub-regions.
  • Build executive relationships. Cultivate and personally engage in strategic relationships with C-level and senior executives at TSOs, DSOs, IOUs, and other utility customers to shape and close large, complex, multi-year deals.
  • Champion customer success. Partner with product, delivery, and customer success teams to ensure customers realize measurable value from Siemens Grid Software solutions, driving renewals, expansion, and reference-ability.
  • Develop go-to-market capability. Build and refine sales processes, territory design, compensation plans, and partner/channel strategies suited to the diverse markets across the Americas.
  • Align cross-functionally. Work closely with marketing, product management, delivery, and finance leadership to ensure the Americas sales strategy is fully aligned with global company priorities.
  • Represent Siemens externally. Serve as a visible, credible executive voice for Siemens Grid Software at industry events, customer forums, and analyst engagements across the region.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree in business, engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • 12+ years of progressive sales leadership experience in enterprise software/SaaS, including 5+ years managing sales leaders (VP or Director-level) across multiple countries or regions.
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding multi-million-dollar revenue/orders targets in a complex, solution-selling environment.
  • Solid knowledge of the power utilities/grid industry, including familiarity with electric utilities, ISOs/RTOs, transmission and distribution organizations, and grid technologies domains such as EMS, DMS, ADMS, or grid planning.
  • Demonstrated experience selling enterprise software and services solutions (not just hardware/products) into utility or critical-infrastructure customers.
  • Proven experience engaging directly with C-level executives at electrical utility companies; existing relationships with C-level utility leaders across the Americas are strongly preferred.
  • Experience building and leading distributed, multicultural sales teams across the U.S., Canada, and Latin America, with a strong understanding of regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to travel 50% (domestic and international) to support customers and regional teams across the Americas.
  • Strong communication skills in business-proficient English and interculturally competent; Spanish and/or Portuguese language skills are a bonus, though not required, given the Central/South America scope.
  • Adaptable to new tasks, solutions, and customer needs.
  • Must be legally authorized for employment in the United States; Siemens is not able to sponsor or transfer employment-based visas for this role, now or in the future.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

#GSWUS

jobs.title: Energy Risk Management Consulting Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) Energy Business Advisory team is paving the way for businesses to navigate complexity, drive growth, and shape the future in an evolving landscape. Our comprehensive services provide solutions in strategic planning, risk management, operational efficiency, tailored market studies, M&A support, and infrastructure development.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us

We are looking for a Risk Management Consulting Specialist with a strong background in the energy industry. Our team seeks someone with expertise in portfolio management, implementing hedging strategies, and trading or procuring power, gas, and renewable energy credits. The Risk Management Consulting Specialist will be proficient in standard methodologies for risk assessment and crafting risk programs.

This is a remote position in the U.S.

This opportunity offers remote flexibility and a collaborative culture built on honesty, accountability, empowerment, and autonomy. You will have opportunities to shape client strategies, develop colleagues, and grow the practice.

You’ll make an impact as you:

  • Lead client discussions, identify business needs, explain trade-offs, and recommend action.
  • Develop procurement, hedging, and portfolio-risk strategies for power, natural gas, refined products, and other related exposures.
  • Connect market fundamentals and portfolio risks to client objectives, budgets, and operational constraints.
  • Design and review risk analyses, including VaR, cash-flow-at-risk, stress testing, and hedge effectiveness.
  • Develop risk policies, governance frameworks, and limits; support implementation of approved strategies.
  • Translate client needs into ETRM analyses, workflows, controls, and reporting.
  • Lead engagements and workstreams, owning analytical quality, scope, budgets, and deadlines.
  • Turn insights on emerging commodity risks into recommendations, presentations, and new services.
  • Build client relationships, identify opportunities, develop proposals, and help win profitable engagements.
  • Mentor consultants, delegate effectively, and strengthen analytical and client-facing skills.
  • Improve delivery through automation, reusable tools, and standardized methods.
  • Align client and internal stakeholders, contributing as a hands-on specialist or project director.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, economics, finance, statistics, physics, mathematics, or a related analytical field.
  • 15+ years in commodity risk management, as well as energy trading, portfolio management, procurement, or related consulting.
  • Substantial power and/or natural gas risk experience, including hedging strategy and implementation. (Commodity risk management required.)
  • Strong quantitative foundations demonstrated through hands-on modeling, analysis, or validation during your career.
  • Ability to challenge methods, data, and assumptions and explain their commercial implications.
  • Experience developing risk programs for physical and contractual energy portfolios.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts and deliver actionable recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience leading complex projects, managing priorities, and owning delivery quality.
  • Experience mentoring colleagues and reviewing analytical work.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 20%.
  • Ability to work in the U.S. without current or future employer-sponsored work authorization.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in finance, financial engineering, quantitative finance, economics, or a related field.
  • Consulting or external client-advisory experience.
  • Success building client relationships, developing proposals, and winning engagements.
  • Entrade or other energy trading and risk management platform experience.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Python, SQL, R, or advanced Excel.
  • Experience across energy markets and client types, including utilities, municipalities, large users, and suppliers.
  • Experience developing thought leadership, presenting to executives, or creating advisory services.

jobs.title: Distribution Sales Executive - Automation
jobs.description_html:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

Transform the every day with us!

The Distribution Sell With Executive for Digital Industries (DI) Automation will aid and facilitate the successful growth of revenue derived through the Indirect Channel in terms of supporting distributors directly through the sales cycle, coaching on account management, opportunity management and deal closure to meet revenue objectives.

As the Distribution Sell With Executive (DSE), you will support our sales network throughout the sales cycle ensuring appropriate resources are provided to drive Digital Industries sales and revenue of our portfolio. You will work with the partners to help develop new and expanding business, with a focus on developing a value proposition, to help onboard new customers and drive revenue growth.

Candidate required to create industry-focused initiatives and detailed territory plan to drive execution, account strategy and resource alignment for all stakeholders to achieve expansion goals. Distribution Sell With Executive (DSE) reports directly to the Distribution Sell With Manager as part of the Partner Sales organization.

We are looking for a Distribution Sell With Executive. This position is remote but candidate must be located in Florida.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities in assigned accounts, territories, or verticals.
  • Lead complex negotiations to create mutually beneficial outcomes.
  • Align customer needs with Siemens solutions.
  • Build strong relationships with key decision-makers and Channel Distributors.
  • Coach and mentor distributor teams to improve sales productivity, shorten sales cycles, and increase win rates by:
  • Helping distributors balance 'Hunter/Farmer' sales strategies.
  • Guiding distributors to identify key buyer personas and drive growth.
  • Advising on target markets, industries, and digital-social selling strategies.
  • Coaching on opportunity and pipeline management using Siemens CRM.
  • Providing sales and negotiation tactics to win business.
  • Additionally, you will develop strategic account plans and sales pipelines to meet and exceed quotas. 

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of direct sales/business development experience with a proven sales track record.
  • 8+ years of experience selling high-tech products such as OT to IoT in an automation enviornment.
  • Strong ability to coach and transfer sales knowledge to partners.
  • Experience building a qualified pipeline, identifying new opportunities, and exceeding sales targets.
  • Expertise in managing complex sales cycles and guiding extended teams to close deals.
  • Strategic thinking to identify and address customer pain points and needs.
  • Knowledge of Channel Sales and the indirect reseller model.
  • Experience selling to "C-level" executives in the SMB market.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet customers and partners.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Superior organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to multitask managing multiple projects and campaigns
  • Experience dealing with cross functional, matrixed teams

jobs.title: US Head of Vertical Market – Life Sciences
jobs.description_html:
At Siemens, we empower our customers by combining the real and digital worlds to improve how we live, work, and move today and for future generations. Our people are at the center of everything we do, driving innovation, collaboration, and sustainable growth.

We are looking for a US Head of Vertical Market – Life Sciences.

The One Tech Company transformation is creating new opportunities for Siemens to bring together innovative technologies, deep industry expertise, and cross-business collaboration to serve customers in more meaningful ways. The US Head of Vertical Market – Life Sciences will help lead this effort across one of Siemens' most important strategic markets. This role will serve as a key connector across businesses, stakeholders, and customers, helping to align market strategies, unlock growth opportunities, and strengthen Siemens' position throughout the Life Sciences ecosystem.

You'll Make an Impact By

  • Leading Siemens USA’s growth strategy and business plan for the assigned Vertical, aligning global Vertical priorities with US market trends, customer needs, competitive insights, and the One Tech Company ambition.
  • Serving as the US representative for the global Vertical and as the primary local coordination point for Siemens US leadership, the global Vertical organization, Siemens businesses, customers, partners, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Operating as an integrated member of the global Vertical organization, with a solid-line reporting relationship within Siemens US and a strong dotted-line relationship into the global Vertical organization.
  • Leading strategic opportunity capture and pursuits by mobilizing Siemens businesses, orchestrating cross-business resources and executive sponsorship, and creating a coordinated One Tech Company experience for customers.
  • Building and leading the US Vertical community across businesses, functions, sales teams, regions, and channels to align priorities, strengthen collaboration, and accelerate growth.
  • Developing and executing the US Vertical business plan, including market priorities, target segments, focus accounts, strategic opportunities, ecosystem partnerships, and growth initiatives.
  • Determining the localization of global Vertical strategy, including US go-to-market approaches, account focus, sales motions, channel and partner strategies, and coordinated marketing execution.
  • Building trusted executive customer and ecosystem relationships, representing Siemens in the market, and expanding Siemens’ influence through industry engagement, advocacy, and thought leadership.
  • Acting as the voice of the US customer, market, and industry by translating insights into enterprise action, portfolio priorities, solution development, investment choices, enablement needs, and business results.
  • Leveraging global Vertical leadership, market development, architecture, subject matter experts, and other supporting capabilities to accelerate local strategy, opportunity development, solution design, and execution.
  • Identifying cross-business synergies, portfolio and capability needs, solution gaps, resource requirements, and investment priorities, and aligning the appropriate Siemens businesses and functions to address them.
  • Ensuring relevant Siemens capabilities—including sales enablement, marketing, financing, consulting, architecture, and other supporting functions—are engaged in the right opportunities and implemented effectively.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of Life Sciences industry experience and knowledge, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, and healthcare, with an understanding of industry customers, market dynamics, supply chain complexities, regulatory requirements, and digital transformation trends.
  • Deep understanding of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and CDMO manufacturing environments and the business, operational, quality, and technology priorities shaping these markets.
  • Knowledge of FDA, EMA, and other global Life Sciences regulatory frameworks, including GxP requirements such as GMP, GCP, and GLP, as well as GAMP 5 principles.
  • Experience with Life Sciences digital transformation initiatives and technologies, including MES, Electronic Batch Records (EBR), PLM, laboratory informatics, quality management systems, industrial data management, AI, digital thread, and digital twin technologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.
  • Ability to travel approximately 30–40%.
  • Must be eligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding Siemens’ portfolio, with the ability to identify and apply relevant solutions across Digital Industries, Smart Infrastructure, Mobility, Software, Financial Services, and consulting offerings to address Life Sciences customer needs.
  • Proven ability to drive strategic business development in highly regulated environments, including identifying growth opportunities, developing account strategies, and navigating complex sales cycles and customer pursuits.
  • Ability to translate Siemens technologies and digitalization capabilities into meaningful customer outcomes, such as accelerating drug development and technology transfer, improving manufacturing efficiency and quality, increasing asset availability, strengthening regulatory compliance, and reducing operational risk.
  • Ability to engage credibly with customers on Life Sciences reference architectures, digital manufacturing strategies, and technology roadmaps.
  • Strong customer-facing and executive credibility with senior leaders across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and CDMO organizations.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the broader Life Sciences ecosystem, including technology partners, OEMs and machine builders, engineering and system integration partners, and industry organizations such as ISPE.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and influence, with the ability to align diverse internal businesses and teams while engaging effectively with customers, regulators, technology partners, and industry leaders.
  • Strategic and commercial acumen, with the ability to anticipate industry and regulatory shifts, translate market needs into growth priorities and business plans, and connect Siemens’ broader portfolio to customer challenges across the Life Sciences value chain.
  • Innovation and digital transformation mindset, with an understanding of emerging technologies and their potential to accelerate drug discovery and development, optimize manufacturing, improve quality and productivity, and drive better outcomes across the Life Sciences value chain.

Scope, Impact & Accountability

As the Head of Vertical Market Strategy, you will be responsible for shaping and executing Siemens' U.S. growth strategy within your assigned market vertical. You will serve as the connective leader across Siemens’ businesses, bringing together teams, solutions, and expertise to help customers solve their most critical challenges.

In this highly visible role, you will translate global strategy into market-specific growth plans, identify and pursue strategic opportunities, and help drive go-to-market priorities across the U.S. market. You will serve as the voice of the U.S. customer within Siemens' global vertical organization, helping influence future portfolio development, ecosystem partnerships, and investment priorities based on evolving market needs.

Success in this position requires the ability to build alignment across a complex organization, inspire collaboration among diverse stakeholders, and orchestrate high-value opportunities that accelerate growth. Working closely with business leaders, sales teams, and subject matter experts around the world, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening Siemens' market position and expanding our impact within the industry.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $171,000 - $293,000 annually with a target incentive of 25% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

  • Strong communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across businesses and functions without direct authority.
  • Strategic business acumen with the ability to anticipate industry shifts, identify growth opportunities, shape market and account strategies, and drive profitable growth.
