jobs.title: Business and Financial Professional
jobs.description_html:
Business and Financial Professional


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

Join our Smart Infrastructure (SI) team as our Business and Financial Professional

to help us to successfully manage all financial aspects across our network of factories. The successful candidate will report to the Electrical Products Finance Operations Manager of Governance and Performance Controller, partner closely with the Head of Finance, North America Operations, Fin. Director of Operations, Systems, EP NA Factories, the Segment Fin teams and other functions while owning and improving financial aspects of accuracy of books and records, planning and controlling, measuring the achievement of KPIs and driving improvement projects

We are looking for Business and Financial Professional. This position will be based preferably at Peachtree Corners, GA or at one of our US Plant locations, Remote work would also be considered.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Lead performance controlling, governance, and financial oversight for key operational and corporate initiatives, including but not limited to:
    • EP NA OFLDP Program Lead
    • Expansion Controlling, Reporting, Transparency and Commentary
    • Standard and Ad hoc Analytics
    • Partner to EP NA FIN OPS Leadership on driving Strategic initiatives
    • EP NA FIN OPS Special Projects
    • Knowledge sharing with OPS Technical teams
    • Additional strategic initiatives as assigned
  • Partner proactively with factory leadership, operations teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive corrective actions.
  • Develop and deliver management presentations, business reviews, and decision proposals that support executive decision-making.
  • Independently analyze complex business, organizational, process, and system-related topics, translating findings into actionable recommendations and measurable improvement initiatives.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for assigned areas of responsibility, providing guidance, governance, and best practices across the organization.
  • Drive the continuous enhancement of reporting, analytics, and business intelligence tools to improve transparency, standardization, and productivity.
  • Perform regular and ad hoc analysis of business performance against targets, proactively identifying trends, risks, anomalies, and improvement opportunities.
  • Facilitate constructive performance discussions with factories and key stakeholders to ensure accountability and achievement of business objectives.
  • Provide qualified backup support across the EP NA Finance Operations Governance and Performance Controlling organization, ensuring continuity of critical processes and deliverables.
  • Support special projects, strategic initiatives, and other business requirements as needed.

Key Competencies

  • Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
  • Performance Management
  • Business Partnering
  • Executive Communication
  • Governance & Compliance
  • Process Improvement
  • Data Analytics & Reporting
  • Project Leadership
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Strategic Thinking

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:

  • BS in Accounting, Finance.
  • 8-10 years’ experience in Finance, preferably in a manufacturing plant environment
  • Very strong in depth knowledge of SAP (FI/CO) and digitalization- / automation tools (Tableau, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Strong Networking-, Collaboration- and Stakeholder Management skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Project Management Skills and Experience / Change Management experience
  • Solution oriented thinking and ability to practically apply methodic approaches to overcome business challenges
  • Ability to effectively manage deadlines, prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience and in-depth know how of large and complex manufacturing environments
  • Comprehensive SCM- and manufacturing process understanding (beyond finance)

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. 

Protecting the environment, conserving our natural resources, fostering the health and performance of our people as well as safeguarding their working conditions are core to our social and business commitment at Siemens. They are an integral part of our Business Conduct Guidelines and our corporate strategy.

Sr. Business Financial Analyst

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Transform the everyday with us!


Join our Smart Infrastructure (SI) team as our Sr. Business Financial Analyst to help us to successfully manage all financial aspects across our network of factories. The successful candidate will report to the Electrical Products Finance Operations Manager of Governance and Performance Controller, partner closely with the Head of Finance, North America Operations, Fin. Director of Operations, Systems, EP NA Factories, the Segment Fin teams and other functions while owning and improving financial aspects of accuracy of books and records, planning and controlling, measuring the achievement of KPIs and driving improvement projects

Sr. Business Financial Analyst position can be located in Peachtree Corners, near one of our SI EP plants or remote eligibility is generally limited to current Siemens employees or candidates with a proven track record of success in remote work environments.


As the Senior Business & Financial Analyst, you will make an impact by:

  • Lead performance controlling, governance, and financial oversight for key operational and corporate initiatives, including:
    • Tariff transparency, management and analysis
    • Freight cost performance and optimization
    • Headcount planning and controlling
    • Delegation of Authority (LoA) governance
    • Central Operations cost center planning, forecasting, and controlling
    • Additional strategic initiatives as assigned
  • Partner proactively with factory leadership, operations teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive corrective actions.
  • Develop and deliver management presentations, business reviews, and decision proposals that support executive decision-making.
  • Independently analyze complex business, organizational, process, and system-related topics, translating findings into actionable recommendations and measurable improvement initiatives.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for assigned areas of responsibility, providing guidance, governance, and best practices across the organization.
  • Drive the continuous enhancement of reporting, analytics, and business intelligence tools to improve transparency, standardization, and productivity.
  • Perform regular and ad hoc analysis of business performance against targets, proactively identifying trends, risks, anomalies, and improvement opportunities.
  • Facilitate constructive performance discussions with factories and key stakeholders to ensure accountability and achievement of business objectives.
  • Provide qualified backup support across the EP NA Finance Operations Governance and Performance Controlling organization, ensuring continuity of critical processes and deliverables.
  • Support special projects, strategic initiatives, and other business requirements as needed.

Key Competencies

  • Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
  • Performance Management
  • Business Partnering
  • Executive Communication
  • Governance & Compliance
  • Process Improvement
  • Data Analytics & Reporting
  • Project Leadership
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Strategic Thinking

You will make a strong impact if you have the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • BS in Accounting, Finance.
  • 5 +years of experience in Finance (level 7)
  • 8+ years of experience in Finance (level 6)
  • Experience and in-depth knowledge of large and complex manufacturing environments
  • Comprehensive SCM- and manufacturing process understanding (beyond finance)
  • Very strong in-depth knowledge of SAP (FI/CO) and digitalization- / automation tools (Tableau, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Strong Networking-, Collaboration- and Stakeholder Management skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Project Management Skills and Experience / Change Management experience
  • Solution oriented thinking and ability to practically apply methodic approaches to overcome business challenges
  • Ability to effectively manage deadlines, prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Finance or CPA
  • 5-10 years’ experience in Finance, preferably in a manufacturing plant environment

Job Level Disclosure:
This position will be posted and hired at one of two job levels based on candidate qualifications and experience in a related field and successful demonstration of Key Responsibilities and Knowledge as presented above

Level 7: Requires a minimum of 5+ years of applicable professional experience Salary Range: $74,970-$128,520
Level 6: Requires a minimum of 8+ + years of applicable professional experience- Salary Range: $91,463-$156,794

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Tampa, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Tampa, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Client Service Managers manage a portfolio of service agreements (through delivery) and are responsible for profit and loss of these agreements. As a Client Service Manager, ensuring the financial performance of our service agreements and customer satisfaction are critical to our success. You’ll be working directly with the customer to develop trusted-advisor relationships and recommend services and solutions. 


As a Client Service Manager, you will:  

  • Manage assigned service agreement accounts, driving to a financial target and outstanding customer satisfaction and retention
  • Balance time between on-site customer interactions and back-office responsibilities
  • Develop account strategies to achieve the customer’s business goals, leveraging the company’s entire service and product portfolio
  • Develop service delivery plans with the customer to provide service agreement scope of work
  • Identify customer needs and make prioritized recommendations for service agreement adds, upgrades, and escalations
  • Participate in the development of a master schedule to deliver service for all customers in the service area and lead quality assurance activities that will support service agreement renewals
  • Maintain excellent organizational and interpersonal skills


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED
  • 3+ years of on-the-job experience working within:
  • The Building Technology industry
  • Engineering HVAC or Building Automation systems
  • Experience using Microsoft Office and business software systems
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience in demand-side energy services or Certified Energy Manager 
  • Associate degree from a two-year/technical college or bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of experience in the building technology industry

jobs.title: AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect
jobs.description_html:
AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect

 

Position Overview 

 

The AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect will serve as a global technical authority for compute, networking, storage, memory, and IT infrastructure architecture within Siemens' AI Factory organization. The role will track how AI, hyperscale, cloud, HPC, and enterprise platforms are evolving and convert those changes into actionable AI Factory reference architectures and go-to-market guidance. The successful candidate will bring practical experience building or architecting large-scale compute, network, and storage environments and enough data-center fluency to translate upstream IT decisions into clear implications for power, cooling, controls, physical topology, resiliency, and deployment strategy. A critical responsibility is to partner with electrical, thermal/liquid cooling, controls & automation, digital thread, and regional Solutions Architects, rack density, cluster topology, network fabrics, storage architecture, and workload behavior are accurately reflected in the complete AI Factory architecture. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Serve as the technical authority for AI, HPC, cloud, and enterprise infrastructure architectures. 
  • Evaluate emerging processor, accelerator, networking, memory, and storage technologies and assess their impact on AI Factory designs. 
  • Develop scalable reference architectures spanning compute, storage, networking, racks, clusters, and data hall environments. 
  • Translate IT infrastructure requirements into actionable inputs for electrical, cooling, controls, and facility design teams. 
  • Partner with customers, hyperscalers, enterprises, and technology partners on infrastructure strategy and architecture planning. 
  • Develop technical guidance, architecture frameworks, and thought leadership content supporting sales and go-to-market initiatives. 
 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; Master’s preferred. 
  • 10+ years of experience in compute infrastructure, networking, storage, cloud, HPC, enterprise systems, or hyperscale environments. 
  • 5+ years in architecture, principal engineering, technical leadership, or equivalent roles. 
  • Proven experience designing or architecting large-scale infrastructure environments. 
  • Experience with AI infrastructure, accelerated computing, HPC, hyperscale, or high-density data centers. 
  • Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Ability to travel up to 30-50%. 
 

Technical Expertise 

  • Large-scale compute, AI, HPC, cloud, or hyperscale infrastructure environments. 
  • Server, CPU, GPU, and accelerator architectures. 
  • AI training and inference platforms. 
  • Data center networking including Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE, and AI fabrics. 
  • Enterprise and high-performance storage architectures. 
  • Linux, virtualization, containers, and distributed systems. 
  • Rack-level infrastructure, power, cooling, and high-density deployments. 
  • Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into scalable architecture strategies. 
 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep expertise in compute, HPC, networking, AI infrastructure, hyperscale systems, or a related domain. 
  • Broad knowledge across compute, networking, storage, and data center infrastructure. 
  • Strong systems thinking with the ability to translate technology trends into business and architectural value. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive alignment across technical and business stakeholders. 
  • Executive presence with strong communication and presentation skills. 
  • Ability to simplify complex technologies into actionable architectural decisions. 
  • Innovation mindset with a passion for learning emerging technologies and industry trends. 
 

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

 

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

   

You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $137,000.00 - $222,000.00 annually with a target incentive of 10 of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Building Automation Service Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Tallahassee, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Tallahassee, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Service Specialists perform assigned tasks on building automation systems. Tasks include service agreement maintenance, projects, and on-call (time and material) service. Responds to emergency service calls as directed during regularly scheduled hours and after hours as needed. Our ServiceSpecialists are the face of Siemens, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customer will help them save energy and money, as well as create a more sustainable future for our environment.   

  

As a Service Specialist, you will:  

  • Execute digitalization and standard service operations strategies
  • Work with multiple internal service team members including Service Sales, Client Service Managers, Service Coordinators, and RAM Digital Service Center personnel
  • Follow safety requirements as outlined by Siemens and customers and successfully completes assigned training as outlined in the training path
  • Follow mandatory policies, procedures, and standards, may coordinate with contractors on job sites, maintains tools and test equipment
  • Support after hours during on-call rotation, responds to service calls (emergency and on-site) as assigned. Performs repairs as directed on all automation system types 
  • Be responsible for completing service ticket documentation per the policy, follow and maintain preventive maintenance schedules
  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation of services performed and generates reports within Siemens tools
  • Provide instructions to customer personnel regarding proper system operations and assists with training
  • Identify and reports system discrepancies, suggests system upgrade opportunities, and may assist in pricing of repairs and upgrades to existing agreement and performs system checkout and startup on projects
  • Work overtime when needed (Compressed schedule performance can be a factor and will require extended hours to meet commitments)
  • Work rotational on-call and/or minimal overnight travel
  • Participate in job site final walk and/or final completion for systems-to-service turnover on assigned jobs performs other duties as assigned


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • 1+ years of experience servicing electronic control or HVAC equipment 
  • Electro-mechanical experience (either in a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skill
  • Ability and willingness to work in a variety of circumstances, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in various conditions
  • Must be able and willing to use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet as well as carrying and moving equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) 
  • Ability and willingness to work overtime and be on call on a standard rotation 
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED 
  • Specialized skill training/certification 
  • 1+ years of experience installing and servicing electronic control or HVAC equipment
  • Knowledge of building automation systems, PLCs, HVAC, electrical concepts, and building operations 
  • Engineering and programming (PLC or BMS) background 
  • Knowledge of building system communication protocols (BACnet, Modbus, TCP/IP)

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn't just about improving buildings; it's about creating perfect places that improve people's lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


An Associate Project Manager at Siemens is responsible for the coordination and delivery of multiple, simultaneous projects of varying complexities. For projects with a financial impact of less than $100K, the Associate Project Manager holds fiscal cost reporting responsibilities for all project facets, including project billing, job responsibility, and overall customer satisfaction.


As the Associate Project Manager, you will:

  • Review project specifications, drawings, and project-specific documents to establish project intent.
  • Develop and maintain a project schedule and coordinate needs with the project team, identifying time-sensitive installation requirements.
  • Manage the requisition of supplies and materials to complete projects.
  • Review plans and specifications and participate in project cost reviews.
  • Assist the Operations Manager in the solicitation and contracting of subcontractors.
  • Conduct orientations for project technicians and provide comprehensive project documentation, including scope of work, drawings, applicable specifications, application-engineered drawings, and project contacts.
  • Track resources and project progress.
  • Document project events that impact the schedule, scope of work, and project efficiency.
  • Pursue project-specific change-order opportunities.
  • Coordinate and pursue project-specific billing, collaborating with the Accounting team and Operations Manager.
  • Schedule project-specific commissioning resources and provide commissioning documentation.
  • Expedite the return of project-specific mark-ups for as-built development.
  • Complete project-specific close-out documentation.
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures, and report unsafe conditions and actions.


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Associate degree or Technical Degree, Construction, Engineering or similar
  • Technical experience in the HVAC controls industry, construction, engineering (electrical or mechanical), or similar
  • Must be able to demonstrate knowledge and understanding of HVAC industry applications; ability to read and understand MEP drawings and specifications, and electrical, network, and control wiring diagrams.
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Mechanical or Electrical Engineering degree 
  • 3+ years of technical experience in the HVAC controls industry
  • Knowledge of industry-standard communication protocols such as Ethernet, Modbus, and/or BACnet

jobs.title: Financial Analyst- Controlling
jobs.description_html:
Financial Analyst -Controlling Professional

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

At Siemens Grid Software, we accelerate and secure a successful Energy Transition

Today the energy world is changing to become carbon neutral. Distributed Energy Resources are growing rapidly and decentralized power generation is transforming how energy systems operate. Utility companies are rethinking their IT/OT landscapes and require agile, data-driven solutions to operate efficiently and securely.

At Siemens Grid Software, we are at the forefront of this transformation, enabling our customers through advanced digital solutions, analytics, and software platforms.

Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens Grid Software here:

https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/energy/topics/smart-grid.html


Our Culture

At Siemens Grid Software, we foster an ownership culture where employees take responsibility, collaborate openly, and continuously improve. We value innovation, transparency, and data-driven decision-making. Our teams operate globally and work closely across functions to drive meaningful business outcomes.

We have major locations in Minneapolis, MN; Foster City, CA; Schenectady, NY; Houston, TX; and Wendell, NC. 


Who are we seeking?

We are looking for a Financial Analyst – Controlling with a solid foundation in finance and a genuine interest in data, analytics, and automation. You will join the Grid Software Services Americas finance team, reporting to the Head of Finance, supporting the full portfolio with a focus on Power Technologies International (PTI), our power systems consulting and engineering business.

You are a hands-on contributor who keeps the day-to-day running accurately and on time – and who looks at every manual, repetitive step and asks “how do we standardize this, and can we automate it?” You will have the support and room to make that happen, turning routine work into reliable, repeatable processes and freeing up time for analysis that helps the business make decisions.


We are looking for Financial Analyst. This position follows a remote work model, allowing employees to work primarily from a home office while supporting business needs as required.


You’ll make an impact by:

PTI Finance Operations

  • Business partnering: Support the finance partner for PTI leadership, project managers, and sales, providing analysis of revenue, margin, costs, and backlog for a consulting business that runs on people, hours, and projects.
  • Project financials: Support PTI project and order setup, review time and billing data, and maintain accurate project revenue recognition (Percentage of Completion) in SAP.
  • Utilization & capacity: Prepare utilization, capacity, and headcount reporting that feeds the monthly business review and helps leadership balance workload against demand.
  • Operational accuracy: Handle a steady volume of transactional and data-entry work with care, and document each recurring process so knowledge is shared across the team rather than held by one person.
Financial Steering & FP&A
  • Closing & Reporting: Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end activities. Lead margin analysis and backlog reporting to ensure a clear picture of business health.
  • Variance Analysis: Prepare monthly commentary that tells the story behind the numbers, explaining variances between actual results and forecasts with clarity and insight.
  • Planning & forecasting: Contribute to budget, forecast, and recurring headquarters requests for the PTI business.
  • Business analysis: Perform targeted data analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

Commercial Operations (Order-to-Cash)

  • O2C Management: Own and improve the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process, including customer setup, order intake, invoicing, and cash receipt.
  • Issue resolution: Spot and help resolve bottlenecks in billing and collections to improve cash flow and customer satisfaction.

Standardization & Automation

  • Standardize: Turn recurring processes into consistent templates, checklists, and controls that others on the team can run.
  • Automate: Identify manual steps and reduce them over time using tools such as Power Query, Power Automate, and KNIME – progressively shifting your own time from data entry to analysis.
  • Partner on reporting: Work alongside the team’s Financial Data Architect, who owns the data models and Power BI platform; you bring the process expertise and are a key user and tester of the reporting tools.
You will impress us by having the following:

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in finance and/or accounting roles, ideally within a multinational, software, or professional-services organization.
  • Solid understanding of IFRS 15 / US GAAP ASC 606 (Percentage of Completion, Cost-to-Cost Method), specifically within a project environment.
  • Proficiency with SAP FI and CO modules.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query and relational data modeling – well beyond VLOOKUPs.
  • A strong desire to learn and apply tools like Power BI, Power Automate, and KNIME to improve how finance works.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States without Visa sponsorship
Preferred Qualifications
  • MBA or professional certification (CPA/CMA).
  • Experience in a consulting or professional-services environment (utilization, time-and-materials and fixed-price project billing).
  • Exposure to SQL or Python.
  • Ability to manage tight deadlines and high-volume work while keeping an uncompromising eye for detail and a collaborative spirit.

Why this role is unique

  • The PTI Edge: You will support Power Technologies International (PTI), the "brains" of the energy transition, gaining exposure to high-level consulting and technical software financials.

  • Digitalization Playground: You will have the autonomy to identify automation opportunities and build the tools that will modernize our regional reporting.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.


You’ll Benefit From

jobs.title: Industry Marketing Manager – Semiconductors US
jobs.description_html:
About Siemens Digital Industry Software 

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer-aided design, 3D modeling, and simulation—helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large enterprise and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world-class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, ensuring our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Position Summary 

The Industry Marketing Manager for Semiconductors turns industry strategy, customer insight, and Siemens’ portfolio strengths into focused go-to-market (GTM) priorities, differentiated messaging, executable campaign direction, and high-impact sales enablement materials. Serving as the marketing subject-matter expert for the semiconductor industry, you will connect market opportunities, customer needs, industry priorities, solution capabilities, and business objectives to create actionable strategies that accelerate awareness, engagement, pipeline creation, and revenue growth. Operating as a key integrator across industry leadership, product marketing, sales, technical experts, and implementation teams, success in this role requires both strategic industry leadership and the ability to navigate a complex, matrixed organization while maintaining a razor-sharp focus on customer relevance and business impact. 

Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Ownership & Evolution: Own and continuously evolve the semiconductor go-to-market intent, translating high-level strategy into clear target segments, buying groups, personas, Digital Thread and Solution Domain priorities, and campaign plans.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the industry marketing lead within cross-functional implementation. Bring customer and market relevance to delivery teams, clarify business rationale, surface dependencies and risks, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Audience & Persona Strategy: Lead buyer-audience definitions and validate persona-to-topic mapping to reflect how semiconductor companies organize, buy, and transform.
  • Messaging & Value Proposition: Develop and maintain industry messaging frameworks and briefs that connect customer challenges to differentiated Siemens value. Translate highly technical input into credible, outcome-led narratives for executive, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with industry leaders, solution managers, Digital Thread Factory leads, solution/core marketers, technical experts, and sales to align solution definition, audience strategy, and messaging.
  • Campaign & Content Direction: Lead integrated campaign definitions from strategy through handoff, providing complete inputs for campaign overviews, prioritized topics, audiences, imperatives, messaging, and content requirements while supporting content creators with clear strategic direction.
  • Sales Enablement: Own the creation and delivery of enablement and go-to-market materials that sellers use because they map directly to real customer priorities. Customer Insight & Market Intelligence: Build a continuous feedback loop through customer conversations, sales interactions, customer advocacy, events, market research, and performance data to validate assumptions and guide investment.
  • Customer Insight & Market Intelligence: Build a continuous feedback loop through customer conversations, sales interactions, customer advocacy, events, market research, and performance data to validate assumptions and guide investment.
  • Industry Fluency: Monitor fast-moving semiconductor market and technology developments, including AI and custom silicon, EDA, software-defined development, advanced packaging, silicon photonics, fab/sub-fab digitalization, manufacturing optimization, sustainability, and supply-chain resilience.
  • Governance & Execution: Resolve ambiguity, escalate gaps in ownership or portfolio readiness with clear business implications, and rigorously document decisions, trade-offs, and next steps.
  • Evangelism: Represent the semiconductor industry in internal planning, executive reviews, customer engagements, and key industry forums.
What Success Looks Like
  • Delivery of customer-relevant messaging with the deep technical credibility required by semiconductor audiences.
  • Tight, measurable alignment across industry, solution, campaign, sales, and technical stakeholders. A focused, evidence-based semiconductor campaign strategy that teams can easily understand and execute.
  • High adoption of campaigns and enablement assets by sales teams due to their direct connection to real-world buyer challenges.
  • A trusted, up-to-date industry point of view that adapts to market shifts and sharpens prioritization over time.
Required Skills & Capabilities
  • Industry Expertise: Deep understanding of the semiconductor industry, its ecosystem, value chain, business models, buying dynamics, and technology trends.
  • Technical Agility: Ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts and distinguish enduring customer needs from short-lived market hype.
  • GTM Strategy: Strong command of go-to-market strategy, segmentation, audience definition, positioning, messaging, and B2B campaign planning.
  • Executive Storytelling: Exceptional strategic writing and storytelling skills; ability to make complex engineering and software topics clear, differentiated, and relevant across all levels of a customer organization. Data-Driven & Inquiring Mindset: Demonstrated customer mindset and research discipline; skilled at combining qualitative insights, market intelligence, competitive context, and performance data to challenge assumptions and guide decisions.
  • Data-Driven & Inquiring Mindset: Demonstrated customer mindset and research discipline; skilled at combining qualitative insights, market intelligence, competitive context, and performance data to challenge assumptions and guide decisions.
  • Influence Without Authority: Proven ability to lead through a global matrixed organization, aligning senior leaders, technical specialists, marketers, sales teams, and external agencies.
  • Project Leadership: Strong leadership and project management skills, including prioritization, decision framing, dependency management, issue escalation, workshop facilitation, and on-time delivery.
  • Business & Sales Acumen: Ability to connect marketing choices directly to growth priorities, pipeline requirements, adoption barriers, and seller readiness.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable thriving in environments characterized by ambiguity and constant change.
  • Communication: Executive-ready verbal communication and presentation skills, coupled with excellent written English.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field (advanced degree or equivalent relevant experience preferred).
  • 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, go-to-market strategy, product marketing, or industry marketing, preferably within the semiconductor, EDA, or industrial software environments.
  • Demonstrated track record of developing audience strategies, messaging frameworks, campaign briefs, thought leadership, sales enablement, and executive presentations.
  • Extensive experience collaborating with global, cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders in complex, matrixed corporate structures.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience spanning multiple segments of the semiconductor value chain, or successfully bridging EDA, systems engineering, simulation, lifecycle management, and manufacturing narratives.
  • Hands-on experience supporting both overarching GTM strategy and integrated tactical campaigns.
  • An established professional network within the semiconductor ecosystem, with strong familiarity with major industry events, associations, and the media landscape.
"Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States".

Why Join Us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility—choosing between working from home and collaborating in the office is a standard part of our culture. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and the robust rewards package you would expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time across more than 200 countries. We are dedicated to equality and welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities where we live and work. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity, creativity, and drive, and help us shape tomorrow. 

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday.

The pay range for this position is 147,500 - 265,600 annually with a target incentive of 10 - 15% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Senior Storage Administrator - US Remote
jobs.description_html:
About Siemens Digital Industries Software
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a global leader in industrial software, empowering companies worldwide to drive innovation and digital transformation through our comprehensive portfolio of products and solutions. Our cutting-edge technology helps create precise digital twins, enabling customers to master the complexity of smart products and processes.


Join our dynamic Global Storage Team, a strategic pillar supporting Siemens Digital Industries Software's engineers and corporate staff across numerous R&D centers and offices worldwide. 


The Role

As a Senior Storage Administrator, you will be instrumental in driving efficiency and innovation by assisting with the automation of our enterprise storage infrastructure. You'll leverage your deep expertise in NetApp and EverPure/Pure Storage to deliver highly available, performant, and cost-effective solutions, playing a critical role in our digital transformation journey.


Key Responsibilities

The Senior Storage Administrator will also be responsible for critical storage operations support in a primarily NAS environment and will participate in a global on-call rotation. Must be able to perform problem resolution in an effective and timely manner in accordance with SLA's and customer expectations. Time management and prioritization skills will be required to accommodate business requirements and manage scheduled activities. Must work well in a team environment and possess strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Infrastructure Management: Storage platforms administration, monitoring, upgrading, installation and setup, configuration, testing, and deployments optimized for software development and build environments.

  • Performance Engineering & Tuning: Drive performance tuning, capacity planning, and troubleshooting in large-scale enterprise environments with high IOPs and throughput demands (supporting CI/CD pipelines, EDA workloads, and developer scratch spaces).

  • Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Spearhead process automation, expert scripting, and IaC to enable self-service storage provisioning for engineering teams.

  • Vendor & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with architecture, DevOps, and service delivery teams on new and existing infrastructure initiatives; manage vendor escalations for critical support issues.

  • Operations & Support: Handle tier-3 support tickets for complex customer/developer issues and participate in a global on-call rotation. Ensure reliable operations in a primarily NAS/SAN environment in accordance with strict SLAs.

Job Qualifications

  • Education: BS degree (or equivalent) in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MS degree is preferred.

  • Experience: 5+ years of directly applicable enterprise storage administration experience in large-scale corporate or software engineering environments.

  • Core Storage Expertise:

    • 5+ years working with Network Appliance NAS/SAN technologies, including in-depth experience with NetApp Cluster Mode (cDot) and management tools (e.g., Active IQ Unified Manager).

    • Hands-on administration and troubleshooting experience with Everpure Storage or modern all-flash scale-out platforms.

    • Robust understanding of Data Protection technologies, including SnapMirror/Snapvault replications and disaster recovery paradigms.

  • Software Development & Engineering Support Alignment:

    • Demonstrated experience supporting software development organizations, understanding the unique IO profile of software builds, test execution, compilation workloads, and artifact repositories.

    • Familiarity with High-Performance Computing (HPC) and EDA (Electronic Design Automation) storage requirements (handling high small-file IOPS, concurrency, and massive throughput).

  • Automation & Scripting: Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Ansible, REST APIs, and Terraform/IaC to eliminate manual administrative toil.

  • OS & Networking Fundamentals: Solid understanding of networking protocols (NFS, SMB/CIFS, TCP/IP) and deep operating system administration skills (Linux and Windows) for diagnosing client-side storage bottlenecks, permissions, and mount issues.

  • Operations Mindset: Solid understanding of problem management, incident management, and change control processes in a global enterprise. Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Knowledge / Skills, Education, and Experience

  • Development Toolchain Familiarity: Exposure to modern developer tools and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, Docker/Kubernetes persistent volumes).

  • Certifications: NetApp Certified Storage Associate/Professional (NCSA/NCIE) or Pure Storage certifications highly desired. 

  • Virtualization & Cloud: Experience with OpenStack, VMware, or hybrid-cloud storage tiering.

  • EDA Industry Knowledge: Specific familiarity with semiconductor or mechanical EDA tool storage tuning.


"Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States".

You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is 129,600 - 233,300 annually with a target incentive of 5-10 of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

 Development Toolchain Familiarity: Exposure to modern developer tools and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, Docker/Kubernetes persistent volumes).
 Certifications: NetApp Certified Storage Associate/Professional (NCSA/NCIE) or Pure Storage certifications highly desired.

jobs.description_html:
Key Account Manager - Miller Electric

Position Overview

At Siemens, we pride ourselves on enabling sustainable progress through technology. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to improve how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We believe that a business thrives when its people thrive, which is why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team is here to support and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

Our technology transforms infrastructure, across buildings, electrification, and grids, at speed and scale, enabling collaborative ecosystems to accelerate our customers’ digital journey to become more competitive, more resilient, and more sustainable.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Account Manager to join our Siemens Smart Infrastructure division, focusing on Power Distribution. This position will play a critical role in advancing our market footprint through a strategic, multi-branch electrical contractor (Miller Electric). The successful candidate will report to the Area Sales Manager and be responsible for driving strategic growth/market share, sales targets, and ensure customer satisfaction.

Key Account Manager - Miller Electric

This position will be remote in Jacksonville metro areas.

Role Description

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Develop and implement strategic account plans to achieve sales targets and market growth. 
  • Build/maintain strong relationships and drive influence with key decision-makers for a national contractor.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the contractor’s national footprint. 
  • Ensure exceptional customer service and satisfaction. 
  • Address and resolve customer issues and concerns promptly. 
  • Conduct regular meetings and quarterly business reviews with the key account to review performance and identify areas for improvement. 
  • Drive sales initiatives and campaigns to achieve revenue targets. 
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities. 
  • Collaborate with the strategic national account team and their target general contractors to develop and execute effective sales strategies. 
  • Work closely with other divisions within Siemens Smart Infrastructure to leverage synergies and drive integrated solutions. 
  • Coordinate with product management, engineering, and operations teams to ensure seamless project execution. 
  • Prepare and present regular sales reports, forecasts, and performance analyses to the Area Sales Manager and Regional Sales Director. 
  • Utilize CRM tools to track and manage customer interactions and sales activities. 
  • Ensure adherence to Siemens’ policies, procedures, and ethical standards. 
  • Promote a culture of integrity and compliance within the team. 

You will win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years’ experience in working in the power distribution market and awareness of its key players. 
  • 5+ years’ experience in sales/account management within the power distribution or related industry.
  • Ability to travel 20-30% of the time, as needed, to support locations outside of the Jacksonville market and participate in trade shows/industry conferences.
  • Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA preferred.
  • 7+ years of demonstrated sales/account management experience. 
  • Proven experience in account management within the power distribution or related industry.

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Tallahassee, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Tallahassee, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


Electrical Installers assist with equipment installation, trial runs, investigative tests, repairs, and overhauls of building automation systems, fire alarm, or security systems. Activities include installation and check-out of electric and electronic components, conduit, wire, and cable while keeping records and documentation. In addition to your primary responsibilities, you will also act as a mentor, providing on-the-job training to less experienced installers, fostering a culture of growth and knowledge-sharing within our team. You will also provide on-site product and service training to the customer. Our Electrical Installers ensure safe, efficient, and reliable electrical systems that underpin Siemens’s operations, safety, and success.


As an Electrical Installer, you will:

  • Install conduit, wire, cable, and devices including panels, sensors, and components for a range of systems, ensuring their proper integration
  • Perform preventive maintenance and routine inspections
  • Perform wiring check-out and assist with system start-up. Disconnect and dismantle electric/electronic instruments, panels, sensor, etc. Troubleshoot wiring issues
  • Coordinate with operations for the timely delivery of materials and supplies to the job site
  • Lead teammates through installation requirements, and coordinate work for the installation team. May be required to assist with electrical installation estimates
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated educational or on-the-job understanding of electrical codes, requirements, and efficient installation methods and practices
  • Demonstrated educational or on-the-job experience installing conduit and running pipe
  • 3+ years' experience installing electrical systems and/or low-voltage control systems 
  • Must be able to:
    • Read and understand design and construction documents
    • Work in a variety of environments in and around mechanical equipment, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high-lift equipment, working in ducts, above ceilings, and in outside/inside/heat/cold/day/night conditions; use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet; carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
    • Differentiate types/colors of wire
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate degree
  • 5+ years' experience installing low-voltage control systems

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Tallahassee FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Tallahassee, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

 Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Systems Specialists participate in the installation, startup, and commissioning of building automation system equipment that has been newly installed and supports the verification of the system database and programming, ensuring consistency with the scope of work and sequence of operations. Our Systems Specialists are the face of Siemens, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customer will help them save energy and money, as well as create a more sustainable future for our environment.

 

As a Systems Specialist, you will:  

  • Commission new distributed digital control systems on construction sites within planned timelines
  • Document commissioning details; communicates deficiencies and progress
  • Act as the Lead Technician and plan work with Team Leader 
  • Network technologies: Perform data back-up from data servers and create automated back-up procedures. Troubleshoot and resolve inconsistencies in the functions or sequence of operations Configures PC workstations and user interfaces. Confirm proper network performance
  • Operational testing, verification, and acceptance: Run routine reports to review system operation Perform final inspection, testing and customer acceptance. Provide customer training on system operations. Complete and submit routine written reports. Provide plans and control system documents to engineering for as-built drawings
  • Project site communication and coordination: Coordinate trade contractors to perform startup services
  • Work Overtime as needed (Compressed schedule performance can be a factor and will require extended hours to meet commitments)
  • Work Rotational On-Call and/or Minimal Overnight Travel
  • Submit accurate time and expense reports
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • 3+ years of experience with Electro-mechanical systems and user PC/software (either in a previous role or through education)
  • Demonstrated on-the-job experience with:
  • Integration of low voltage building sub-systems industry protocols, such as LON, BACnet, N2, Modbus, etc.
  • Reading, understanding, and interpreting design and construction documents 
  • Ability and willingness to work in a variety of circumstances, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in various conditions
  • Must be able to use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet as well as able to carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) 
  • Must be able to work overtime and on-call as needed
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate or Bachelor’s degree in electronics, mechanical engineering, or related

jobs.title: Technical Learning Consultant - NX Ship Design - Remote USA
jobs.description_html:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

As part of a zone or country Enterprise Learning and Adoption team, work with Professional Services and project management to deliver high-quality Learning and Adoption Services and end user training. Contribute to the delivery of Enterprise Learning and Adoption programs in agreed DI domains that enable customers to minimize user adoption risks and to achieve superior adoption of the Digital Enterprise solution.

Deliver standard and custom instructor-led trainings in center, at customer site or as distance learning. Applies aspects of Adult Learning strategies and Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices to address the needs of Customer user communities. In collaboration with the lead Learning Architect, follows the Learning and Adoption work stream of customer programs deploying multiple Siemens DI products within a single domain (for example: DI, STS, DER) to multiple locations.

Actively participates in and contributes to the global "Learning" Community of Practice and contributes to the definition, development and curation of the Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices. Works under self-management on routine assignment/projects and light supervision on new assignment/projects. Works on projects/assignments of basic to moderate scope.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct in person and online NX Ship Design training classes to our customers.
  • Demonstrate critical thinking, command of specific technical subject matter, ability to learn new technologies very quickly, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in the simplest possible terms (relative to the audience)
  • Stimulate interest and enhance learner understanding through appropriate anecdotes, stories, analogies and humor. Use activities that allow learners to review and apply content at appropriate intervals.
  • Apply Adult Learning strategies and Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices to address the needs of customers user communities.
  • Actively participates in and contributes to the global "Learning" Community of Practice and contributes to the definition, development and curation of the Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Willingness to travel up to 50%
  • Bachelor’s Degree is required for this position
  • Required: 5-10 years of experience in design, development and delivery of training, and blended-learning solutions
  • Strong hands-on experience using NX Ship Design, in a Design role, is absolutely required as this person will need to be able to answer many complex question from Ship Designers using NX.
  • Strong preference for recent experience as a Trainer, in addition to the above (But not required)

NOTE: Applicants must not require employer sponsored work Visa authorization, now or in the future for employment in the USA.  Must be able to support US Dept of defense requests


Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

jobs.title: Manager of Governance and Performance Controlling - Operations Finance
jobs.description_html:
Manager of Governance and Performance Controlling, Finance Operations


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


Transform the everyday with us!


Join our Smart Infrastructure (SI) team as Manager of Governance and Performance Controlling, Finance Operations to help us to successfully establish, manage and oversee all activities and process related to controls and reporting. The successful candidate will partner closely with the Operations FIN team, the Performance controlling team, the EP Factories, the Segment Fin teams and other functions while owning and aiming to improve all financial transparency, controls, planning and controlling and measuring the achievement of KPIs and driving improvements / projects.

This position is based in Peachtree Corners, GA. Remote eligibility is generally limited to current Siemens employees or candidates with a proven track record of success in remote work environments.”


As the Manager of Governance and Performance Controlling, Finance Operations, you will:

  • Be part of the Finance Operations leadership team and partner with plant finance teams and well as Operations- and Operations Finance leadership team and Business Unit Performance Controlling
  • Recruit, manage, assess, and develop team members by setting challenging targets and ensure achievement by motivating, encouraging and advising as required.
  • Own and drive all performance controlling activities for EP North America Finance Operations (US, MEX, CAN), including:
    • organize, direct and improve planning- and forecasting processes, including timelines, tools, systematic, etc.
    • own, drive and improve regular performance reviews including scope, timelines, tools, Risk and Opportunities
    • create collaborative structure with operations fin teams to ensure we have required transparency
    • own, drive and improve regular performance reviews including scope, timelines, tools, Risk and Opportunities
  • Own Governance for EP North America Finance Operations (US, MEX, CAN), including:
    • design, implement and monitor internal controls across the plant network to ensure accuracy of books and records and process adherence, identify any gaps or weaknesses and coordinate with internal and external auditors.
    • implement new systems, software and tools and enhance existing ones to ensure optimal support of technical and financial needs, e.g. SAP
    • innovate by standardizing and digitalizing existing processes and identify opportunities to develop new KPI’s or reporting that adds business value.
  • Help define long term strategic targets and drive implementation by breaking them into achievable short-term objectives in a highly dynamic environment.
  • Valuate and ensure alignment of operational and commercial targets. Develop KPI’s to measure such targets and collaborate cross-functionally to take corrective actions as necessary.
  • Support and drive accuracy of master data and value flow in factories aiming at standardization and Sherpa readiness

You will make a strong impact if you have the following qualifications:

  • BS in Accounting, Finance or related field.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in Finance, preferably in an industrial manufacturing environment
  • Experience and in-depth know-how of large and complex manufacturing environments
  • Comprehensive SCM- and manufacturing process understanding (beyond finance)
  • Very strong in-depth knowledge of SAP (FI/CO) and digitalization- / automation tools (Tableau, Snowflake, KNIME, PowerBI, etc.) and AI
  • Strong Networking-, Collaboration- and Stakeholder Management skills
  • Ability to effectively manage deadlines, prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting process, performance controlling, and internal controls.
  • Experience and track record in developing and directing teams as well as to manage and develop individuals
  • Strong impact on results in own area.

Preferred qualifications:

  • CPA or Advanced degree in Finance

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce: 

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. 


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $145,156. - $248,839. annually with a target incentive of 20% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Senior Mulesoft Developer (Technical Lead) - US Remote
jobs.description_html:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and deploy MuleSoft solutions, including APIs, integrations, and connectors like SFDC, SAP, Queue, Database, etc.
  • Design and develop MuleSoft applications using RAML 1.0, API Designer, API Management, and implementation of policies.
  • Strong understanding of DataWeave 2.0 and ability to develop complex logic using DataWave 2.0.
  • Design and develop Munits as part of unit testing.
  • Deployment of applications on on-prem and cloud hub 2.0.
  • Lead the technical design and implementation of integration solutions, ensuring adherence to best practices and scalability.
  • Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, and other developers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Implement MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including API Gateway, Anypoint Studio, and CloudHub.
  • Lead the design and development of API-led connectivity and microservices architecture.
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, and troubleshooting of MuleSoft solutions to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  • Ensure the security, performance, and scalability of the integration solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers and team members.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and solution architecture to promote best practices and maintain high code quality.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal downtime and efficient resolution.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest MuleSoft features, tools, and industry trends to continually improve the integration solutions.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in software development with a focus on MuleSoft and API integrations.
  • Strong experience in an object-oriented programming language.
  • Proficiency in MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including Mule 4, Anypoint Studio, API Manager, and CloudHub.
  • Strong experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Solid understanding of API-led connectivity and microservices architecture.
  • Proficiency in integration patterns, EAI, ESB, and SOA concepts.
  • Experience with data formats such as JSON, XML, and understanding of data transformation tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based technologies, specifically in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Strong knowledge of security standards, such as OAuth, SAML, and API security best practices.
  • Experience with version control tools such as Git, SVN, or similar.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of Jenkins, Maven and Databases is necessary.
  • Strong experience with all types of integration patterns.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline tools (Jenkins, Maven, etc.).
  • Knowledge of database technologies (SQL/NoSQL) and integration with MuleSoft.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and development practices.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Remote Supply Chain Management Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_html:
The Siemens Government Technologies (SGT) Internship Program enables college students to explore stimulating career possibilities in the government contracting environment. As an intern of SGT, you will be given individual and group assignments that are designed to provide you with experience in a corporate environment and develop your business acumen. 

Objective - Work within the Supply Chain Management (SCM) department to assist with, supplier vetting, on-boarding, reporting, and industry research and KPI analysis. In addition, support Subcontract Administrators with procurement file administration to learn regulatory compliance.

Developmental Aspects - The intern will have direct involvement with Federal Acquisition Regulations, evaluation of suppliers, and the execution of the required documentation internally and externally with suppliers. Communication skills will be developed when engaging internal customer as well as the supplier community. The intern will be exposed to and required to perform various tasks that will enhance analytical skills. The intern will participate in team meetings and continuous improvement projects.

Responsibilities:
•Actively engage in vendor outreach activities and develop the appropriate vendor profile information. 
•Participate in the development and maturation of departmental metrics in Power BI
•Participate in departmental continuous improvement projects, including metrics and enhanced use of AI
•Support to Supply Chain team as required during peak business period
•Compliance reviews of procurement folders

Requirements:
•Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher
•Rising junior or above
•Seasoned in using Microsoft suite and products
•Creativity in problem solving and alternative solutions
•Demonstrated ability to collaborate with others on projects and assignments to achieve optimal results
•Ability to quickly learn the SGT business and understand the values proposition to SGT
•Proven ability to present information in both 1 on 1 and large group settings.
•Strong communication skills
•Ability to meet deadlines and schedules

Preferred: 
•AI experience 

Clearance Requirement:
•Candidate must be a United States Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Security Clearance




You’ll Benefit From
The hourly pay range for this position $23.00 - $29.00 per hour, based off of your projected graduation year. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location. Additionally, interns for Siemens are eligible to contribute into our 401K program.
