Ao longo de sua história, a companhia contribuiu ativamente para a construção e para a modernização da infraestrutura brasileira, com um portfólio de soluções inovadoras que capacita seus clientes a acelerarem sua própria transformação digital e a alcançarem maior sustentabilidade. 🚀 Quer fazer parte desse time? 
 Veja nossa oportunidade para Analista de Controladoria de Projetos Pl. Se inscreva e compartilhe 👏 
 Quais serão suas responsabilidades? 
 • Executar análise financeira de projetos, acompanhando custos, orçamentos, viabilidade econômica e fluxo de caixa sob orientação da equipe sênior; • Dominar processos em SAP relacionados a reconhecimento de receita, gestão de custos e planejamento econômico; • Participar de project reviews e apresentar análises técnicas e financeiras de projetos; • Desenvolver conhecimento técnico avançado com suporte da pessoa sênior, atuando como referência técnica em desenvolvimento; • Colaborar com áreas de negócio, fornecendo análises financeiras que suportem decisões sobre projetos; • Identificar oportunidades de otimização de processos e implementar melhorias contínuas; • Garantir conformidade com políticas corporativas e normas aplicáveis de controladoria. 
 Quais requisitos estamos buscando? 
 • Formação superior em Administração, Economia ou Ciências Contábeis; • Experiência mínima de 2 a 3 anos em controladoria de projetos ou gestão financeira; • Conhecimento em SAP; • Experiência com reconhecimento de receita, gestão de custos, planejamento econômico e fluxo de caixa; • Domínio de ferramentas como Excel e Power BI; • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos; • Inglês avançado; • Espanhol será considerado um diferencial; • Experiência prévia em ambientes com projetos complexos será considerada diferencial. 
 Local de trabalho e modelo de contratação: 
 • CLT, modelo híbrido (home office em alguns dias da semana!) • Local de trabalho – Jundiaí/SP 
 Se você se identifica com o que estamos procurando, venha se aplicar! Equipes diversificadas são equipes melhores! Se todos pensarmos da mesma forma, a inovação dificilmente acontece. Por isso, buscamos talentos de diferentes origens, gêneros, idades, raças, orientação sexual e pessoas com deficiência. Na Siemens, as oportunidades são para todos. 
 Informamos que as nossas pessoas recrutadoras não solicitam documentos ou dados pessoais sensíveis via e-mail, WhatsApp ou redes sociais. Todo o processo admissional acontece por meio da plataforma digital "Docteka", um ambiente seguro que protege tanto os dados dos candidatos quanto as informações pertinentes à vaga e à empresa. Além disso, ressaltamos que não realizamos cobrança de taxas de quem participa dos nossos processos seletivos e não exigimos a realização de cursos para preenchimento das vagas. Caso queira fazer parte da nossa empresa, faça a sua inscrição pelos canais oficiais. Venha conosco construir o futuro! Faça parte do nosso time!

jobs.title: Customer Solution Architect, Chemicals, Glass and Energy
jobs.description_html:
Customer Solution Architect, Chemicals, Glass and Energy

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people ﬁrst. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

As a Customer Solution Architect within Sales Acceleration, supporting the Chemicals, Glass and Energy, you will be a key individual contributor reporting to the Manager of Sales Acceleration, Chemicals, Glass and Energy. You will empower vertical sales teams and customers by driving adoption of Siemens' Digital Industries (DI) portfolio, with a focus on automation and digitalization solutions. This role maximizes solution and product sales by applying the Digital Thread methodology and leveraging the Challenger Sales Approach to deliver meaningful customer outcomes, and accelerating their realization. You will translate customer insights into effective, cost-efficient solutions that align with the Siemens Sales Engagement Model, serving as a trusted advisor to vertical sales teams and customers.

This position is remote and can be located anywhere in the continental US.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Solution Development & Architecting: Translate complex customer challenges into clear, actionable requirements and work to deliver innovative automation and digitalization solutions that meet their evolving needs.
  • Driving Sales Engagement: Independently drive and apply a Sales Engagement Model with your assigned accounts to achieve the sales acceleration targets.
  • Trusted Advisory: Serve as a primary technical and strategic advisor to customers and internal sales teams, guiding them through the adoption of Siemens' cutting-edge technologies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster strong collaboration with Sales teams, Marketing & Communication, Product Management in the Zone, and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless value delivery and maximize market opportunities.
  • Market & Customer Identification: Identify key and emerging markets and support the definition and identification of target customers across the Digital Industries Automation portfolio nationwide.
  • Assessing portfolio/productmarket fit for the instrumentation portfolio: Having a strong knowledge on process industries is essential as you will own the process of portfolio fit with strategic customer markets that have a high willingness to buy.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualiﬁcations:

Basic Qualiﬁcations:

  • 8+ years of proven experience in a technical sales, solution consulting, application engineering, or similar individual contributor role within industrial automation or digitalization
  • Strengthening the familiarity with the automation ecosystem 'EPCs and System Integrators'
  • Identify opportunities to co-create reference architectures, standards, preferred vendor positions, and reusable engineering approaches that increase Siemens specification rates.
  • Familiar with key Tier I, II and Tier III Engineering, Procurement & Construction firms.
  • Leverage industry relationships, market knowledge, and professional networks to expand Siemens' visibility and credibility throughout the capital project pursuit ecosystem.
  • Translate Siemens' automation, instrumentation, digitalization, and software portfolio into solutions that help capital projects.
  • Lead technical strategy and value messaging that aligns Siemens capabilities with the unique needs of process industries such as Oil & Gas, LNG, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Power Generation, and Energy Transition projects.
  • Drive cross-business-unit collaboration to present a unified Siemens solution strategy spanning Process Automation, Instrumentation, Digital Industries Software, Industrial Communications, AI, and Digital Twin offerings.
  • Experience working with End Users, primarily in process and energy-oriented industries, such as oil and gas, chemicals, hydrogen, carbon capture, LNG to name a few
  • Technical expertise in Siemens Industrial Automation and Digitalization Portfolio, with a proven track record of applying these technologies to solve complex customer problems
  • Comprehensive knowledge of industrial automation market drivers, trends, and evolving customer needs, particularly in the context of digital transformation
  • Exceptional customer interaction, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a strong customer-centric approach
  • Experience with various project collaboration models and sales processes
  • Excellent verbal, written and time management skills
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically up to 35%, with occasional international travel
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States permanently, without company sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualiﬁcations:

  • 10+ years of experience in process automation, industrial digitalization, ecosystem business development, solution consulting, application engineering, or technical sales.
  • Existing relationships within North American process-industry ecosystem, including EPC’s and system integrators.
  • Experience supporting capital projects during concept, FEED, detailed engineering, procurement, construction, or commissioning phases.
  • Deep familiarity with one or more CGE segments including Oil & Gas, LNG, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Energy Transition, Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Power Generation, or related industries.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and influence technical standards before projects reach the bid stage.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage both C-suite leaders and hands-on engineering teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Strategic Agility: Ability to foresee future trends in industrial automation and digitalization, contributing to competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans, and influencing outcomes without direct authority
  • Business Acumen: Deep understanding of business operations and market dynamics, with knowledge of current and future practices, trends, and information impacting the industrial business landscape
  • Organizational Agility: Knows how to get things done through formal and informal networks. Works effectively in a matrix structure to exploit opportunities. Rallies the team behind the right opportunities and initiatives
  • Exceptional Customer Focus: A dedication to understanding and meeting customer needs, leveraging insights to drive continuous improvement in products, solutions, and services
  • High Degree of Professional Ownership: Demonstrate strong personal accountability and take initiative to drive projects to completion, even in large, complex working groups
  • Proven ability to work autonomously and thrive in a remote, virtual work environment

This role is not about responding to opportunities. It is about creating them. You will help shape how major capital projects are designed, specified, and delivered across North America's leading process industries. Your impact will be measured not only in revenue, but in the long-term market influence and strategic partnerships you create for Siemens.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose, adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us

#LI-VM1


You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $91,463.00 - $188,006.00 annually with a target incentive of 30% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Energy Developer Solutions Intern
jobs.description_html:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

Transform the everyday with us!  

Our Siemens Grid Software team works to accelerate and secure the energy transition. We ensure a reliable, affordable energy supply in a decentralizing, decarbonizing, digitalizing, and all-electrifying energy world. No matter where power comes from or where it must go, we ensure it makes its way – every step of the way. Over 70% of the world's electricity flows through infrastructure planned or analyzed by Siemens Grid Solutions. Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy and what part you can play: Decoding the Future of Energy. 

We are seeking qualified candidates for our Energy Developer Solutions Internship beginning in May or June 2027. This is a fully remote role. 

You'll make an impact by: 
  • Applying transmission and/or distribution power system model topology changes. 
  • Analyzing transmission and/or distribution power systems through steady state, short circuit, or transient stability studies. 
  • Conducting research on the processes and guidelines for load and generation interconnections to the power grid & new challenges for the future of the grid. 
  • Working with experts in the Energy industry who have developed the software, products, and services that electrify the world. 

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications: 
Basic Qualifications: 
  • Pursuing a master’s degree Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related field. 
  • Ability to work remotely full-time (40 hours per week) for the duration of the 12-week program. 
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship. 
  • This internship is a structured experiential learning program for individuals currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program who will continue their studies following the assignment. Current and continuing enrollment is a condition of participation. Applicants who have completed or expect to complete their educational program before or during the assignment period are encouraged to explore our Early Career Development Program opportunities. 
Preferred Qualifications: 
  • Familiar with Python programming languages. 
  • Familiarity with Transmission Power System Simulation Software and Distribution Power System Simulation Software. 
  • Working knowledge of applications of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace. 
  • Experience using collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams, Slack, or Discord. 
  • Ability to work effectively with multinational and diverse groups and demonstrate leadership skills.
  • Self-starter with good time management skills and the capacity to effectively prioritize a variety of concurrent activities. 
  • Comfortable working as part of a fully remote team, with the initiative and self-direction to work independently and collaborate effectively.
As part of the application, you will be asked to confirm your enrollment status. If your application includes uploaded documents (resume, transcript, or other materials), you may redact any information identifying your age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. Redacting this information will not affect your candidacy.  

About Siemens: 
We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here. 

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce: 
We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. 

#GSWI #URDP #SWE26

You’ll Benefit From
The hourly pay range for this position is $35 per hour for first time Interns or $35 per hour for returning Interns. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location. Additionally, interns for Siemens are eligible to contribute into our 401K program.

jobs.title: Traveling Building Automation Systems Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Southeastern region which serves customers throughout the territory. Ideal candidate will reside anywhere within the Southeast region. 

*75% travel expected in this role*

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?   

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives. 

Transform the everyday with us!

 

The Building Automation Systems Specialist handles the centralized control of a building's heating, ventilation, air conditioning, lighting, and other systems through a building management system or building automation system (BAS).The objectives of building automation are improved occupant comfort, efficient operation of building systems, reduction in energy consumption and operating costs, and improved life cycle of utilities. 


As a Building Automation Systems Specialist, you will: 

  • Assist with building automation system startup, ensuring that all systems and components are designed, installed, tested, operated, and maintained according to the operational requirements of the customer. 
  • Work well with others, take ownership, be a team player, and act with integrity. This position reports to the local Supervisor and takes direction from a mentor and Lead Technician. 
  • Assist with commissioning new Distributed Digital Control System on construction sites. Commissioning is ensuring all systems and components are functioning as required.
  • Document commissioning details; communicate deficiencies and progress.
  • Plan work with mentor, Lead Technician, and Team Leader.
  • Complete commissioning within planned timelines.
  • Submit accurate time-keeping daily and expenses weekly.
  • Work overtime when needed.
  • Able to accommodate in an out of state overnight travel

 

You will make in impact with these qualifications: 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Electro-mechanical experience (wither from a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skills
  • Must be able to demonstrate the ability to read and understand design and construction documents
  • Must be willing and able to work in a variety of circumstances, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in outside/inside/heat/cold/day/night conditions
  • Must be able to demonstrate the ability and willingness to differentiate types/colors of wire, use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet and the ability to carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must be willing and able to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook)
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field
  • 1+ years of experience with Building Automation and HVAC systems

     

Ready to create your own journey? Join us today!

 

About Siemens

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. 

 

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. #LI-BS1 #Southeast-EREF #VeteranCareers #TransitioningServiceMember #MilitarySpouse Hvac controls, building controls, building automation, programming, field technician, heating, ventilation, air conditioning, direct digital control, apogee, desigo, modbus, tridium, controls, commissioning, lonworks, bacnet, ddc, bau, bms, building management, mechanical systems, system integration


You’ll Benefit From

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

The pay range for this position is $49,195 - $84,334 annually. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Application Solutions, Semiconductor Process and Device Simulations (TCAD)
jobs.description_html:
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software.
Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively.


Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

Application Solutions, Semiconductor Process and Device Simulations


Join the Calibre™ R&D Team at Siemens EDA

We are seeking a highly motivated researcher and application engineer, preferably with expertise in semiconductor fabrication process (integration flow and key modules as sputter etch, chemical etch, CMP, deposition, Epitaxy, ion implantation, annealing, etc.), semiconductor metrology (optical or eBeam based), semiconductor devices physics, Design-Technology Co-optimization (DTCO).


About Us

The Calibre™ family of tools is the industry leader in EDA/CAD solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, enabling simulations and diagnostics from the transistor to the package level. As the semiconductor industry continues its rapid growth, there is a critical demand for high-fidelity modeling and high-throughput numerical simulations to support the production of stable, high-volume chips at advanced technology nodes.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate with industry leaders to develop groundbreaking tools that accelerate semiconductor manufacturing and device performance study at the most advanced technologies (logic 2/1.4/1.0/0.7nm and beyond, 3D NAND, 6/4F2/3D DRAM, CIS, and 3DIC packaging). Our solutions will deliver significant performance gains over conventional approaches, essential for supporting high-volume manufacturing and the agile turnaround times our customers demand.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess the following education and experience in one or more of following areas:

Education & Background

• PhD (or MS + 5+ years of research/industry experience) in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or Other Engineering (Material Science, Mechanical, etc.), with expertise in:

o Physics-based Modeling Experience: has good intuitive to build physics-based models to solve real-world problems, capable to derive simplified models for complex systems.

o Semiconductor Fabrication Process: unit process modules such as plasma-based dry etch, wet etch/cleaning, CVD, PVD, ALD, CMP, Epitaxy, Ion Implantation, Annealing, etc. Integration flow for advanced logic transistors (FinFET, NSFET, CFET), DRAM (COB, vertical PassGates, 3D), 3D NAND and 3DIC (TSV, RDL), CIS, LED, etc.

o Semiconductor Device and Multi-Physics: semiconductor band-structure and carrier transport, reliability issues (BTI, TDDB, SHE, EM/IR drop), etc.

o Semiconductor Metrology: Optical (scatterometry, ellipsometry), eBeam (SEM) based.

Key Skills & Attributes

• Strong problem-solving skills with a passion for tackling complex application challenges.
• Ability to estimate application task complexity, timeline and deliver on schedule.
• Open and collaborative team mindset. Good communication skills.

Locations

Preferred US national or hybrid mode



The salary range for this position is 135,800 to 217,300 and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link:https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/

Working at Siemens Software Why us?
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

#LI-CM1 
#LI-EDA
#LI-Hybrid

About Smart Infrastructure – Electrification and Automation:

The EA Business Unit in Wendell, North Carolina, which is its U.S. headquarters, focuses on photovoltaic inverters, medium-voltage power distribution equipment including packaging and services, and solutions, including automation.

We are looking for a Sr Proposal Engineer. This Hybrid position will be based in Wendell, NC. Relocation assistance is available. This position could be fully remote for an experienced MV Switchgear Proposal Engineer.

We are seeking a Sr. Proposal Engineer to lead technical excellence, engineering strategy, and continuous improvement across our Solutions organization. In this high-impact role, you'll work closely with Siemens Sales to prepare offers supporting customers in the industrial, construction and utility markets on technical, contractual, and commercial issues.

This role may be converted to a remote position based on experience and qualifications, with occasional travel to Wendell for trainings, workshops, and key meetings

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Translating customer requirements and specifications into innovative, cost-effective power distribution solutions.
  • Leading the development of complex proposals, including scope definition, equipment selection, and technical configurations.
  • Creating conceptual layouts and engineering deliverables that clearly communicate proposed solutions.
  • Partnering with engineering, procurement, and product teams to evaluate technical options and optimize solution design.
  • Developing project estimates, cost models, and customer-facing proposal packages for large-scale opportunities.
  • Supporting customer discussions and serving as a trusted technical advisor to sales and business development teams.
  • Driving engineering excellence through continuous improvement, technical mentorship, and successful project handoff to execution teams.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.
  • 7+ years of application engineering experience supporting engineered-to-order solutions and customer proposals.
  • 3+ years of quotation, estimating, or front-end engineering experience.
  • Experience analyzing customer specifications, single-line diagrams, and technical requirements to develop optimized solutions.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to balance technical, commercial, and profitability objectives.
  • Ability to identify market trends and collaborate cross-functionally to drive product and process improvements.
  • Ability to travel up to 10-15%.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing engineering teams.
  • Background in power distribution, medium-voltage switchgear, transformers, or related electrical infrastructure products.
  • Knowledge of ANSI, IEEE, UL, and NEMA standards.
  • Experience reviewing single-line diagrams, schematics, protection and control systems, and communication network drawings.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and decision-making skills.
  • Experience within manufacturing, EPC, utility, industrial, or consulting engineering environments.

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. jobs.title: Building Automation Systems Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Winter Park, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Orlando, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Systems Specialists participate in the installation, startup, and commissioning of building automation system equipment that has been newly installed and supports the verification of the system database and programming, ensuring consistency with the scope of work and sequence of operations. Our Systems Specialists are the face of Siemens, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customer will help them save energy and money, as well as create a more sustainable future for our environment.

As a Systems Specialist, you will:  

  • Commission new distributed digital control systems on construction sites within planned timelines. Documents commissioning details; communicates deficiencies and progress
  • Plan work with Lead Technician, and Team Leader
  • Network technologies: Assists with data back-up from data servers and the creation of automated back-up procedures. Supports troubleshooting and resolution of inconsistencies in the functions or sequence of operations. Assists with the set-up and configuration of PC workstations and user interfaces
  • Support the confirmation of proper network performance
  • Operational testing, verification, and acceptance: Runs routine reports to review system operation. Participates in final inspection and testing. Supports customer acceptance. Assists with customer training on system operations
  • Complete and submit routine written reports. Provides plans and control system documents to engineering for as-built drawings
  • Project site communication and coordination: May support others in the scheduling of trade contractors to coordinate startup services. Submits accurate time and expense reports
  • Work overtime when needed (Compressed schedule performance can be a factor and will require extended hours to meet commitments)
  • Work rotational on-call and/or minimal overnight travel
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures. Ability to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • 1+ years of experience installing and servicing electronic control or HVAC equipment 
  • Electro-mechanical experience (either in a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skill 
  • On-the-job experience reading, understanding, and interpreting design and construction documents 
  • Ability and willingness to work in a variety of circumstances including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in various conditions
  • Must be able and willing to use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet as well as carrying and moving equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) 
  • Ability and willingness to work overtime as needed
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate or Bachelor’s degree in electronics, mechanical engineering, or related

jobs.title: Remote Construction Program Manager, Manufacturing Sector
jobs.description_html:
Siemens Government Technologies (SGT) is a dynamic and rapidly growing organization, and we are seeking a self-driven individual to complement our growing team.  

As a Siemens Advanced Manufacturing Sector Program Manager, you will lead and manage a cross functional program delivery team to scope, design, procure, install and commission an advanced, digitally integrated manufacturing capability.  You will establish and communicate clear program priorities and program activities.  This role is the primary point of contact to align the customer, stakeholders, and the multiple Siemens business unit delivery teams.  
    
As part of the Advanced Manufacturing team, you will lead, guide and work with Facility (SGT) , Digital Software (DI-SW), and Automation (DI AUT) Project Managers, integrating their team’s efforts to achieve a One Siemens result for the Customer.  

Responsibilities:
•Manage the Anniston Advanced Manufacturing program through the Project life cycle, leveraging PM Siemens project management framework and the Siemens Delivery Framework  
•Lead Program wide governance approach.  Coordinate with scope specific Project Managers to execute project governance.  
•Manage customer requirements and program scope to achieve program objectives, effectively coordinating project expectations with customers and stakeholders in a timely and concise fashion.    
•Manage and combine individual subproject schedules into an integrated Master schedule, coordinating interdependencies between sub-projects to ensure on time delivery.   
•Manage cross functional, multi-team configuration and deployment activities including software, industrial equipment manufacturers and Facilities experts.  These team members will be coordinated to complete the design, procurement, installation, configuration, validation, and acceptance of the facility improvements and planned Manufacturing Capabilities.
•Work with third-party contractors to ensure overall program execution and success including site safety planning, material ordering coordination, and solution/system validation. 
•Provide program management activities to control scope, cost, schedule, and quality across all sub elements.   
•Define and execute required processes in alignment with stakeholders including appropriate communication to all levels. Lead Internal Steerco communication development and presentation with responsibility for results.
•Perform program quality management, ensuring that the solution meets contractual requirements and is to the appropriate quality and management compliance for industry or customer protocols, regulations, and standards.   
•Perform program reviews and retrospectives regularly and present the results and lessons learned to the program and organization.
•Ensure the projects in the program are meeting the approved budget and agreed margin and are reviewed on a regular basis.   
•Conduct Stakeholder meetings to manage and guide stakeholders through scope clarification, design review and installation activities
•Set the standard and maintain project artifacts such as status, risk, issues, opportunities (RIO), schedule or IMS, decision log, program management plan, safety plan, FMEA, CAP, or other artifacts as needed to support project rigor as required by customer, PM@ Siemens, or industry standards.
•Perform project risk management including planning, identification, analysis, mitigation planning and controlling to include FMEA and CAP as required.   
•Confidence creating and presenting content to all levels of management, both internal and external.  
•Coordinate difficult scope, cost, resource conversations with customers.  
•Lead successful project closeout and successful user-acceptance and adoption of deployed project capability; or participated in customer witness tests or similar events, industrial equipment validation and start up procedures.  Coordinate integration of all Systems 
•Manage contract acceptance and handover of projects to the customer. Develop proactive closeout procedures to avoid extended on site durations.
•In conjunction with Engagement Management, identify, and create new opportunities and renewals for current projects/programs.   
•Mentor and support the development of team members.   
•Perform duties in compliance with SGT Project Management Standards.
   
Required Qualifications:  
•Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university/college in Engineering, Technology, or equivalent years of experience (8+) in technical fields of work.
•Eight to ten years in a project manager/leadership role, guiding a cross-functional team of project managers and consultants during significant facility or industrial equipment implementation.
•Eight to ten years of experience working in a US Federal Government customer-facing environment with a focus on USACE/NAVFAC Construction processes. Including US Federal Government projects, contracts, policies, procedures and quality and safety programs.  
•Knowledge of Change Management processes.    
•Product Scheduling experience with Critical path method schedules using MS Projects, Primavera or similar software.
•Demonstrated experience operating within an industrial setting such as a plant, shop, building infrastructure, shipboard, or other industrial setting.
•Proactive self-starter who can build a team to meet project delivery requirements, performing independently in high-pressure situations with little supervision.
•Leadership skills and proven track record of leading multi-disciplinary teams, including services 
•Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.  

Preferred Qualifications:  
•Experience working with third party contractors. 
•PMP Certification, with working knowledge of project management processes and tools is highly preferred.    
•Experience building effective project teams from separate organizations, establishing program governance, organizational effectiveness and program data interchange.  
•Use of Program/Project management software a plus.
•Experience implementing industrial equipment such as CNC machine tools, conveyers, PLCs, plant automation, manufacturing centers, SCADA, cabling, electrical, or other industrial infrastructure.
•Experience connecting cloud infrastructure with on-premise IT/OT networks
•Proven experience working with distributed, remote teams across multiple disciplines and time zones.
•Ability to promote complex solutions and drive acceptance with confidence.  
•Working knowledge of using AI tools to support project management execution.
 
Travel:
•Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% 
  
Security Clearance:  
•Candidate must be US citizen and have the ability to obtain and maintain a US federal agency security clearance.





You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $133,500.00 - $200,300.00 annually with a target incentive of 10% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.description_html:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

Transform the everyday with us!   

The Siemens PTI Energy Business Advisory (EBA) unit is an experienced technology and management consultancy partner in the energy sector. In this role, EBA creates value for our customers by providing Strategic Planning, Valuation to support Mergers and Acquisitions, Risk Management, and Market Intelligence backed by experience, technical knowledge, and industry-leading tools.   

We are seeking qualified candidates to join our Energy Market Analyst Internship beginning in May or June 2027. This is a fully remote role.  

You’ll make an impact by: 
  • Supporting consulting engagements, business process improvements, solutions to technical issues, and data management and visualization. 
  • Focusing on the interpretation and application of power and gas data to determine relevant issues and inform strategic consultant engagements. 
  • Delivering research, data acquisition, and analysis of energy and power markets to create reports, models, and statistical insights that support decision-making and stakeholder communications. 
  • Presenting findings through briefings, charts, and presentations while safeguarding confidentiality, adapting to shifting priorities, and leveraging programming and analytics skills (MATLAB, SQL, Python).  

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications: 
Basic Qualifications 
  • Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or related field and approaching completion of the required educational credentials for this opportunity. 
  • Ability to work remotely full-time (40 hours per week) for the duration of the 12-week program. 
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship. 
  • This internship is a structured experiential learning program for individuals currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program who will continue their studies following the assignment. Current and continuing enrollment is a condition of participation. Applicants who have completed or expect to complete their educational program before or during the assignment period are encouraged to explore our Early Career Development Program opportunities. 
Preferred Qualifications 
  • Familiar with MATLAB, C/C++, Java, Python or SQL programming languages. 
  • Working knowledge of applications of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace. 
  • Experience using collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams, Slack, or Discord. 
  • Ability to work effectively with multinational and diverse groups and demonstrate leadership skills. 
  • Self-starter with good time management skills and the capacity to effectively prioritize a variety of concurrent activities. 
  • Comfortable working as part of a fully remote team, with the initiative and self-direction to work independently and collaborate effectively.  
As part of the application, you will be asked to confirm your enrollment status. If your application includes uploaded documents (resume, transcript, or other materials), you may redact any information identifying your age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. Redacting this information will not affect your candidacy.

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role is remote.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives. 

Transform the everyday with us!


Sr. Fire Alarm Systems Design Leads create unique design solutions to meet specific customer requirements for commercial building fire alarm systems. This candidate will focus on data centers. This team member makes recommendations for productivity improvements and cost reductions to increase customer satisfaction and job profitability.


As a Fire Alarm Systems Design Engineer, you will:

  • Choose the appropriate mix of products and installation methods to provide the most cost-effective solution. 
  • Prepare submittals and schedules; handle the ordering of products and equipment. 
  • Participate in sales-to-operations turnover meetings to evaluate accuracy of the sales estimate and job layout. 
  • Design fire alarm systems for buildings, including floorplan drawings for system device locations, riser diagrams, device wiring details, panel mounting and wiring details, bills of materials, and sequences of operations to meet the intent of the project plans, specifications, and contract documents. 
  • Provide general electrical calculations, including battery calculations, voltage drop calculations, conduit fills, power supply sizing, etc. and prepare engineering re-estimates and follow up with appropriate sales and management to ensure understanding of and satisfaction with job scope. 
  • Follow up with sales and management to ensure job scope, specifications, and schematics will meet customer needs and provide start-up and checkout documentation to the Project Manager for use in commissioning and validation. 
  • Perform quality assurance; peer-review engineering documents and mentor, train, and direct the design activities of the engineering team. 


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED
  • 5+ years of experience engineering fire alarm systems
  • Must be able to demonstrate:
    • Knowledge of engineering fundamentals of fire systems or equivalent field experience with fire system controls 
    • Knowledge of the following fire alarm system components: fire alarm panels, strobe booster panels, spot detectors (smoke, heat, carbon monoxide), duct-mounted smoke detectors, projected beam smoke detectors, aspirating smoke detectors (VESDA), monitor modules, relay modules (form A and form C), manual pull stations, notification devices (speaker/strobes, horn/strobes, strobes, bells), Class A/Class B/Class X circuits, state and local fire codes, and NFPA 72 national fire code 
    • The ability to read and interpret electrical circuit diagrams
    • Knowledge of fire alarm system components
  • NICET II- Fire Alarm Systems certification and ability and willingness to obtain NICET III within 1 years
  • 5+ years of proficiency in AutoCAD and design; proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate or Bachelor’s Degree
  • Highly detailed oriented
  • Data Center design experience
  • VESDA Fire Alarm Systems experience
  • EIT, ASHRE, NICET III or IV - Fire Alarm Systems, or CISSP certifications

As a Building Automation Solutions Operations Supervisor, you will:

  • Schedule and assign installation and commissioning tasks to the team and ensure schedules are maintained and projects proceed according to plans, job specifications, and cost estimates
  • Maintain and improve planned and booked margins for technical support programs
  • Direct and supervise the development and use of project plans in monitoring and controlling the execution of work and review customer feedback and ensure customer retention and account growth goals such as adds, extras, upgrades, and escalations are achieved
  • Maintain the relationships between sales, engineering, and executions teams so changes and discrepancies can be managed to minimize cost and delay throughout the estimating and execution phases of projects and accountable for the profit and loss of projects assigned to the operations team and serve as a local a Leader and customer representative for the operations team 
  • Support project profitability through cost-containment procedures and processes and travel between branch locations as needed
  • Maintain excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:   

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED 
  • On-the-job experience with:
  • Knowledgeable in Desigo CC or Insight or Niagara
  • HVAC System Automation/Building Automation Controls including knowledge of design, startup, programming, integration, documentation, and commissioning
  • Training, mentoring, scheduling, and supervising employees responsible for System Automation/Building Automation startup
  • Experience with Microsoft Office
  • Ability and willingness to travel 10%
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:   

  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • 3+ years of experience in training, mentoring, scheduling, and supervising employees responsible for System Automation/Building Automation startup
  • 5+ years’ experience in engineering or project management

The Senior Project Manager position requires the coordination and delivery of multiple, simultaneous projects considered small to medium in complexity with financial impact between $250K and $6M. The Senior Project Manager has fiscal responsibility for all project facets, including project billing, job cost reporting, and overall customer satisfaction.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will:

  • Facilitate the execution of project/program solution plan for clearly defined sub-projects or sub-programs.
  • Be responsible for delivery of results for the respective process steps. 
  • Guide technical or administrative staff.
  • Act as a functional process resource on projects or programs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement plan. 
  • Perform active role in maintaining functionally focused client relationships.
  • Be responsible for several projects of varying size. 
  • Obtain PM@Siemens certification for C Projects ($2.5M).
  • Review project specifications, drawings and project-specific documents to establish project intent.
  • Develop and maintain a project schedule and coordinates needs with the project team. Identify time-sensitive installation needs.
  • Manage the requisition of supplies and materials to complete projects. 
  • Review plans and specifications and participate in project cost reviews.
  • Assist Operations Manager in the solicitation and contracting of subcontractors.
  • Conduct an orientation for project technicians and provide project documentation, including scope of work, drawings, applicable specifications, application-engineered drawings, project contacts, etc. 
  • Track resources and project progress. 
  • Document project events that impact the schedule, scope of work, and project efficiency.
  • Pursue project-specific change-order opportunities. 
  • Coordinate and pursue project-specific billing; coordinate with Accounting team and Operations Manager. 
  • Schedule project-specific commissioning resources and provide commissioning documentation. 
  • Expedite the return of project-specific mark-ups for as-built development. 
  • Complete project-specific close-out documentation.
  • Effectively manage and coordinate subcontractors to meet scope, scheduling, and financial requirements.
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures; report unsafe conditions and actions.

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Technical experience in the commercial fire and life safety industry
  • 3+ years of experience managing projects
  • Knowledgeable of local and national (NFPA) fire alarm codes and regulations
  • Must be able to demonstrate ability to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project 
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate or Bachelor of Mechanical or Electrical Engineering degree 
  • 5 + years of technical experience in the fire and life safety industry 
  • NICET Level II or higher certification in Fire Alarm Systems preferred

jobs.title: AI Factory Controls & Automation Architect
jobs.description_html:
Position Overview 

 

The AI Factory Controls & Automation Architect serves as the global technical authority for controls, automation, and operational technology (OT) within Siemens' AI Factory Architecture organization. This highly visible role will define and drive globally scalable reference architectures spanning Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), SCADA, PLC-based automation, OT networks, telemetry, and digital platforms that support the next generation of AI and mission-critical infrastructure. 

 

With a global mandate across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, this role will partner with engineering, digitalization, sales, and customer teams to create repeatable frameworks that connect power, cooling, automation, digital twins, and AI-enabled operations. The successful candidate will help shape how hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, sovereign AI, and high-density GPU environments are designed, integrated, monitored, and operated worldwide. 

 

This is not a traditional controls engineering or controls programming role. We are seeking a systems thinking architect who can translate complex engineering requirements into scalable global standards, support strategic customer engagements, and drive the integration of power, cooling, automation, and digital systems into a unified architecture that accelerates the deployment of next-generation AI infrastructure. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Own and define the controls and automation strategy within Siemens global AI Factory architecture framework. 
  • Develop scalable reference architectures, design standards, and integration frameworks for hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and AI-focused data center environments. 
  • Establish controls strategies, communication standards, resiliency requirements, and data integration frameworks across automation and digital platforms. 
  • Partner with electrical, cooling, and digital architecture leaders to integrate power, thermal, controls, and operational technologies. 
  • Define standards for telemetry, metadata, equipment tagging, and operational data supporting digital twins, analytics, and AI-enabled operations. 
  • Ensure reference architectures balance global standardization with regional requirements across North America, EMEA, and APAC. 
  • Support strategic customer engagements, architecture workshops, RFIs/RFPs, and complex pursuits involving hyperscalers and major data center customers. 
  • Develop technical guidance, training, and reusable content for regional solutions architects and sales teams. 
  • Evaluate Siemens and third-party technologies and define interoperable architectures that support customer and business objectives. 
  • Represent Siemens as a technical thought leader with customers, partners, and industry organizations. 
 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. 
  • 10+ years of experience in data centers, mission-critical infrastructure, controls, automation, or OT environments. 
  • Experience designing, integrating, or architecting BMS, EPMS, SCADA, PLC, or industrial automation systems. 
  • Strong understanding of mission-critical power, cooling, and facility infrastructure. 
  • Experience developing technical standards, reference architectures, or automation frameworks. 
  • Knowledge of industrial networking, systems integration, and OT cybersecurity principles. 
  • Experience leveraging AI, LLMs, APIs, scripting, and automation tools to improve engineering and operational outcomes. 
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders. 
 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience with hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, or AI/GPU data center environments. 
  • Experience with digital twins, digital thread, operational analytics, or cloud-to-edge integration. 
  • Experience applying AI-enabled analytics, predictive operations, or automated root-cause analysis. 
  • Familiarity with NEC, NFPA, UL, ASHRAE, IEC, IEC 62443, and related industry standards. 
  • Experience integrating controls systems across power, cooling, energy storage, or liquid cooling technologies. 
  • Experience working with hyperscalers, data center developers, engineering firms, OEMs, or system integrators. 

About Siemens: 

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. 

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce: 

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

jobs.title: Legal Intern
jobs.description_html:
The Siemens Government Technologies Internship Program enables college students to explore stimulating career possibilities in the government contracting environment.  As an intern of Siemens Government Technologies, you will be given individual and group assignments that are designed to provide you with experience in a corporate environment and develop your business acumen.  

SGT’s Legal and Contracts team is looking for a Legal Intern, that will focus on improving the day-to-day processes within a business function by performing research on complex legal issues and assisting on a wide array of business transactions, with the ultimate goal of better serving the department’s internal clients.  The candidate can expect a mixture of on-the-job and real-world exposure of not only the legal and contracts support functions, but other cross-functional business operations during the internship period.  Successful candidates will demonstrate our leadership principles: a bias for action; partner-centricity; flexibility; analytical ability; the drive to own, build, and grow; along with the ability to have a little bit of fun.  Just as importantly, the candidate will have an ongoing opportunity to engage with legal and contracts professionals and have meaningful conversations that can influence future career decisions.

Responsibilities:
•Monitor changes to procurement laws and related regulations and assist in development and submission of internal client-facing updates on changes or policy issues relevant to the company.
•Perform general legal research on procurement regulations, corporate governance topics, case law, and contract-related legal issues; prepare concise internal memoranda summarizing findings.
•Participate in internal process improvement initiatives, including development of templates, checklists, playbooks, and SOPs for recurring contract and compliance activities.
•Conduct preliminary contract reviews for a variety of agreements, including customer subcontracts, vendor contracts, NDAs, MOUs, and teaming agreements, identifying key terms, risks, and compliance obligations.
•Assist in contract negotiation preparation by developing issues lists, reviewing counterpart redlines, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to gather positions and risk assessments.
•Support Legal and Contracts teams in drafting, revising, and formatting contract provisions, ensuring accuracy and alignment with company policies and applicable regulations.
•Support the Legal and Contracts teams in responding to internal inquiries by researching relevant statutes, regulations, or precedents and preparing draft guidance.
•Support maintenance of corporate governance and administration for relevant legal entities.
•Maintain legal archive documents and advise and assist on organizational document information and management practices.

The expertise the candidate will develop in the role:
•Ability to break down and understand complex legal and regulatory problems.
•Understand the process of memorializing contractual deals where the U.S. Government is the ultimate customer.
•Deeper understanding of contract lifecycle management, including initial review, negotiation strategy, drafting, and execution.
•Learning how to work and communicate within a large, multinational company with several affiliate entities.
•Organizing the elements of closing both simple and complex transactions
•Counseling internal clients on potential risks and opportunities associated with certain business decisions.
•Enhanced legal research skills applied to real-time business needs, including procurement law, government contracting requirements, and general corporate legal topics.
•Enhanced communication and advocacy skills 

Requirements:
•Cumulative GPA of 3.3 or higher preferred 
•Currently enrolled in an ABA approved law school
•Ability to deal with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
•Good organizational skills, including time management and extreme attention to detail.
•Propensity to be self-guided (manager will be largely remote from Crystal City Corporate office)
•Demonstrated ability to collaborate with others on projects and assignments to achieve optimal results.
•Proficient with Microsoft Office Programs. 
•Creativity in problem solving and alternative solutions.
•Proven ability to present information in both 1 on 1 and large group settings.
•Ability to meet deadlines and schedules.

Preferred:
•Prefer a rising 3L student

Location:
•Remote (if candidate is not within commuting distance of Crystal City HQs)
•Hybrid (if candidate is in DC area)
•Tentative start date mid-May 2027 and end date August 2027

Clearance Requirement:
•Candidate must be a United States Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Security Clearance









You’ll Benefit From
The hourly pay range for this position $27.00 - $35.00 per hour, based off of your projected graduation year. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location. Additionally, interns for Siemens are eligible to contribute into our 401K program.

jobs.title: Building Automation Systems Specialist Internship
jobs.description_html:
Building Automation Systems Specialist Internship

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

Transform the everyday with us! 

Are you looking for an internship where you can showcase your technical aptitude and passion for problem solving to ensure customers can work in a comfortable, safe, and energy-efficient environment? Does gaining hands-on experience, real-world skills and valuable knowledge while developing yourself professionally sound exciting to you?

Then look to the Siemens Smart Building Internship Program!

We are looking for Smart Building Systems Specialist Interns. The positions will be based out of our Miami, FL area location.

Internship Program Start Dates: May 17th, May 24th, June 7th, and June 14th

You’ll make an impact by: 

  • 80% Field Technician Experience: Spend most of your time on job sites with experienced Siemens technicians, learning how we install, program, and service advanced HVAC automation, systems in commercial buildings. You'll take part in on-the-job training, job shadowing, troubleshooting, and classroom instruction.
  • 10% Sales Exposure: Learn how Siemens brings smart building solutions to life by spending time with our sales team. Gain insight into how we engage with customers and design solutions that improve building performance and safety.
  • 10% Project & Service Operations: Rotate through our service and project delivery teams to understand how customer needs are supported from installation to long-term maintenance and upgrades.
  • Work alongside experienced technicians to visit customer sites and troubleshoot HVAC, Building Automation, and electronic control systems. Assist in diagnosing issues, performing maintenance and repairs, or supporting new installations and system commissioning.
  • Collaborate with our engineering and project management teams to resolve any discrepancies in system drawings or address challenges encountered on the job.
  • Interface directly with customers: document service activities, help explain system operations, and provide basic training to ensure smooth hand-off. Youll also have opportunities to recommend upgrades or system enhancements that improve performance and add long-term value for the customer.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:  

  • Must have a high school diploma or state-recognized GED
  • Education: Students currently enrolled in or who have recently completed a 2-year Technical College/School pursuing a degree in HVAC Controls, Building Automation, Mechanical Engineering / Technology, Electrical Engineering / Technology, Energy/Sustainability and Built Environment or related program.
  • Availability: Ability to work 40-hours per week for the 10-week program (May-July or June - August)
  • Relocation: Must be willing and able to work onsite at the location and surrounding local area. There is no relocation or housing stipend for this program.
  • Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company or school sponsorship. This program does not support students on a Visa such as F1, J1, M1 and H1B as well as OPT/CPT.
  • Comfortable working in dynamic environments; including rooftops, mechanical rooms, crawl spaces, and behind ceilings, whether it’s hot, cold, indoors, or outdoors.
  • Hands-on role that requires the use of hand tools, laptops, tablets, smartphones, and other tech to review program and troubleshoot building systems.
  • Physically capable of safely lifting and transporting tools and equipment up to 75 pounds without assistance.
  • Team player who enjoys collaborating with coworkers and customers to deliver smart, safe, energy-efficient building solutions.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and experienced working on Windows-based laptops; quick to learn new software platforms for automation and control systems.
  • Strong communication skills able to clearly document your work and communicate technical issues and solutions with customers and team members.
  • As part of the application, you will be asked to confirm your enrollment status. If your application includes uploaded documents (resume, transcript, or other materials), you may redact any information identifying your age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. Redacting this information will not affect your candidacy.

You’ll benefit from:

The hourly pay range for this position is $22.00 per hour for first time Interns or $24 per hour for returning Interns. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location. Additionally, interns for Siemens are eligible to contribute into our 401K program.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs 

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. Learn more about our commitment to DEI [3] here.
Protecting the environment, conserving our natural resources, fostering the health and performance of our people as well as safeguarding their working conditions are core to our social and business commitment at Siemens. They are an integral part of our Business Conduct Guidelines and our corporate strategy.

jobs.title: Smart Buildings Technical Sales Intern
jobs.description_html:
Smart Buildings Technical Sales Internship 

Location:  Jacksonville, FL

Undergraduate: Rising Junior 

Duration: 10 weeks
Start Dates: May 17, May 24, June 7, or June 14, 2027
Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week


Smart Buildings Sales Internship 

 

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

Who designs your future?  You do. 

Are you looking for an internship where you can showcase your technical aptitude and passion for problem solving to ensure customers can work in a comfortable, safe, and energy-efficient environment? Does gaining hands-on experience, real-world skills and valuable knowledge while developing yourself professionally sound exciting to you? 

Join our Siemens Smart Buildings Internship Program as a Smart Buildings Sales Intern in Summer 2027! 

How long is the Smart Buildings Sales Internship and when can I start?

This internship is a 10-week program where you will rotate through various departments at your local branch office, focusing all on smart buildings and sustainable infrastructure.  Internship Program Start Dates: May 17, May 24, June 7 and June 14, 2027.

This is a hybrid sales internship supporting Building Automation, Fire & Life Safety and Security businesses, for both Solutions and Service Sales.

What is Building Automation?

Siemens Building Automation Systems is a building management system (BMS) that automatically manages and controls all systems within a building. These systems include lighting, heating, cooling, ventilation, fire detection and notification, CCTV, door and window controls, water and waste management. It consists of sensors, controllers, software and communication devices. Siemens offers building automation systems for all building types and sizes, and for every use. The system is designed to manage a wide range of building systems, such as HVAC, lighting, security, fire safety, and other critical building functions.

Click HERE to learn more about Siemens’ Building Automation and Control Systems.

What is the difference between Solutions & Service Sales?

The Solutions Sales Team is committed to supporting our new construction customers and will achieve booking and profit goals by developing and implementing plans to grow, develop, and manage contractor, consultant, developer, and end-user relationships; capitalize on sales opportunities within the territory; and effectively execute sophisticated deals independently within our established guidelines.

The Service Sales Team is committed to supporting our Service Agreements business for commercial building automation controls, fire/life safety and security systems. The Service Sales Team supports our Operations Team whose focus is to perform service and maintenance in large commercial buildings such as hospitals, universities, and industrial facilities.

What will I do as a Smart Buildings Sales Intern?

  • Work alongside Sales Managers and Sales Executives within the local branch office.
  • Assist the sales team with lead generation, prospecting, and account outreach.
  • Support the preparation of sales presentations, proposals, and reports.
  • Help manage CRM data by tracking leads and maintaining data accuracy.
  • Shadow sales calls and meetings to learn effective sales techniques.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (operations, other business units, departments, etc.) to support customer engagement
  • Analyze sales performance data and provide insights into driving growth.

What will my responsibilities be as a Smart Buildings Sales Intern?

  • Position Siemens as an industry leader among service providers, leveraging Siemens world-class digital service delivery as a key differentiator. 
  • Collaborate with operations and internal teams to deliver excellent customer outcomes. 
  • Help prospect for new customers and engage with existing customers on new offerings. 
  • Visit customer sites with both Solutions and Services Sales Teams. 
  • Develop value-based proposals, estimates, specifications, and presentations.
  • Work with operations, finance, legal and other inside and outside resources to obtain the sale.

The goal of this internship program is to develop future talent for the Siemens organization and help you identify where you may be interested in pursuing a career at Siemens post-graduation. 

To apply for the Smart Buildings Sales Internship, candidates must meet the following requirements:

  • Majors: Pursing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Energy/Sustainability, Built Environment, Construction Management or Business Administration, Sales/Marketing with a strong technical engineering aptitude.
