jobs.description_html:
Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) – Day Shift | Part-Time

Location: Legacy Pointe at UCF – Orlando, FL

Departments: Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care

Employment Type: Part-Time

Shift: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM

FLSA: Non-Exempt

Shift Differentials:

Weekdays (Monday 7 AM – Friday 11 PM): No day-shift differential

Weekends (Friday 11 PM – Monday 7 AM): Additional $1.00 per hour

About Legacy Pointe at UCF

Legacy Pointe at UCF is a Life Plan Community dedicated to brightening lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. Our community offers Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing services. We take pride in providing an environment where residents receive compassionate care and employees are recognized for the important work they do.

Position Summary

We are seeking caring and reliable Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) for part-time day-shift opportunities across our Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care departments. This position is ideal for individuals who enjoy providing hands-on resident care and contributing to a supportive healthcare environment. CNAs assist residents with daily routines, personal care, mobility, and other essential needs while promoting independence, safety, and dignity. The position works under the supervision of the assigned department's Nurse Manager and nursing team. Candidates may be considered for opportunities in multiple departments based on experience, qualifications, preferences, and available openings.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Assist residents with bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and morning personal care.
  2. Provide assistance with activities of daily living while encouraging resident independence.
  3. Respond promptly and professionally to call lights and resident requests.
  4. Assist residents with transfers, walking, repositioning, and mobility devices.
  5. Support mealtimes, including setting up trays, serving meals, and providing feeding assistance.
  6. Take and record vital signs, weights, intake/output, and other observations as directed.
  7. Document care accurately and in a timely manner using electronic medical records.
  8. Observe and report changes in residents' health, behavior, or emotional well-being to nursing staff.
  9. Provide compassionate care to residents experiencing dementia, memory loss, or other cognitive challenges.
  10. Help maintain clean, comfortable, and organized resident rooms.
  11. Change linens and prepare, clean, and store resident care equipment and supplies.
  12. Communicate effectively with residents, families, and other members of the care team.
  13. Follow established care plans, infection prevention procedures, and safety guidelines.
  14. Protect resident rights, confidentiality, dignity, and comfort.
  15. Assist with additional resident care and departmental responsibilities as needed.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. High school diploma or equivalent.
  2. Current Florida Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification required.
  3. Current CPR certification meeting assigned department requirements, including BLS/AED as applicable.
  4. One year of experience in a healthcare or residential care setting preferred; an equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered.
  5. Ability to provide respectful, compassionate care to older adults.
  6. Strong communication, teamwork, and interpersonal skills.
  7. Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and established care procedures.
  8. Familiarity with electronic medical records, preferably PointClickCare.
  9. Basic computer and documentation skills.
  10. Patience and understanding when assisting residents with varying physical and cognitive needs.
  11. Dependability and commitment to resident safety and quality care.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift, and assist residents during assigned shifts.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist with resident transfers, positioning, and mobility.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled healthcare environment.

Why Join Legacy Pointe?

At Legacy Pointe, we appreciate employees who bring compassion, dedication, and a commitment to exceptional resident care. Our community offers opportunities to work alongside experienced healthcare professionals, contribute to meaningful resident experiences, and participate in employee recognition and appreciation programs. Benefits and program eligibility vary by employment classification and applicable plan requirements.

Important Notice

Applicants for this position will be required to complete a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse, per House Bill 531 (2025).

Learn more:https://info.flclearinghouse.com

About Legacy Pointe at UCF

At Legacy Pointe at UCF, our mission is to brighten lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. As a Life Plan Community, we provide Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing services. Our community emphasizes hospitality, resident-centered care, and creating meaningful connections that improve the quality of life of those we serve.

Position Summary

Legacy Pointe at UCF is seeking dedicated Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) to join our healthcare team for full-time evening-shift opportunities. Available positions may be within Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, or Memory Care, depending on current staffing needs. The evening-shift CNA assists residents with personal care, mobility, mealtimes, and bedtime routines. This role plays an important part in ensuring residents remain comfortable, safe, and supported as they transition from their daytime activities into the evening. The CNA works under the direction of the assigned department's Nurse Manager and nursing team while providing compassionate, respectful care in accordance with established care plans.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Assist residents with evening personal care, bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and activities of daily living.
  2. Support residents with dinner service, meal setup, feeding assistance, and cleanup as needed.
  3. Assist residents with transfers, ambulation, mobility devices, and safe positioning.
  4. Help residents prepare for bed while respecting their individual routines and preferences.
  5. Respond promptly to call lights, bells, intercoms, and requests for assistance.
  6. Provide compassionate support and reassurance to residents experiencing dementia, Alzheimer's disease, or other cognitive impairments.
  7. Encourage residents to remain as independent as possible while providing appropriate care and supervision.
  8. Observe and report changes in residents' physical condition, behavior, or emotional well-being.
  9. Take and record vital signs, weights, intake/output, and other observations as directed.
  10. Accurately document care and resident observations using electronic medical records.
  11. Turn and reposition residents as directed to promote comfort and prevent pressure injuries.
  12. Change bed linens and maintain clean and organized resident rooms.
  13. Prepare, clean, and properly store equipment, supplies, and treatment trays.
  14. Communicate important resident information and concerns to nursing staff.
  15. Maintain resident safety, confidentiality, rights, and dignity.
  16. Collaborate with coworkers to ensure consistent and high-quality care.
  17. Perform additional responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. High school diploma or equivalent.
  2. Current Florida Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification required.
  3. Current CPR certification meeting assigned department requirements, including BLS/AED as applicable.
  4. One year of experience in a healthcare or residential care setting preferred; an equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered.
  5. Ability to provide individualized care to older adults with varying physical and cognitive needs.
  6. Strong communication, teamwork, and organizational skills.
  7. Ability to follow care plans, nursing instructions, safety guidelines, and established procedures.
  8. Experience with electronic medical records, preferably PointClickCare.
  9. Basic computer skills and the ability to complete accurate documentation.
  10. Good judgment when responding to routine and emergency situations.
  11. Patience, compassion, and commitment to resident-centered care.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist residents throughout the shift.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist residents with mobility, transfers, and repositioning.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled healthcare setting.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe

Eligible full-time employees receive access to benefits that include:

  1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  2. Company-paid basic life insurance
  3. Short-term disability options
  4. 401(k) retirement plan
  5. Paid time off that grows with tenure
  6. Eight paid holidays annually
  7. Scholarship programs for employees and dependents
  8. Employee recognition and milestone awards
  9. Employee discounts on travel, attractions, and entertainment
  10. Annual employee appreciation events

Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) – Evening Shift | Part-Time

Location: Legacy Pointe at UCF – Orlando, FL

Departments: Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care

Employment Type: Part-Time

Shift: 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM

FLSA: Non-Exempt

Shift Differentials:

Weekdays (Monday 7 AM – Friday 11 PM): Additional $1.50 per hour

Weekends (Friday 11 PM – Monday 7 AM): Additional $2.50 per hour

About Legacy Pointe at UCF

Legacy Pointe at UCF is a Life Plan Community committed to brightening lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. We serve residents across Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing, providing care that emphasizes dignity, independence, safety, and meaningful connections. Our team members are an essential part of the resident experience, and we value the dedication and compassion they bring to our community.

Position Summary

Legacy Pointe at UCF is hiring part-time Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) for evening-shift opportunities across Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care. As an evening-shift CNA, you will help residents with personal care, dinner service, mobility, and bedtime routines while maintaining a comfortable and supportive environment. This position requires patience, dependability, and the ability to provide compassionate assistance to residents with varying healthcare needs, including those living with dementia or cognitive impairment. CNAs work closely with licensed nursing staff and the assigned department's Nurse Manager to ensure care is provided safely and in accordance with established care plans. Candidates may be considered for positions in multiple departments depending on qualifications, experience, preferences, and staffing availability.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Assist residents with evening activities of daily living, including bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and personal hygiene.
  2. Help residents prepare for bed and maintain comfortable evening routines.
  3. Support dinner service through meal setup, tray collection, and feeding assistance as needed.
  4. Respond promptly to call lights and requests for resident assistance.
  5. Assist with transfers, ambulation, mobility devices, and repositioning.
  6. Encourage resident independence while providing appropriate support and supervision.
  7. Provide reassurance and individualized care to residents experiencing dementia, memory loss, or cognitive impairments.
  8. Observe and report changes in resident behavior, physical condition, or emotional well-being.
  9. Take and record vital signs, weights, intake/output, and other observations as directed.
  10. Complete timely and accurate documentation in electronic medical records.
  11. Turn and reposition residents as directed to support comfort and prevent pressure injuries.
  12. Change bed linens and maintain clean, safe, and organized resident rooms.
  13. Prepare, clean, and properly store resident care equipment and supplies.
  14. Communicate effectively with residents, families, visitors, and the nursing team.
  15. Follow infection prevention practices, resident care plans, and established safety procedures.
  16. Maintain resident privacy, confidentiality, dignity, and rights.
  17. Assist with other assigned resident care and departmental duties.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. High school diploma or equivalent.
  2. Current Florida Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification required.
  3. Current CPR certification meeting assigned department requirements, including BLS/AED as applicable.
  4. One year of experience in a healthcare or residential care setting preferred; an equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered.
  5. Ability to provide compassionate care to older adults with physical or cognitive limitations.
  6. Strong interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills.
  7. Ability to follow nursing instructions, established care plans, and safety procedures.
  8. Familiarity with electronic charting systems, preferably PointClickCare.
  9. Basic computer skills and the ability to complete accurate resident care documentation.
  10. Good judgment, dependability, and the ability to manage assigned responsibilities.
  11. Commitment to creating a safe, respectful, and positive resident care environment.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist residents during assigned shifts.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist residents with transfers, mobility, and repositioning.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled healthcare setting.

Why Join Legacy Pointe?

Working at Legacy Pointe gives you the opportunity to make a difference in the lives of residents while being part of a supportive healthcare team. We recognize employees through milestone awards, appreciation events, and programs that celebrate the contributions of our staff. Benefits and program eligibility vary based on employment classification and applicable plan requirements.

Important Notice

Applicants for this position will be required to complete a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse, per House Bill 531 (2025).

Learn more:https://info.flclearinghouse.com

Weekends (Friday 11 PM – Monday 7 AM): Additional $2.00 per hour

About Legacy Pointe at UCF

At Legacy Pointe at UCF, our mission is to brighten lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. As a Life Plan Community, we provide Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing services. Our community is committed to providing residents with a welcoming, safe, and supportive environment where dignity and quality of life are always priorities. Our healthcare team plays an essential role in providing consistent, compassionate care throughout the day and night.

Position Summary

Legacy Pointe at UCF is seeking compassionate and dependable Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) for full-time overnight opportunities across Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care. The overnight CNA provides direct resident care, assists with activities of daily living, responds to resident needs, and helps maintain a safe and comfortable environment throughout the night. This role is especially important in supporting residents who require assistance with nighttime routines, mobility, personal care, and reassurance. CNAs work under the direction of the assigned department's Nurse Manager and nursing team while following established care plans and safety procedures. Candidates may be considered for different departments based on qualifications, experience, preferences, and available positions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Provide compassionate, person-centered care to residents throughout the overnight shift.
  2. Respond promptly to call lights, bells, intercoms, and resident requests.
  3. Assist residents with toileting, personal hygiene, dressing, and other activities of daily living.
  4. Provide support with nighttime mobility, transfers, ambulation, and repositioning.
  5. Turn and reposition residents as directed to promote comfort and prevent pressure injuries.
  6. Assist residents who awaken during the night and provide reassurance, comfort, and appropriate assistance.
  7. Support residents living with dementia, Alzheimer's disease, or other cognitive impairments using patience and individualized care approaches.
  8. Observe and promptly report changes in residents' physical condition, behavior, or emotional well-being to licensed nursing staff.
  9. Take and record vital signs, intake/output, and other observations as directed.
  10. Document care accurately and in a timely manner using electronic medical records.
  11. Follow established care plans, nursing instructions, infection prevention practices, and safety procedures.
  12. Assist residents with early morning personal care and preparations for the day as assigned.
  13. Change bed linens and maintain clean, comfortable, and organized resident rooms.
  14. Prepare, clean, and properly store care equipment, supplies, and treatment trays.
  15. Maintain resident confidentiality, privacy, safety, and dignity.
  16. Communicate important resident information and observations to nursing staff.
  17. Work collaboratively with coworkers to maintain consistent, high-quality resident care.
  18. Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. High school diploma or equivalent.
  2. Current Florida Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification required.
  3. Current CPR certification meeting assigned department requirements, including BLS/AED as applicable.
  4. One year of experience in a healthcare or residential care setting preferred; an equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered.
  5. Previous overnight experience in Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, or Memory Care preferred.
  6. Ability to provide compassionate care to residents with varying physical and cognitive needs.
  7. Strong observation, communication, and documentation skills.
  8. Ability to recognize and report changes in resident condition promptly.
  9. Ability to follow individualized care plans, nursing instructions, and safety guidelines.
  10. Familiarity with electronic medical records, preferably PointClickCare.
  11. Basic computer and mathematical skills.
  12. Ability to work independently while remaining an active member of the nursing team.
  13. Dependability, good judgment, and commitment to resident safety.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift, and assist residents throughout the shift.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist with resident transfers, positioning, and mobility.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled healthcare environment.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe

Full-time employees receive access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  2. Company-paid basic life insurance
  3. Short-term disability options
  4. 401(k) retirement plan
  5. Paid time off that increases with tenure
  6. Eight paid holidays annually
  7. Scholarship programs for employees and dependents
  8. Employee recognition and milestone awards
  9. Employee discounts on attractions, travel, and entertainment
  10. Annual employee appreciation events

At Legacy Pointe, your work matters at every hour. Providing comfort, reassurance, and compassionate care throughout the night makes a meaningful difference in the lives of our residents. We welcome individuals who take pride in providing dependable, high-quality care.

Applicants for this position will be required to complete a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse, per House Bill 531 (2025).

About Legacy Pointe at UCF

Legacy Pointe at UCF is a Life Plan Community dedicated to brightening lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida.

We offer a full continuum of care, including Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing. Our community emphasizes resident dignity, safety, meaningful connections, and compassionate service. We recognize that quality resident care is essential around the clock, and our overnight healthcare professionals are an important part of that commitment.

Position Summary

Legacy Pointe at UCF is hiring part-time Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) for overnight opportunities in our Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care departments.

The overnight CNA assists residents with personal care, mobility, toileting, repositioning, and other nighttime needs while maintaining a safe and supportive environment.

This position is suited for individuals who are attentive, patient, dependable, and comfortable providing care during overnight hours. CNAs work under the direction of the assigned department's Nurse Manager and nursing team to ensure care is provided in accordance with resident needs, established care plans, and safety procedures.

Department placement will depend on available openings, qualifications, experience, and candidate preferences.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Provide direct, compassionate care to residents during assigned overnight shifts.
  2. Respond promptly to resident call lights, bells, intercoms, and requests for assistance.
  3. Assist residents with toileting, personal hygiene, dressing, repositioning, and activities of daily living.
  4. Support safe resident transfers, ambulation, positioning, and mobility.
  5. Turn and reposition residents as directed to support comfort and help prevent pressure injuries.
  6. Provide reassurance and assistance to residents who awaken or require support throughout the night.
  7. Assist residents experiencing dementia, Alzheimer's disease, or other cognitive impairments with patience and understanding.
  8. Monitor and report changes in resident health, behavior, comfort, or emotional condition.
  9. Take and record vital signs, intake/output, and other observations as directed.
  10. Complete timely and accurate electronic documentation of resident care.
  11. Follow care plans, nursing instructions, infection prevention procedures, and established safety guidelines.
  12. Assist with early morning resident care and preparations for the day when assigned.
  13. Change linens and maintain clean, safe, and organized resident rooms.
  14. Clean, prepare, and properly store care equipment and supplies.
  15. Maintain resident confidentiality, dignity, privacy, and safety.
  16. Communicate resident needs and important observations to licensed nursing staff.
  17. Work collaboratively with the nursing team to maintain consistent resident care.
  18. Complete additional assigned duties as needed.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. High school diploma or equivalent.
  2. Current Florida Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification required.
  3. Current CPR certification meeting assigned department requirements, including BLS/AED as applicable.
  4. One year of experience in a healthcare or residential care setting preferred; an equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered.
  5. Previous overnight healthcare or senior living experience preferred.
  6. Ability to provide compassionate assistance to residents with varying physical and cognitive needs.
  7. Strong communication, observation, and organizational skills.
  8. Ability to follow established care plans, nursing instructions, and safety procedures.
  9. Familiarity with electronic medical records, preferably PointClickCare.
  10. Basic computer skills and the ability to document care accurately.
  11. Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with other healthcare professionals.
  12. Dependability, patience, and a commitment to providing safe, respectful care.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift, and assist residents throughout assigned shifts.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist with resident mobility, transfers, and repositioning.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled healthcare environment.

Why Join Legacy Pointe?

As a member of the Legacy Pointe team, you will contribute to a caring and supportive environment where residents receive personalized assistance and respectful care.

We value the contributions of our employees and recognize their dedication through employee appreciation events, milestone celebrations, and recognition programs. Benefits and program eligibility vary based on employment classification and applicable plan requirements. Whether helping a resident feel comfortable during the night or assisting with the start of their morning, your work contributes directly to the quality of life of those we serve.

About Our Mission

At Legacy Pointe at UCF, our mission is grounded in a simple and meaningful purpose: to brighten lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. Everything we do is built around that vision. Our community was created on the belief that older adults deserve to live with dignity, connection, opportunity, and joy, every single day. As a Life Plan Community, we provide a full continuum of care, from independent living to assisted living and memory care, all the way to skilled nursing. Our culture is shaped by hospitality, service, and accountability, and our affiliation with UCF enhances what we offer through lifelong learning, intergenerational opportunities, and innovative programming. Legacy Pointe is a modern, welcoming community where people feel seen, valued, and cared for. Whether someone is participating in a wellness program, engaging in a cognitive activity, receiving compassionate support, or enjoying a meaningful moment of connection, our priority is always their comfort, dignity, and quality of life.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe

Joining Legacy Pointe means becoming part of a team that appreciates your work and supports your well-being. We want you to feel equipped, encouraged, and valued in your role.

Full-time employees receive access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Company-paid Basic Life Insurance

• Short-term disability options

• 401(k) retirement plan

• Paid time off that grows with tenure

• Eight paid holidays annually

• Scholarship programs for employees and dependents

• Recognition programs, including milestone awards and annual celebrations

• Employee discount program with savings on attractions, travel, and entertainment

• Annual staff appreciation events

Work That Makes a Difference

Working at Legacy Pointe is deeply meaningful. Each day brings moments where your presence, patience, and compassion can change someone’s experience for the better. You help residents feel comforted, safe, understood, and supported, especially those living with cognitive impairment, who depend on consistency and connection. You build trust, create calm, and offer reassurance through even the simplest interactions. At the end of the day, you know your work mattered. Every role at Legacy Pointe contributes to these moments of impact, and we value the people who show up with empathy, skill, and dedication. There is purpose here. There is growth here. And there is a place for you at Legacy Pointe.

Cook – Position Summary

The Cook is responsible for preparing high-quality, nutritious meals for residents in accordance with established menus, standardized recipes, and individual dietary requirements. This role plays a critical part in resident satisfaction by ensuring meals are prepared safely, served on time, and meet all texture modifications, allergy restrictions, and physician-ordered diets. The Cook adheres to proper food handling, sanitation, and temperature-control standards while maintaining an organized, clean, and efficient kitchen environment. Working collaboratively with the Dietary team, the Cook supports daily meal service, special events, and catering functions while consistently demonstrating professionalism and hospitality aligned with the community’s service excellence philosophy and core values.In addition to food preparation, the Cook is responsible for maintaining compliance with federal, state, and local food safety regulations, including infection control and allergen-handling practices. This position requires effective communication with dietary staff, nursing, and leadership to address resident preferences, intake concerns, equipment needs, and operational issues. The Cook contributes to quality assurance efforts through taste testing, audits, and participation in training and orientation for new team members when assigned. The role involves working in a fast-paced commercial kitchen environment and requires reliability, attention to detail, adaptability, and a genuine interest in serving older adults.

Requirements and Qualifications

  1. High school diploma or GED preferred, with at least one year of cooking experience in healthcare, hospitality, restaurant, or senior living environments preferred
  2. Ability to prepare meals using standardized recipes while following dietary restrictions, texture modifications, allergy protocols, and food safety standards
  3. Knowledge of safe food handling, sanitation practices, temperature controls, and infection prevention procedures
  4. Ability to obtain and maintain required Food Handler certification within established timeframes
  5. Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced kitchen environment
  6. Effective communication skills and the ability to work respectfully and collaboratively with dietary staff, nursing, leadership, residents, and families
  7. Demonstrated professionalism, reliability, punctuality, and a strong work ethic
  8. Basic math and computer skills to support food preparation, documentation, and electronic dietary systems as applicable
  9. Ability to stand for extended periods, use hands for food preparation, and safely lift or carry items up to 50 pounds
  10. Availability to work weekends, holidays, evenings, and varying shifts as required

Important Notice: Applicants for this position will be required to complete a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse, per House Bill 531 (2025). Learn more here: https://info.flclearinghouse.com

Position Summary

The Dining Services Supervisor supports the daily front-of-house operations of Dining Services by assisting the Dining Room Manager and Dining Services Director with service oversight, staff support, training, floor leadership, and resident satisfaction initiatives. This role helps maintain service standards across the main dining room, bistro, bar, and designated assisted living dining operations. The DSS acts as a working leader who supports daily execution, reinforces expectations, assists with events, and provides leadership coverage in the absence of the DRM, including days off and vacation periods.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The following duties are normal for this position. This list is not to be construed as exclusive or all inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned.

  1. Support the DRM and DSD in the daily operation of dining services front-of-house areas.
  2. Assist with supervising service staff in the main dining room, bistro, and bar to ensure consistent hospitality, professionalism, and service flow.
  3. Provide floor leadership during meal periods by monitoring section coverage, resident service, table maintenance, beverage service, and staff responsiveness.
  4. Serve as a visible leadership presence on the floor and help reinforce service expectations, dress code, professionalism, and daily accountability.
  5. Assist in training and orienting new dining staff on service procedures, side work, resident interaction, and front-of-house standards.
  6. Reinforce service standards through daily coaching and real-time feedback to improve consistency, hospitality, and team performance.
  7. Support service operations in Assisted Living, including meal flow, staffing support, resident satisfaction, table service quality, and communication with care or nursing teams as needed.
  8. Assist with service oversight for special events, theme meals, and catering functions, including set-up, service execution, staffing coordination, and breakdown.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Educational Requirements and Experience

  1. High School diploma or equivalent required.
  2. Minimum of 2 years of dining, restaurant, hospitality, or senior living food service experience preferred.
  3. Previous lead server, shift leader, or supervisory experience preferred.
  4. Ability to obtain Food Handler certification within required timeframe (if applicable).
  5. Experience working with older adults or in healthcare dining is helpful.
  6. Core Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
  7. Strong understanding of dining room operations, service flow, and resident/customer service.
  8. Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  9. Willingness to work with the elderly in a senior living environment
  10. Effectively communicate with residents, guests, associates, and supervisors
  11. Must be able to work on all Holidays and for pre-planned special events
  12. Ability to train staff, reinforce standards, and lead by example.
  13. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing operational needs
  14. Availability to work weekends, holidays, and flexible shifts.
  15. Environment Adaptability:
  16. Works primarily indoors in a climate-controlled setting
  17. Possible exposure to chemicals as identified in the MSDS Manual

Important Notice: Applicants for this position will be required to complete a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse, per House Bill 531 (2025). Learn more here:https://info.flclearinghouse.com

And there is a place for you at Legacy Pointe.

Housekeeper – Position Summary

The Housekeeper is responsible for maintaining a clean, safe, and welcoming environment throughout the community to support resident comfort, health, and satisfaction. Reporting to the Housekeeping Manager, this role performs routine, scheduled, and as-needed cleaning of resident apartments, common areas, dining spaces, offices, and healthcare units in accordance with established cleaning schedules, infection control standards, and safety protocols.

The Housekeeper plays an essential role in infection prevention and overall community presentation by sanitizing high-touch surfaces, properly handling waste, and using approved cleaning products and equipment. This position requires attention to detail, respect for resident privacy, and the ability to respond promptly and courteously to housekeeping requests and urgent needs such as spills, accidents, or outbreak-related cleaning.

The role requires the ability to work independently and as part of a team, follow written and verbal instructions, and adapt to changing priorities. The Housekeeper must demonstrate professionalism, a service-oriented attitude, and a genuine interest in supporting a senior population while working flexible schedules, including weekends or holidays as needed.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. High School Diploma or GED preferred, but not required
  2. Prior housekeeping, janitorial, environmental services, or custodial experience preferred
  3. Experience in senior living, skilled nursing, assisted living, memory care, healthcare, hospitality, or commercial environments strongly preferred
  4. Familiarity with cleaning chemicals, floor care equipment, and infection control practices preferred
  5. Prior experience working with older adults or individuals with disabilities is a plus
  6. Knowledge and Skills
  7. Knowledge of proper cleaning, sanitizing, and disinfection techniques
  8. Understanding of infection control standards and safe handling of cleaning chemicals and waste
  9. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established schedules and procedures
  10. Ability to recognize and report safety hazards, maintenance concerns, or resident-related observations
  11. Effective verbal communication skills and ability to interact respectfully with residents, families, staff, and visitors
  12. Ability to maintain confidentiality and demonstrate professionalism at all times
  13. Strong time-management and organizational skills
  14. Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team environment
  15. Willingness and ability to respond to urgent housekeeping needs and changing priorities
  16. Physical and Work Requirements
  17. Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, reach, and perform repetitive motions throughout the shift
  18. Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull supplies and equipment (generally up to 50 pounds, occasionally more with assistance)
  19. Ability to work indoors across various environments including resident apartments, healthcare units, offices, dining areas, and restrooms
  20. Ability to tolerate exposure to cleaning chemicals, dust, allergens, and typical healthcare-related conditions while using proper PPE
  21. Ability to work flexible schedules, including weekends, holidays, evenings, or extended hours as required

Important Notice: Applicants for this position will be required to complete a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse, per House Bill 531 (2025). Learn more here: https://info.flclearinghouse.com

jobs.description_html:
Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)

Location: Legacy Pointe at UCF – Orlando, FL

Departments: Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living & Memory Care

Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time opportunities, depending on available positions

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Available Shifts

Day Shift: 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM

Overnight Shift: 7:00 PM – 7:00 AM

Additional shifts and opportunities across Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care may be available based on staffing needs.

Shift Differentials

Applicable shift differentials are paid based on hours worked.

Weekdays (Monday 7 AM – Friday 11 PM):

  1. 7 AM – 3 PM: No differential
  2. 3 PM – 11 PM: Additional $1.50/hour
  3. 11 PM – 7 AM: Additional $1.00/hour

Weekends (Friday 11 PM – Monday 7 AM):

  1. 7 AM – 3 PM: Additional $1.00/hour
  2. 3 PM – 11 PM: Additional $2.50/hour
  3. 11 PM – 7 AM: Additional $2.00/hour

About Legacy Pointe at UCF

At Legacy Pointe at UCF, our mission is to brighten lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. As a Life Plan Community, we offer a full continuum of care, including Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing. Our community is built around hospitality, service, and accountability, with a commitment to helping residents feel valued, supported, and cared for. We are seeking compassionate, dependable Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs) who are passionate about providing high-quality care and making a meaningful difference in the lives of older adults.

Position Summary

The Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) provides direct nursing care to residents under the direction of nursing leadership and in accordance with applicable nursing regulations and established care plans. Responsibilities include administering medications and treatments, monitoring changes in resident condition, maintaining accurate clinical documentation, and collaborating with healthcare team members to ensure resident safety and quality care. LPNs may work in Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, or Memory Care depending on qualifications, candidate preferences, and staffing needs. This role requires professionalism, strong clinical skills, effective communication, and a commitment to compassionate, resident-centered care.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Provide direct nursing care in accordance with physician orders, established care plans, and nursing standards.
  2. Administer medications and treatments safely and accurately within the LPN scope of practice.
  3. Monitor residents for changes in physical, emotional, behavioral, and cognitive conditions.
  4. Report significant changes in resident condition to the appropriate nursing staff or healthcare provider.
  5. Take and document vital signs, blood glucose readings, and other clinical observations.
  6. Perform wound care, dressing changes, and other nursing procedures as authorized and assigned.
  7. Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation using electronic medical records.
  8. Assist with developing, implementing, and updating individualized resident care plans within assigned responsibilities.
  9. Communicate effectively with physicians, residents, families, nursing supervisors, and interdisciplinary team members.
  10. Provide direction and support to Certified Nursing Assistants and other care team members consistent with applicable regulations and departmental procedures.
  11. Respond promptly to resident needs, changes in condition, and emergency situations.
  12. Assist with resident admissions, transfers, and discharges as assigned.
  13. Follow infection prevention, medication safety, and resident safety procedures.
  14. Provide appropriate care and reassurance to residents with dementia, Alzheimer's disease, and other cognitive impairments.
  15. Maintain residents' rights, privacy, dignity, confidentiality, and emotional well-being.
  16. Encourage resident independence while providing appropriate nursing support.
  17. Maintain clean, organized, and properly supplied treatment and nursing areas.
  18. Complete required documentation, training, and other assigned responsibilities.
  19. Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. Graduate of an accredited practical nursing program.
  2. Current, active Florida Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license required.
  3. Current CPR/BLS certification required.
  4. Previous experience in Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, Memory Care, long-term care, or a related healthcare setting preferred.
  5. Knowledge of nursing procedures, medication administration, infection prevention, and resident safety.
  6. Ability to recognize changes in resident condition and respond appropriately.
  7. Strong clinical observation, critical thinking, communication, and organizational skills.
  8. Ability to accurately document care using electronic medical records; PointClickCare experience preferred.
  9. Ability to follow physician orders, established care plans, and nursing procedures.
  10. Strong teamwork and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities in a healthcare environment.
  11. Patience, professionalism, dependability, and compassion when providing care to older adults.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, and provide hands-on resident care throughout the shift.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist residents with mobility, transfers, and positioning.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled healthcare environment.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe

At Legacy Pointe, we value the dedication and compassion of our healthcare employees. We strive to provide a welcoming workplace where employees feel supported, appreciated, and empowered to make a difference. Eligible full-time employees receive access to benefits that include:

  1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  2. Company-paid basic life insurance
  3. Short-term disability options
  4. 401(k) retirement plan
  5. Paid time off that grows with tenure
  6. Eight paid holidays annually
  7. Scholarship programs for employees and dependents
  8. Employee recognition and milestone awards
  9. Employee discounts on attractions, travel, and entertainment
  10. Annual employee appreciation events

Benefits and program eligibility depend on employment classification and applicable plan requirements.

Work That Makes a Difference

Nursing at Legacy Pointe is about providing more than clinical care. It is about building trust, supporting independence, and making residents feel comfortable, safe, and respected. Whether you're caring for residents in Skilled Nursing, supporting daily health needs in Assisted Living, or providing compassionate care in Memory Care, your work contributes directly to the quality of life of those we serve. We welcome dedicated nurses who want to be part of a resident-focused community.

Important Notice

Applicants for this position will be required to complete a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse, per House Bill 531 (2025).

Learn more:https://info.flclearinghouse.com

About Our Mission
At Legacy Pointe at UCF, our mission is grounded in a simple and meaningful purpose: to brighten lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. Everything we do is built around that vision. Our community was created on the belief that older adults deserve to live with dignity, connection, opportunity, and joy—every single day.

As a Life Plan Community, we provide a full continuum of care, from independent living to assisted living and memory care, all the way to skilled nursing. Our culture is shaped by hospitality, service, and accountability, and our affiliation with UCF enhances what we offer through lifelong learning, intergenerational opportunities, and innovative programming.

Legacy Pointe is a modern, welcoming community where people feel seen, valued, and cared for. Whether someone is participating in a wellness program, engaging in a cognitive activity, receiving compassionate support, or enjoying a meaningful moment of connection, our priority is always their comfort, dignity, and quality of life.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe
Joining Legacy Pointe means becoming part of a team that appreciates your work and supports your well-being. We want you to feel equipped, encouraged, and valued in your role.

Work That Makes a Difference
Working at Legacy Pointe is deeply meaningful. Each day brings moments where your presence, patience, and compassion can change someone’s experience for the better. You help residents feel comforted, safe, understood, and supported—especially those living with cognitive impairment, who depend on consistency and connection.

You build trust, create calm, and offer reassurance through even the simplest interactions. At the end of the day, you know your work mattered. Every role at Legacy Pointe contributes to these moments of impact, and we value the people who show up with empathy, skill, and dedication.

There is purpose here. There is growth here. And there is a place for you at Legacy Pointe.

RN House Supervisor – Position Summary

The RN House Supervisor oversees nursing staff and daily clinical operations within the Skilled Nursing Facility to ensure safe, high-quality resident care. Reporting to Nurse Leadership, this role coordinates admissions, discharges, and care plans; conducts daily rounds; and ensures accurate documentation and compliance with facility policies, infection control standards, and regulatory requirements. The RN House Supervisor provides leadership support to RNs, LPNs, and CNAs, promotes teamwork and professionalism, and serves as a clinical resource for staff, residents, and families. 

This position is responsible for addressing staffing needs, responding to clinical or operational issues during assigned shifts, and assisting with staff supervision and performance oversight. In the absence of senior nursing leadership, the RN House Supervisor may handle urgent disciplinary matters and ensure continuity of care. The role requires an active Florida RN license, prior nursing leadership experience, strong clinical judgment, effective communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while working varied shifts, including weekends or holidays as needed.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Florida (required)
  • Associate’s Degree in Nursing from an accredited college or university (required)
  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) preferred
  • Minimum of two (2) years of nursing leadership experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility, Long-Term Care, or Acute Care setting
  • At least two (2) years of supervisory or managerial experience in a healthcare environment
  • Strong knowledge of infection control standards, CMS guidelines, and survey readiness
  • Experience with staff education, training, and competency assessments
  • Certification in Infection Prevention & Control (CIC) preferred or willingness to obtain
  • Strong clinical judgment and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to supervise and support RNs, LPNs, and CNAs
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with basic computer systems; PointClickCare (PCC) knowledge preferred
  • Ability to work weekends, holidays, evenings, or varied shifts as needed
  • Physical ability to perform job-related duties in a clinical environment

Important Notice: Applicants for this position will be required to complete a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse, per House Bill 531 (2025). Learn more here: https://info.flclearinghouse.com

jobs.description_html:
Position Title:

Security Guard Officer

Department:

Facilities/Plant Operations

FLSA:

Non-Exempt

Supervisor:

Director of Facilities/Plant Operations/Security Supervisor

Supervises:

N/A

Welcome to Legacy Pointe at UCF!

Legacy Pointe at UCF is a premier continuing care retirement community in the heart of Oviedo, Florida. Our state-of-the-art community is uniquely affiliated with the University of Central Florida, offering residents access to lifelong learning, innovative programs, and an exceptional quality of life. At Legacy Pointe, we embrace the Pinnacles of Hospitality, Service, and Accountability. These values guide our commitment to creating warm welcomes, delivering outstanding care, and taking pride in our responsibilities.

We are currently seeking passionate and skilled professionals to join our team and contribute to the vibrant culture that makes Legacy Pointe so special. If you are ready to make a difference and be part of an innovative and caring community, we would love to meet you! To learn more about Legacy Pointe, visit our website: www.legacypointeatucf.com, where you can explore Lifecare, Living Options, and our commitment to Lifelong Learning.

Job Summary:

The Security Guard is responsible for ensuring the overall safety and security of residents, associates, and their guests by ensuring that only authorized individuals enter the campus. Security Guards work hand in hand with the Health Services Team during emergency response situations. Reports to the Security Supervisor.

Essential Job Functions:

  1. Provide quality customer service in all interactions with residents, guests and staff while maintaining the Rules of Engagement.
  2. Represent the Company through professional demeanor and attitude.
  3. Promptly and kindly greets all residents, guests and employees at the Gate House and around campus.
  4. Monitors residents’ individual Emergency Response System/ Personal Help Button in addition to campus wide surveillance cameras.
  5. Patrols campus and parking areas in an effort to prevent unauthorized parking, potential thefts, vandalism, and ensuring resident safety.
  6. Conducts inspections of campus for safety issues such as roads for potholes, lighting outages on interior & exterior areas and other potential hazards.
  7. Responds to campus emergencies of a medical, criminal, or mechanical nature.
  8. Conducts resident wellness checks by phone and in-person as needed.
  9. Provide reports of calls generated by Emergency Call System to Security Supervisor.
  10. Performs investigation and documentation of incidents including reports of theft, accidents on campus, resident injuries and unauthorized visitors on campus.
  11. Assists Human Resources department with employee terminations as requested.
  12. Adheres to all company policies and procedures.
  13. Attend departmental education and all required in-service training/education.
  14. Maintain confidentiality of resident/family and facility information in accordance with HIPPA regulations.
  15. Respond to all campus fire alarms and assist the fire department in the evacuation of residents when needed.
  16. Cooperate with staff of other departments when needed.
  17. Perform any other duties as required.

Qualifications:

  1. High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  2. Prior Security experience preferred, but willing to train the right candidate.
  3. CPR, AED & First Aid Certified eligible.
  4. Class D security license preferred.

Critical Skills / Expertise:

  1. Strong customer service skills.
  2. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with attention to detail.
  3. Sound judgment and decision making skills.
  4. Self- directed and requires minimal supervision.
  5. Excellent interpersonal skills.
  6. Able to work well with others, including staff, supervisor, residents, families, volunteers and the public.

Equipment Skills:

  1. Knowledge of windows based applications, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Internet, and e-mail.
  2. Ability to use and interact effectively on the telephone and voice mail on a multi-line phone.

Physical Requirements:

  1. Required walking, standing, stooping and/or bending for periods of time, climbing ladder or step stool.
  2. Ability to sit or stand for extended time.
  3. Ability to climb stairs, reach overhead.
  4. Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

Working Conditions:

  1. Busy outdoor and indoor environments.
  2. Exposure to heat and humidity; exposure to cold.

Hospitality Philosophy:

Legacy Pointe at UCF embraces a culture of hospitality. To that end, we include the following hospitality promises in this description. These promises must be fully exercised and are part of your performance evaluation.

Hospitality Promises:

  1. We greet residents, associates and guest warmly, by name and with a smile.
  2. We treat everyone with courteous respect.
  3. We strive to anticipate resident, associate and guest needs and act accordingly.
  4. We listen and respond enthusiastically in a timely manner.
  5. We hold ourselves and one another accountable.
  6. We embrace and value our differences.
  7. We make residents, associates and guests feel important.
  8. We ask “is there anything else I can do for you?”
  9. We maintain high levels of professionalism, both in conduct and appearance, at all times.
  10. We pay attention to details.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe

Joining Legacy Pointe means becoming part of a team that appreciates your work and supports your well-being. We want you to feel equipped, encouraged, and valued in your role.

Work That Makes a Difference

Working at Legacy Pointe is deeply meaningful. Each day brings moments where your presence, patience, and compassion can change someone’s experience for the better. You help residents feel comforted, safe, understood, and supported—especially those living with cognitive impairment, who depend on consistency and connection.

You build trust, create calm, and offer reassurance through even the simplest interactions. At the end of the day, you know your work mattered. Every role at Legacy Pointe contributes to these moments of impact, and we value the people who show up with empathy, skill, and dedication.

There is purpose here. There is growth here. And there is a place for you at Legacy Pointe.

RN - Position Summary

The Registered Nurse (RN) provides direct nursing care to residents in a Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) under the supervision of the Director of Nursing (DON), Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON), and Nurse Supervisors. This role is responsible for ensuring high-quality resident care, accurate documentation, and compliance with facility policies and state regulations. RNs also supervise Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs), ensuring effective teamwork and continuity of care. Duties and responsibilities will be completed while demonstrating behaviors that align with our Community’s Service Excellence philosophy and core values.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The following duties are normal for this position. This list is not to be construed as exclusive or all inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned.

  • Provide direct nursing care to residents, including medication administration, wound care, and treatments as prescribed.
  • Monitor residents' conditions and report significant changes to the DON, ADON, or  Nurse Supervisors.
  • Supervise CNAs, ensuring proper documentation, adherence to care plans, and assistance with resident needs.
  • Conduct and receive shift reports at the beginning and end of each shift to ensure continuity of care and effective communication.
  • Assist in resident admissions, discharges, and transfers, ensuring accurate documentation and coordination with healthcare providers.
  • Establishes and maintains a close liaison with residents and families.
  • Educate residents and families on care plans, medications, and health conditions as needed.
  • Maintain compliance with all state and federal Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) regulations.
  • Follow infection control protocols, including proper use of PPE and sanitation procedures.
  • Respond promptly to resident needs, ensuring a compassionate, resident-centered approach to care.
  • Collaborate with physicians, therapists, and social workers to coordinate resident care.
  • Assist with emergency response procedures and provide first aid or CPR as necessary.
  • Document resident care accurately using electronic medical records (EMR) on facility-approved computers, tablets, or iPads.
  • Assists with ongoing care management meetings.
  • Support quality assurance initiatives and participate in performance improvement programs.
  • Work as part of a team, assisting fellow nurses and CNAs when needed to maintain smooth operations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the nursing leadership team.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Oversee CNAs to ensure proper resident care and documentation.
  • Assist with training and mentoring new CNAs.
  • Address performance concerns and escalate issues to the DON as necessary.
  • Ensure CNAs follow resident care plans and facility protocols.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Educational Requirements and Experience:

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Florida (Required).
  • CPR/AED certification required.
  • Experience in long-term care or skilled nursing preferred but not required.
  • Familiarity with Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) regulations and compliance standards preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Language Ability:

  • Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally, speaking the primary language of the residents.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

Mathematical Skills:

  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent, and to draw and interpret graphs.

Interpersonal Skills:

  • Ability to work in a polite, respectful, caring, calm, and compassionate way

Ability to Handle Confidential Information:

  • Must be a trustworthy individual who can keep items confidential as appropriate

Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in using computers, tablets, or iPads for recording vital signs, charting, and reviewing resident care plans.
  • Basic typing skills to ensure efficient and accurate data entry.
  • Ability to use the Internet.

Problem-Solving & Adaptability:

  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.  
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

Competencies:

  • Must demonstrate an interest in working with a senior cognitive impaired population.
  • Provides leadership by exhibiting confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well.
  • Interacts with guests, residents and staff in a courteous and friendly manner.
  • Responds promptly to resident and visitor needs and assistance.
  • Supports organization's goals and values.
  • Balances team and individual responsibilities. Manages people effectively by taking responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff; Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; Improves processes, products and services.
  • Provides leadership by exhibiting confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well.

Environmental Adaptability:

  • Works primarily indoors in a climate-controlled setting

Important Notice: Applicants for this position will be required to complete a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse, per House Bill 531 (2025). Learn more here: https://info.flclearinghouse.com
